Senior Lead Product Manager - EA SPORTS™ FC
EA SPORTS is one of the most iconic brands in entertainment, connecting hundreds of millions of players around the world to the sports they love through a portfolio of industry-leading video games.
EA SPORTS FC represents the future of interactive football, bringing together a global community of players across an evolving ecosystem of experiences. As we continue to expand the scope and ambition of FC, our Product Management team plays a critical role in understanding our players, shaping product strategy, and helping teams make the decisions that move the franchise forward.
We are looking for a Senior Lead Product Manager to take on some of the most complex and strategically important product challenges across EA SPORTS FC. This role combines senior product leadership, analytical thinking, and deep cross-functional collaboration. You will help shape live service strategy, influence feature roadmaps across major FC experiences, and ensure that player behavior and product performance are translated into clear, actionable decisions.
You will work closely with teams across Product, Design, Development, Analytics, Commercial, Finance, and senior leadership. In many cases, you will influence strategies and roadmaps that are owned by partner teams rather than directly by you, making the ability to build trust, develop strong product perspectives, and influence without authority essential to success.
This is a role for someone who can operate at multiple altitudes. You will help establish strategic direction and hold the broader product vision while remaining close enough to the work to interrogate data, build models, develop strategies and business cases, and solve difficult problems directly when needed. You will also provide leadership and mentorship to other Product Managers, helping translate broader strategy into clear direction and raising the quality of product decision making across the team.
This role is based in Vancouver, Canada. We operate in a required, hybrid or fully in office work model. Relocation support is available.
Your Responsibilities
Lead product strategy across complex and high-impact areas of EA SPORTS FC, translating player needs, business goals, and franchise priorities into clear strategic direction.
Partner closely with teams across major FC experiences, including Career and Grounds, to shape live service strategy and influence feature roadmaps, priorities, and investment decisions.
Build deep understanding of player behavior and product performance, using quantitative and qualitative insights to identify opportunities, diagnose problems, and inform product decisions.
Interrogate data and analytical methodologies, working closely with Analytics and Data partners to ensure conclusions are robust, appropriately contextualized, and actionable.
Develop and communicate trusted performance narratives for senior leadership, connecting player behavior, product decisions, business outcomes, risks, and emerging opportunities.
Lead or support forecasting, opportunity sizing, scenario modeling, and feature impact assessment to inform product and investment decisions.
Create compelling product strategies, business cases, and recommendations that turn complex information into clear choices for senior stakeholders.
Define measurement approaches for features and live service initiatives, including KPIs, experimentation strategies, testing plans, and post-launch evaluation.
Identify and develop high-value problem and opportunity spaces, helping teams prioritize where product investment can have the greatest player and franchise impact.
Influence senior stakeholders and partner teams without direct authority, building alignment across competing perspectives, priorities, and organizational boundaries.
Build strong partnerships across Product, Design, Development, Analytics, Commercial, Finance, and other teams throughout the FC organization.
Provide strategic direction, mentorship, and product leadership to other Product Managers, helping teams translate broader vision into focused execution.
Represent the Product Management perspective in senior cross-functional conversations and act as a trusted partner during complex, ambiguous, or fast-moving situations.
Help evolve the practices, frameworks, and ways of working that allow the FC Product Management team to operate effectively as its scope and influence continue to grow.
Your Qualifications
Deep familiarity with EA SPORTS FC, football games, or the broader football ecosystem is highly desirable. Candidates with a strong understanding of the FC franchise, its players, modes, and community will be particularly well positioned to succeed in this role.
Minimum of 10 years of experience in Product Management or closely related product disciplines, with demonstrated experience operating at a senior level on complex consumer products.
Strong product leadership skills, with experience setting strategic direction, navigating ambiguity, and solving problems that span multiple teams or product areas.
Strong analytical capabilities, including experience interpreting product telemetry, challenging analytical assumptions, working with dashboards and models, and translating data into product decisions.
Demonstrated ability to influence senior stakeholders and cross-functional teams without direct authority, particularly where priorities, incentives, or perspectives may differ.
Excellent executive communication and storytelling skills, with experience turning complex product, player, and business information into clear recommendations.
Experience developing product strategies, business cases, opportunity sizing, forecasts, or similar analyses used to support significant product decisions.
Experience working closely with Analytics, Data Science, Design, Development, Commercial, Finance, or similar partner functions.
Ability to operate effectively as both a strategic leader and a hands-on contributor, moving comfortably between high-level direction and detailed problem solving.
Experience providing leadership, mentorship, or strategic direction to other Product Managers or cross-functional teams.
Experience with live services, gaming, sports, entertainment, or other large-scale consumer digital products is strongly preferred.
A passion for games and an understanding of what creates compelling, long-term player experiences is strongly preferred.

Lead Game Product Manager, Game Product Management - EA SPORTS™ FC
EA SPORTS is one of the most iconic brands in entertainment – connecting hundreds of millions around the world to the sports they love through a portfolio of industry-leading video games.
After nearly 30 years of creating genre-defining, interactive football experiences with the world's biggest football entertainment platform, EA SPORTS FIFA, we are soon beginning an exciting new era. EA SPORTS FC will become the future of football from EA SPORTS – as we strive to take global football experiences to new heights, on behalf of football fans everywhere.
With more opportunity than ever to innovate and create new, authentic experiences that bring joy, inclusivity, and immersion to a global community of fans, we invite you to join us and pioneer the future of football with EA SPORTS!
The Live Product Manager's mission, in close collaboration with the wider Live Content Team, is to help create the most engaging and rewarding live service experience for our players. You will have a mix of strategic skills, creative instinct and analytical ability that can help create relevant plans and content strategies that benefit our players.
A Product Manager will partner directly with Producers, Game Designers, Artists and external partners to further the growth of FC.
Your Responsibilities
Design and manage live content, stories and features that maximize acquisition, engagement and monetization throughout the product cycle in any FC mode.
Support strategic planning for your area, ensuring the goals are in synergy with other parts of the product.
Conduct and communicate in-depth analysis of in-game behaviour trends using data insights and strong business acumen to impact top line KPIs.
Create and communicate concise and inspiring roadmaps, strategies and execution plans for your product space.
Be passionate about, and represent the voice and needs of our customers and partners within FC.
Determine measurement plans, testing strategies, execute A/B testing campaigns and conduct post mortems.
As an individual contributor, support the growth of the product management practice through demonstration of product competencies as an example of the craft at its best.
Work closely with the game team to both create new live service spaces within our game modes, as well as drive best-practice strategies for new live service levers in your existing product space.
Track and develop an expert level understanding of gaming trends and insights from the market.
Create live content stories & plans using a combination of real and imagined football events.
Collaborate with our internal technical partner groups, being a key stakeholder in technologies that impact the game or live service.
Partner with Central teams and craft requirements for all player facing features outside the game team's scope.
Your Qualifications
A passion for games with a player first mentality.
8 years of Product Management or other relevant Game discipline experience required (ideally in Live Services).
Self-motivated team player that brings excitement and enthusiasm to work each day.
Strong analytical skills and experience with data driven product design and decision making.
Sound and proven ability in using and understanding in-game trends using data insights to impact top line KPIs.
Strong communication and writing skills, with experience preparing and presenting decks to various senior stakeholders.
Excellent organizational skills, with the ability to juggle priorities and projects.
The ability to adapt to a variety of delivery methodologies in play.
Highly desirable but not essential: A football fan with a good understanding of the core mechanics of FC and its live features, or willing to develop this understanding in the role.
Experienced in:
Successful live service console and/or mobile games having delivered and maintained at least one product through the product life cycle.
Identifying gaps and iterations in an existing product and choosing a direction to pursue to capture opportunities.
Designing content, campaigns and features that maximize acquisition, engagement, and monetization throughout the product life cycle, with an eye for retention & loyalty.
Obtaining insights and developing strategies through analytical metrics driven analysis and design experimentation.

About Design Home
Design Home is the world’s leading interior design mobile game, empowering millions of players to create beautiful spaces using real-world furniture and décor. With over a billion lifetime downloads and partnerships with top lifestyle brands like West Elm, Serena & Lily, and Arhaus, Design Home sits at the intersection of gaming, creativity, and commerce.
As we enter the next evolution of the franchise, we’re looking for a Lead Product Manager to help shape the future of design entertainment.
The Role
As Lead Product Manager, you will report to the Director of Product and own the product vision, roadmap, and performance outcomes for major Design Home initiatives. You’ll guide a cross-functional team of designers, engineers, analysts, and artists to drive growth, engagement, and profitability across our live service. You’ll play a central role in defining how Design Home expands its economy, player expression systems, and novel gameplay experiences to reach new audiences.

Lead the forecasting, experimentation, and optimization of core performance funnels, including retention, monetization, and engagement.

Advanced analytical capabilities, including proficiency with Excel, SQL, and data modeling.

Ability to interpret complex data, extract insights, and translate them into actionable strategy.

Strategic thinker with a data-driven, results-oriented approach.

As one of the largest sports entertainment platforms in the world, EA SPORTS FC is redefining football with genre-leading interactive experiences, connecting a global community of fans to The World's Game through innovation and unrivaled authenticity.
With more opportunity than ever to design, innovate and create new, immersive experiences that bring joy, inclusivity, and connection to fans everywhere, we invite you to join our passionate and dynamic team as we pioneer the future of football fandom.
The EA SPORTS FC™ Mobile team is an international team, powered by global talent and looking for passionate new team members to work on one of the biggest sports games in the world.
Responsibilities:
The Assistant Producer of the Business Operations team will work closely with central organizations such as Publishing, Marketing, ASO, Legal & Release Management teams on behalf of the Development Team helping to manage & organize live event promotions, draft messaging for players and provide operational support to cross-functional teams. The ideal candidate will have production or design experience on a live service game & experience writing copy for in-game events or player-first communications. This person will work within the highly collaborative arm of the Business Operations team for FC Mobile, connecting the development studio (based in Shanghai) with the global marketing, publishing, social media & community on the world's biggest soccer/football game.
We're looking for someone with a passion for mobile free to play games and football/soccer. This role will involve co-ordination with remote teams and managing communications and promotions on the world's game, one of the most complex, yet rewarding global sports IPs.
As an assistant producer for the business operations team you will:
Work with the community management team to understand our users' needs & write critical in-game communications that serve our audience
Work with Fan Care teams, helping provide guidance on communications to provide information to fans & players
Draft engaging marketing copy that meets legal & licensing requirements, shows a clear understanding of the game & the value for users.
Review in-game copy for campaigns & tutorials, improving their quality & tone for an EN reading audience.
Work with interdisciplinary global teams to coordinate marketing deliverables and ensure their highest quality and success
Identify opportunities to grow our live operations services and tools, and work in collaboration with multiple partner groups.
You will report to the Business Operations Lead in Vancouver & partner global/regional teams in multiple time zones - including Shanghai, Australia & Singapore
Qualifications:
2+ years' experience working in games development or games social media as a social media manager, producer, game designer or equivalent
Communications experience - drafting copy for games in or a major social media account
A passion for global football/soccer & ability to discuss current teams & players in leagues such as the EPL, LALIGA or specific popular clubs.
Basic Photoshop skills, experience using the tool for social media is an asset.
Organizational skills, we expect you to be self-motivated and manage your priorities effectively
A passion for providing a safe, and inclusive environment for all team members
Ability to speak more than one language is an asset, please communicate which ones you speak or write fluently in your resume

Associate Producer - EA SPORTS FC™ Mobile, Business Operations
EA SPORTS ™
EA SPORTS ™ is one of the most iconic brands in entertainment with over 25 years of innovation, passion, and connecting millions of players across the globe to their favorite sports, teams, and players. EA Mobile is dedicated to creating high-quality mobile games connected to some of the world's biggest gaming franchises, with the current FIFA Mobile leading the way.
The EA SPORTS FC™ Mobile team is an international team, powered by global talent and looking for passionate new team members to help launch one world’s largest new brands on one the most actively played sports games in the world.
Responsibilities:
The Associate Producer of the Business Operations team will work closely with central organizations such as Publishing, Marketing, Product Management & Mobile Central Technologies on behalf of the Development Team helping to create roadmaps, drive priority and participate in value assessments of internal and external tools. The ideal candidate will have production or project management experience on a live service mobile game, experience working with engineering, pm, & marketing teams, and a passion for Football/Soccer.
We’re looking for someone with a passion for mobile games as a business and experience driving cross functional teams toward a high achieving outcome. This role will involve a lot of co-ordination with remote teams, located around the world on one of the biggest & most complex licensed IPs.
As an associate producer for the business operations team you will:
Work across interdisciplinary teams to coordinate deliverables and ensure their highest quality and success
Identify opportunities to grow our live operations services and tools, and work in collaboration with multiple partner groups towards implementation
Work with a global team to help drive & coordinate each release of EA SPORTS FC™ Mobile
Partner with internal teams to create value propositions, collect requirements & plan roadmaps for new tools and optimizations
Work with PM to craft estimates for business opportunities, follow up on their success against targets & draft plans for improvement.
Be a point of contact and strategist for global teams working on Ads & Sponsorships, Community, Publishing and Marketing
Develop successful partnerships with global/regional teams in multiple time zones - including Shanghai, Singapore, Indonesia & Australia
Help prepare & track App / Google Play Store assets as well as first party featuring assets for large global updates.
Collaborate with the business operations team and the development team on feature prioritization, production, and quality executions.
Provide clear and concise communication to the production team on emergent or ongoing executions as well as updates related to tools & services
Work closely with the community management team to understand our users, identify areas for improvement & help communicate their needs to product stakeholders.
Help translate the requirements gathered from user feedback, data, and market competition to drive business growth.

A minimum of 3+ years’ experience working in games development as a producer, marketing, product manager or equivalent

Experience leading cross functional teams on a live mobile game
Experience establishing clear communications between multiple teams, ensuring that actions and goals are completed on time and to quality expectations
Experience working with interdisciplinary experts, with the ability to consider and incorporate diverse perspectives and feedback
Experience in a leadership role and the ability to coordinate and drive a remote team to accomplish shared objectives
Preferred Skills:
The ideal candidate would have a love for global football & it’s stars and want to work on a product that celebrates them for players all over the world
Strong written and verbal communication skills (email, Slack, video calls, ppt). The associate producer will need to communicate with both internal and external teams
Leadership skills and the ability to drive actions and deliverables from conception to completion
Organizational skills, including the ability to self-motivate and manage your time and priorities effectively
Understanding of user experience on mobile with a “player first” mentality
An eye for detail, able to articulate value propositions, as well as identify risks and opportunities
A passion for providing a safe, and inclusive environment for all team members
Passion for working on the business side of mobile games, beyond game development

Commercial Management function within EA SPORTS operates across several primary responsibilities:
Team Ambassadorship: We are the voice to and from the broader Commercial Organization. We directly collaborate with Studio, Brand, and Finance partners on behalf of Commercial Teams. These teams represent partners, retailers, and players around the world.
Distribution Execution: Our full game experts ensure EA's games are available in the right place, at the right time, and at the right price. Meanwhile, live service experts drive the content side of our edition planning process, creating compelling and exciting offers for our players.
Revenue Responsibility - We guide how EA SPORTS titles interface with the forecast and planning process, ensuring title-specific forecasts work towards company-wide goals, then supporting teams as they pursue revenue targets
Growth Innovation - Both long-term and short-term, we brainstorm, propose and implement Commercial growth drivers. Consult and partner with Studio and Brand teams to unlock immediate, incremental opportunities and longer-term roadmaps to Franchise success
Strategy Creation - We use all of the above to create the Commercial portion of a product strategy, collaborating with Studio and Brand partners on their strategies to build an integrated, holistic approach
RESPONSIBILITIES:
This Individual Contributor role is part of the Commercial Activation team on FC, building collaborative relationships to improve growth and positive outcomes. You will report to the Director of Global Commercial Management. You will:
Commercial Planning and Activation:
Lead the development of the Commercial Chapter, outlining the annual Commercial and Executional Strategies for FC.
Collaborate with Marketing and Global Operations to develop platform strategies.
Provide commercial inputs into regional strategies and investments, ensuring alignment with franchise direction and priorities.
Ensure commercial readiness across assets, localization, metadata, and scheduling in partnership with Marketing, Brand, Studio, and regional teams.
1P and Partner Management:
Represent FC with first-party platform and store partners (e.g. Sony, Microsoft), ensuring terms, programs, and deliverables align with commercial targets and broader strategy.
Identify, assess, and execute licencing and merchandising opportunities to deliver incremental player engagement and revenue for FC.
QUALIFICATIONS:
5+ years of experience in a Commercial, Publishing, Strategy, or Product Management function, within sports, mobile, or video games.
Experience managing live service performance, with understanding of acquisition, engagement, and monetization KPIs across platforms.
Strong analytical and data-driven mindset, able to synthesize insights from multiple sources into deliverables, including executive business reviews and partner presentations.
Natural communicator and storyteller, with the ability to translate complex subjects into compelling, easy-to-understand narratives.
Experience developing and delivering high-impact commercial projects and programs that drive acquisition and revenue growth.
Experience building and managing complex commercial plans, coordinating across multiple departments and partners.
Experience working on a global product with global scope, altitude-switching from strategic, high-level thinking to highly detailed discussions.
Business degree or equivalent combination of education and experience.

Our Quality Verification and Standards (QVS) team is an integral part of our development process, consistently delivering actionable insights that support our game teams to optimize software performance and elevate gameplay. Their dedicated efforts ensure that we deliver cutting-edge entertainment experiences that captivate and inspire players and fans globally.
About Us: EA Sports FC is at the forefront of interactive football entertainment, committed to delivering unparalleled experiences to our global community of fans. We are looking for a visionary leader to support the driver for higher quality of our player experiences, ensuring our games not only meet but exceed expectations on all our platforms.
Role Overview: The Head of Product Experience, FC, will partner closely with senior production and creative leaders to ensure that all FC player experiences exceed player expectations, validated through large and small scale playtesting, research, competitive analysis and understanding the community . You will apply your in-depth knowledge of football (soccer) and game development to objectively evaluate experiential quality , ensuring gameplay, modes, and live services authentically reflect the sport, its culture, and evolving fan expectations across multiple platforms.
Key Responsibilities:
Lead, grow and evolve the Experiential Quality function within the FC franchise, building a team relentlessly focused on driving positive impact on quality and player experience.
Support the strategic planning and execution for new and current experiences within the EA Sports FC ecosystem. This involves understanding player needs and market trends to innovate and deliver compelling features and gameplay.
Work closely with the FC Product team to establish a quality assessment framework that translates player experience goals into actionable insights that feed back into the development process in a cohesive and streamlined manner.
Champion a rigorous, player-centric quality approach by leveraging research, player sentiment, and data to guide every decision about experiential quality.
Closely support execution and implementation of strategies designed to identify, acquire and engage new cohorts of players working with the Consumer Insights and the PX Research to expand the reach and appeal of EA Sports FC.
Collaborate effectively with cross-functional partner teams and contribute significantly to the broader Product Center to align experiential quality initiatives with overall business and product objectives.
Qualifications:
10+ years of game production, game design or game product leadership experience, with at least 5 years in a senior leadership role.
Past experience with football-related games and products strongly preferred.
Deep understanding of design thinking, user experience, and systems-level product development.
Influence-oriented. Excel at collaborating with other leaders such as Executive Producers and Lead Producers, guiding the collective group to the best action, decision, or result. You have experience working with creative leaders, UXR, marketing, and quality verification teams.
Strong track record of influencing executive stakeholders and leading cross-functional initiatives.
Experience working in fast-paced, high-growth environments.
Analytical mindset with hands-on experience with development tools, metrics, and risk management frameworks.
Excellent communication, negotiation, and leadership skills.

Senior Program Manager – Respawn Studios
Location: Vancouver, BC (Great Northern Way) / Hybrid
Organization: Respawn Entertainment (Electronic Arts)
Reports To: Head of Operations, Respawn Studios
Role Overview
Respawn Entertainment is looking for a Senior Program Manager to drive complex, interconnected strategic initiatives across our studio ecosystem. In this highly cross-functional role, you will partner with key leaders across internal game development disciplines—including Production, Technology, Art, and Product Management—as well as central Electronic Arts (EA) partner teams such as the CTO Organization, Talent Acquisition (TA), and Quality Verification & Services (QVS).
You will serve as an operational backbone for high-impact studio programs, initially focusing on AI Council Operations , Talent Recruiting & Resource Management Operations , and Outsourcing Vendor Operations . You will play a crucial role in bringing operational rigour, strategic alignment, and clear execution frameworks to help Respawn achieve its ambitious business and creative objectives.
Key Responsibilities
1. AI Council Operations & Governance
Program Leadership: Drive the operational cadence, roadmap execution, and agenda for Respawn’s AI Council, ensuring alignment with EA’s central AI initiatives (e.g., enterprise AI adoption and spend tracking).
Technology Adoption: Partner with central CTO teams and studio tech leadership to evaluate, deploy, and support internal AI and machine learning tools (including enterprise digital assistant frameworks and operational chargeback models).
Governance & Alignment: Establish clear workflows and policy guidelines for responsible AI usage across game teams, ensuring cross-discipline alignment between creative, technical, and legal stakeholders.
2. Talent Recruiting Operations
Respawn RMO Function: Setup and operate the Respawn Resource Management Organization (RMO) function to facilitate internal talent mobility initiatives and cross-studio staffing opportunities with other EA groups.
TA Partnership: Collaborate directly with EA Talent Acquisition and central enterprise partner teams to streamline recruitment & talent evaluation workflows and resolve hiring bottlenecks for high-priority franchise roles (e.g., specialized concept artists, technical leads, and core discipline directors).
Pipeline Optimization: Develop operational frameworks to track hiring velocity, forecast resourcing needs, and ensure studio leadership has visibility into key talent pipelines.
Onboarding & Operations: Enhance operational readiness for new talent integration across multi-studio projects and unique development team requirements.
3. Outsourcing Vendor & Partner Operations
Vendor Governance: Oversee operational frameworks and lifecycle management for external development vendors, co-development studios, and strategic technology partners.
Strategic Partnerships: Program manage external partner workstreams (such as live operations, technical integration, and collaborative workshops), ensuring clear scope delivery, SLAs, and integration with internal pipelines.
Financial & Contractual Tracking: Partner with finance and game team producers (ie. External Development Planning & Operations Manager) to oversee accurate vendor contracts, budget allocations, and performance evaluations.
4. Cross-Functional Execution & Stakeholder Alignment
Interconnected Initiatives: Program manage cross-cutting studio initiatives that bridge internal development teams (Production, Art, Tech, PM) and central EA partners (CTO, TA, QVS).
Executive Reporting & Communication: Deliver clear, concise executive updates, risk assessments, and status dashboards to studio leadership and enterprise partners.
Continuous Improvement: Continuously assess studio operational frameworks, identifying opportunities to standardize tools, reduce friction, and increase development throughput.
Qualifications
Experience: 8+ years of program management, project management, or operational leadership experience within the video game industry, technology sector, or complex creative environments.
Cross-Functional Leadership: Proven ability to lead by influence, build trust, and align diverse stakeholders ranging from creative directors and senior engineers to corporate central teams.
Operational Expertise: Demonstrated background in managing complex, multi-faceted operational programs such as vendor management, talent operations, resource management, or emerging technology integration.
Technical & Emerging Tech Familiarity: Understanding of game development lifecycles, game production pipelines, and enterprise AI tools/governance frameworks.
Communication: Exceptional verbal and written communication skills with experience presenting to senior executive leadership.
Problem Solving: Strong analytical, organizational, and risk-management capabilities with a bias for action in fast-paced environments.
Preferred Qualifications
Experience working within multi-studio game development frameworks or AAA franchise production environments.
Hands-on experience establishing governance programs, technology rollout plans, resource management/mobility functions, or strategic external partnership frameworks.
Familiarity with EA internal operational structures or similar large-scale publisher/studio operations.

lever:eqbank:ed06b95a-a20e-4a10-a8a5-fd7.description:
Join a Challenger At EQ, we're remaking banking so every Canadian gets ahead, every day. Serving nearly 4 million Canadians from coast to coast, we offer a wide variety of financial services from banking and lending, to trust and credit union solutions.  We've been at this since 1970, challenging the conventions of traditional banking with smarter, faster, and more connected financial experiences. What's kept us moving?  The people behind it all: challengers who ask better questions, push back on old assumptions, and look for a better way forward. If you're driven to help reshape how banking works for Canadians and the businesses that power our economy, this could be your next big opportunity.  We can’t wait to get to know you!  The Work   Reporting to the VP, Decumulation, the Director, Strategy, Risk & Business Operations is responsible for leading the strategic planning, business performance and enablement, governance, and risk management functions for the Reverse Mortgage and Insurance Lending business. Acting as the operational and strategic leader to the VP, Decumulation, this role ensures the business maintains a robust risk and control environment while delivering on growth, profitability, and customer objectives. The Director will oversee enterprise and business-specific risk activities including risk appetite monitoring, credit, operational, compliance, legal, conduct, model, and reputational risks. This leader will act as the primary liaison between the business and corporate Risk, Legal, Compliance, Finance, Audit, Governance and other business related risk functions such as Fraud Management while ensuring the business meets all regulatory, governance, and board reporting obligations. In addition, the Director will lead annual strategic planning, financial forecasting, business performance management, executive and Board reporting, KPI development, , enterprise initiatives, business enablement programs, and the development of new products and growth opportunities. The role requires a unique combination of strategic leadership, analytical rigor, operational execution, governance expertise, and cross-functional influence. The Core Responsibilities:

Strategic Planning & Business Performance

  • Support the development and execution of the annual business strategy, operating plan, and growth priorities for the Reverse Mortgage business.
  • Own business performance management, including KPI development, executive dashboards, forecasting, and financial modeling.
  • Drive strategic business initiatives and investment decisions through business cases, market analysis, profitability assessments and ongoing performance reporting. Lead the execution of initiatives as needed.
  • Key Metrics: Achievement of annual volume, revenue, and profitability targets, Strategic initiative delivery (% completed on time and on budget), KPI and reporting accuracy/timeliness

    • Risk Management & Governance

  • Own first-line risk management activities across credit, operational, compliance, legal, conduct, and reputational risk.
  • Act as the primary liaison between the business and Risk, Compliance, Legal, Audit, and other partners.
  • Lead program development activities such as a the corporate RCM program, risk assessments, issue remediation, governance activities, and committee submissions while ensuring compliance with risk appetite and regulatory requirements. Perform testing of business controls as needed.
  • Key Metrics: Number and severity of audit, compliance, or regulatory findings, completion of remediation actions within agreed timelines, business performance against approved risk appetite metrics.

    • Credit Risk, Portfolio Analytics & Model Governance

    • Oversee LTV model governance, portfolio monitoring, stress testing, and scenario analysis to support risk management and strategic decision-making.
    • Partner with Credit Risk and Finance teams to monitor portfolio performance, concentration risks, and emerging trends.
    • Lead development and reporting of portfolio, risk, and capital metrics for executive and Board audiences.
    • Key Metrics: Portfolio delinquency and loss performance versus plan, timeliness and accuracy of stress testing and scenario analysis, LTV model governance and validation compliance.

      • Executive, Board & Regulatory Reporting

      • Lead preparation of Board, Executive Committee, ERMC, and regulatory reporting packages.
      • Develop clear, data-driven insights and recommendations supporting strategic and risk-related decision-making.
      • Ensure reporting effectively communicates business performance, emerging risks, and mitigation actions.
      • Key Metrics: On-time delivery of Board and committee materials, stakeholder satisfaction with reporting quality and insights, number of material reporting errors or revisions.

        • Business Enablement & Transformation

        • Lead cross-functional business transformation and operational improvement initiatives that enhance scale, efficiency, and customer outcomes.
        • Establish governance frameworks to prioritize, monitor, and measure strategic project delivery.
        • Partner across Technology, Operations, Product, and Finance to remove barriers and accelerate execution. Identify and accelerate opportunities to leverage AI through the risk and all business functions.
        • Key Metrics: Benefits realized from business initiatives, project delivery on time and within budget.

          • New Product Development & Innovation

          • Lead strategic evaluation, business case development, and governance for new products and product enhancements.
          • Coordinate cross-functional assessments involving Risk, Finance, Credit, Legal, Compliance, Operations, and Technology.
          • Ensure new products meet profitability, customer, risk, and regulatory objectives.
          • Key Metrics: New product launches delivered on time, business case outcomes versus forecast, product profitability and adoption rates

            • People Leadership

            • Lead, develop, and coach a high-performing team responsible for strategy, risk, analytics, and business operations.
            • Foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
            • Build organizational capability in strategic planning, governance, data analytics, and risk management.
            • Key Metrics: Employee engagement scores, achievement of team performance objectives.
    Let's Talk About You:
    • Bachelor's degree in Business, Finance, Economics, Mathematics, or a related field.
    • 10+ years of progressive experience in strategy, risk management, business management, finance, consulting, or related leadership roles within financial services.
    • Ideally has a mix of Consulting and financial industry experience.
    • Deep understanding of credit risk, operational risk, compliance risk, governance frameworks, and financial services regulatory environments.
    • Experience preparing Executive Committee, Board, and Risk Committee materials.
    • Strong financial modeling, forecasting, and business case development experience.
    • Experience leading strategic planning and enterprise transformation initiatives.
    • Strong analytical skills with the ability to synthesize complex information into clear recommendations and actionable insights.
    • Exceptional stakeholder management skills with demonstrated ability to influence senior executives and cross-functional teams.
    • Advanced proficiency in data analysis, KPI development, dashboard creation, and performance management.
    • Excellent written, verbal, and presentation communication skills.

lever:eqbank:c40c0c17-1c33-4a69-8a82-0b8.description:
Purpose of the Job:  The Lead, Program Governance & Enablement is an individual contributor role within the Integration Management Office (IMO). Working directly with the Senior Director, Program Management, the incumbent plays a key role in driving integration execution, governance effectiveness, and delivery outcomes across the program.  The role is responsible for leading assigned integration workstreams, initiatives, and cross-functional deliverables while also providing governance, reporting, and program management support across the broader integration. The incumbent works with stakeholders across business and corporate functions to drive milestones, manage risks, issues, dependencies, decisions, and actions, and help remove blockers that may impact program delivery.  In addition, the role brings together information from across the program to produce executive materials, governance reporting, and actionable insights for leadership decision-making. The role works closely with senior leaders, workstream owners, and delivery teams to ensure integration commitments are progressing as planned and that emerging issues are identified and addressed promptly.  The role provides broad exposure across the integration, including the Executive Steering Committee, IMO All Hands, leadership updates, the integration program management platform, and consolidated reporting on contracts, Transition Service Agreements, synergies, and benefits.  The role suits an organized, analytically strong individual who can structure problems, work through ambiguity, influence stakeholders, and drive outcomes in a complex environment. Relevant experience may come from management consulting, a Big Four firm, an internal strategy or transformation team, program management, or another demanding environment requiring structured problem-solving, stakeholder management, and executive communication. Main Activities: :
Integration Workstream Leadership
Lead complex integration workstreams and cross-functional initiatives, ensuring milestones, dependencies, risks, and deliverables remain on track.
Partner across business, technology, risk, legal, and operations teams to drive execution and resolve issues.
Provide status updates, recommendations and escalations to leadership while ensuring accountability for outcomes.
 
Executive Materials & Communications
Create executive-level presentations, reports, and governance materials for leadership and steering committees.
Translate complex or evolving information into clear, concise, and decision-focused narratives.
Leverage AI tools to accelerate research, content development and reporting while ensuring quality, accuracy and consistency.
 
Program Governance & Coordination
Coordinate governance processes, meeting materials, timelines, and executive submissions across the integration program.
Track decisions, outcomes, actions, and follow-up activities to ensure effective execution.
Serve as a key partner to program leadership, supporting strategic priorities, executive requests, and operational effectiveness.
 
Program Management Platform & Reporting
Manage and enhance the integration program management platform to improve visibility and collaboration.
Develop dashboards, reporting views, and executive summaries covering milestones, risks, dependencies, and program performance.
Drive automation and AI-enabled reporting solutions to improve efficiency and data quality.
 
RAID, Dependency, Decision & Action Management
Maintain centralized tracking of risks, assumptions, issues, dependencies, decisions, and actions across the program.
Monitor ownership, timelines, blockers, and escalation requirements to support timely resolution.
Provide clear exception reporting and insights to support leadership decision-making and governance.
 
Contracts, TSAs, Synergies & Benefits Reporting
Consolidate and report on contracts, Transition Service Agreements (TSAs), synergies, benefits, and value-capture initiatives.
Partner with Finance, Legal, Procurement, Technology, and delivery teams to gather and align program updates.
Highlight risks, gaps, dependencies, and integration impacts while supporting accurate enterprise-level reporting.
:

Skills & Knowledge

  • Strong problem-solving, analytical, organizational, and stakeholder management skills.
  • Advanced PowerPoint and executive communication capabilities, with the ability to translate complex information into clear, decision-focused narratives.
  • Experience with program governance, RAID and dependency management, dashboards, structured data, and AI-enabled research, analysis, and reporting.
  • Sound judgment, attention to detail, and the ability to influence, navigate ambiguity, and drive actions to completion.

    • Education & Experience

  • 5+ years of experience in program management, transformation, consulting, strategy, governance, integration management, or related fields.
  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Commerce, Finance, Strategy, Technology, or a related discipline.
  • Proven experience developing executive-level presentations, management reporting, and coordinating complex, cross-functional initiatives.
  • Advanced proficiency in Microsoft PowerPoint, Excel, and Microsoft 365; experience in consulting, transformations, integrations, financial services, TSAs, contracts, synergies, or benefits reporting is an asset.

    • What Success Looks Like

  • Deliver high-quality executive, governance, and All Hands materials accurately and on schedule.
  • Maintain reliable program reporting across milestones, RAID items, dependencies, decisions, actions, and blockers.
  • Ensure contract, TSA, synergy, and benefits reporting is consolidated, aligned, and linked to program outcomes.
  • Proactively identify risks, gaps, overdue actions, and escalation needs while improving efficiency through automation, templates, and AI.

At Expedia Group, we help travelers explore the world, one journey at a time. As a global travel company powered by passionate people, trusted partnerships, and leading technology, we connect travelers, partners, and advertisers through our consumer brands, B2B network, and travel advertising business.

 Here, you'll do meaningful work that helps millions of people discover, book, and experience travel with more ease, confidence, and joy. Our five Behaviors-Traveler First, Think Big, Operate with Excellence, Ownership Mindset, and Succeed Together-help foster a supportive environment where people can grow their careers and have the flexibility, benefits, and support to do their best work. Join us and build for travelers everywhere.

 Program Manager II, AI & Productivity 

 Please note : Role must be based in Vancouver. Relocation support not available for this role.   

 Introduction to the team 

 Expedia Group B2B connects partners across the travel industry to our leading technology, supply, and services - helping them deliver seamless travel experiences to their customers. From airlines and hotels to financial institutions and other travel platforms, we power smarter, faster, and more impactful travel solutions through the most connected marketplace in the world.

 Expedia Cruises is seeking a Program Manager II, AI & Productivity to identify and implement opportunities to improve how we work through AI, automation, and emerging technologies across the cruise and travel business. You’ll examine existing workflows, including legacy technology and manual processes, to simplify work, improve productivity, and modernize our operations for the future. This is a highly hands-on role focused on building and implementing practical AI solutions, while also championing AI adoption across our corporate teams.

 In this role, you will : 

- Identify and prioritize opportunities to use AI and automation, spending regular time with internal teams to understand workflows and pain points firsthand and shape what gets built and in what order. 

- Analyze existing workflows, legacy technology, and manual processes to identify opportunities to automate, simplify, or modernize. 

- Design, build, and implement practical AI solutions, including document processing, data extraction, email workflows, summarization, and other repetitive activities. 

- Build and deploy solutions using LLMs and agentic workflows (e.g., prompt engineering, RAG, multi-step automation) to solve real business problems. 

- Evaluate and maximize AI capabilities within existing enterprise software and licensed platforms, while identifying emerging technologies that can deliver value. 

- Take solutions from pilot to scaled rollout, managing timelines, communications, and change management to drive adoption -- iterating based on real usage and feedback. 

- Track the impact of AI initiatives against clear metrics, and keep stakeholders informed on progress and results. 

- Partner with business and Technology teams to implement, scale, and troubleshoot AI initiatives, coordinating across teams as needed to keep work moving. 

- Serve as an AI champion across the corporate organization through training, coaching, demonstrations, and practical guidance 

 Experience and Qualifications: 

- 5+ years of experience in program management, process improvement, automation, technology, or a related field. 

- Hands-on experience building with LLMs and agentic workflows (e.g., prompt engineering, multi-step automation) to solve real business problems. 

- Experience designing, building, and implementing AI-powered solutions, workflows, or automations. 

- Strong understanding of AI tools, emerging technologies, and their practical business applications.  

- Strong analytical, problem-solving, and process improvement skills. 

- Comfortable working across teams and functions to get things done, with strong communication skills to train and advocate for AI adoption. 
 #LI-AD1

The total cash range for this position in Vancouver is $95,000.00 to $133,000.00. Employees in this role have the potential to increase their pay up to $152,000.00, which is the top of the range, based on ongoing, demonstrated, and sustained performance in the role.

 Starting pay for this role will vary based on multiple factors, including location, available budget, and an individual’s knowledge, skills, and experience. Pay ranges may be modified in the future.

 Benefits and perks 
 Expedia Group offers benefits and perks designed to support employees and their families, including medical, dental, and vision coverage, paid time off, an Employee Assistance Program, wellness and travel reimbursement, travel discounts, and International Airlines Travel Agent Network (IATAN) membership. Learn more about life at Expedia Group at https://careers.expediagroup.com/life .

 Expedia Group is committed to providing an inclusive and accessible recruiting experience. If you need an accommodation or adjustment due to a disability during the application or recruiting process, please submit a request at https://expedia.service-now.com/askeg?id=job_accommodation .

 About Expedia Group 
 Expedia Group includes three flagship consumer brands - Expedia, Hotels.com, and Vrbo - along with a leading B2B travel business and travel advertising offerings. Across our brands and business, we help travelers explore the world with confidence and ease.

 Important notice 
 Employment opportunities and job offers at Expedia Group will always come from Expedia Group's Talent Acquisition and hiring teams. Never share sensitive personal information unless you are confident of the recipient. Expedia Group does not extend job offers via email or messaging tools to individuals with whom we have not made prior contact. Our email domain is @expediagroup.com. The official place to find and apply for roles is https://careers.expediagroup.com/jobs/ .

 Equal Opportunity 
Expedia is committed to creating an inclusive work environment with a diverse workforce. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. This employer participates in E-Verify. The employer will provide the Social Security Administration (SSA) and, if necessary, the Department of Homeland Security (DHS) with information from each new employee's I-9 to confirm work authorization.

greenhouse:faire:8864857002.description:
About Faire 

 Faire is a technology wholesale platform built on the belief that the future is local. Independent retailers around the globe collectively represent a multi-hundred-billion-dollar wholesale market that has historically been fragmented and offline. At Faire, we're using the power of tech, data, and machine learning to connect this thriving community of entrepreneurs across the globe. Picture your favorite boutique in town — we help them discover the best products from around the world to sell in their stores. With the right tools and insights, we believe that we can level the playing field so businesses can grow and local communities can thrive.

 We’re looking for smart, resourceful and passionate people to join us as we power the shop local movement. If you believe in community, come join ours.

 About the Role 

 We're looking for Product Managers to sit at the nexus of design, engineering, data science, strategy and go-to-market, partnering closely across those functions and with founders and senior leadership to shape decisions that move Faire forward.

 You’ll own a significant area of the roadmap, deeply understand the customers you build for, and execute with an eye toward impact.

 We hire role agnostic, first assessing your fit for Faire through the interview process and then matching you to the role, team and problem space where you’ll have the greatest impact, based on your experience, skills and interest.

 You’ll be aligned to one of these pillars:

 Retailer Growth focuses on making Faire’s retailers more successful by acquiring, activating, and retaining more retailers, ultimately driving demand and deeper engagement with the marketplace.⁠

 Brand drives Faire’s supply side — acquiring new brands, building tooling to help them run their businesses, partnering with them to maximize their growth and success on Faire, and ensuring quality of the marketplace.

 Discovery focuses on the core shopping experience — helping retailers find the right products and brands through search, recommendations, ads, and exploration while balancing marketplace dynamics.

 Value makes Faire the best place for independent retailers to buy , building programs that take cost and friction out of sourcing inventory: membership discounts, flexible financing, a fulfillment network enabling lower minimums and faster and cheaper shipping, and simpler inventory workflows behind every order.

 Ads helps brands succeed on Faire by putting them in control of their growth through paid placement. The team builds effective advertising products that accelerate brands’ wholesale growth while connecting retailers with relevant products.⁠

 What you’ll do 

- Own strategy and roadmap for your product area. Set the multi-year direction for how current and future products evolve and build the prioritized roadmap to get there.

- Own specific goals and outcomes. You will be responsible for specific product outcomes and goals all designed to drive meaningful growth for the marketplace.

- Own the unit economics for your product. Know the levers that drive your product's growth and margin.

- Partner deeply across Design, Data Science, Strategy & Analytics, Go-To-Market, Operations and Engineering. Earn trust across functions, lead without authority, and keep complex, multi-stakeholder work moving without losing momentum.

- Communicate clearly at every altitude. Translate complex, technical topics for a wide range of audiences, from engineering partners to senior leadership.

 What we’re looking for, across levels: 

- 4+ years of product management experience (years of experience requirements scale with level, see below), with demonstrated ability to own complex, cross-functional products end to end.

- Strategic clarity with hands-on execution. You can zoom out and develop a defensible multi-year point of view, then zoom back in to write crisp requirements, drive execution, and unblock your team.

- High learning velocity and analytical rigor. You define the metrics that matter, size the opportunity before you commit to it, and use data to drive decisions.

- Customer empathy and strong design sense. You deeply understand how retailers and brands run their businesses and what makes them trust a platform like ours. You are skilled at designing thoughtful and delightful experiences that solve customer needs.

- Structured problem solving. You break ambiguous problems into clear hypotheses, don't mistake activity for progress, and diagnose root causes rather than escalate.

- Cross-functional influence across Design, Engineering, Data Science, Strategy & Analytics, and Go to Market, and a track record of aligning diverse stakeholders while maintaining momentum.

- Proven ability to influence at the executive level and to communicate complex topics with clarity and conviction across audiences.

- AI fluency. You use AI tools to accelerate problem solving, solution definition, and analysis; you are comfortable getting hands on building prototypes and using AI to accelerate decision-making.

- Marketplace experience is a strong plus — particularly familiarity with two-sided dynamics and competing customer objectives.

 Levels we're hiring for 

 We hire generalist PMs across the following levels. Your final level and team will be determined through the interview process based on your experience and our current openings.

 Senior Product Manager - 4+ years of product management experience

 Staff Product Manager - 7+ years of product management experience

 Principal Product Manager -   10+ years of product management experience

 Salary Range 

 Senior Product Manager:

- San Francisco, CA/New York City, NY: The pay range for this role is $188,000 - 258,500 USD

- Toronto, ON: The pay range for this role is $148,000 - 203,500 CAD

 Staff Product Manager:

- San Francisco, CA/New York City, NY: The pay range for this role is $220,000 - 302,000 USD

- Toronto, ON: The pay range for this role is $184,000 - 253,000 CAD

 Principal Product Manager

- San Francisco, CA/New York City, NY: The pay range for this role is $260,000 - 357,500 USD

- Toronto, ON: The pay range for this role is $212,000 - 291,500 CAD

 This role will also be eligible for equity and benefits. Actual base pay will be determined based on permissible factors, including transferable skills, work experience, market demand, and primary work location. The base pay range provided is subject to change and may be modified in the future.
 Hybrid Faire employees currently go into the office 3 days per week on Tuesdays, Thursdays, and a third flex day of their choosing (Monday, Wednesday, or Friday). Additionally, hybrid in-office roles will have the flexibility to work remotely up to 4 weeks per year. Specific Workplace and Information Technology positions may require onsite attendance 5 days per week as will be indicated in the job posting. 

 Why you’ll love working at Faire 

- Move fast: You'll own meaningful problems that serve customers around the globe with the agency to move fast and see your results clearly.

- Equipped to scale: We invest in what matters, including the latest enterprise AI tools, to help you work smarter and get more out of every day.

- Best in class: Our team is full of sharp, kind, and generous colleagues who care about their craft and about helping you grow in yours.

- Real rewards. Competitive pay, equity, and comprehensive benefits designed to support your life inside and outside of work.

- Belonging: We're intentional about building an environment where every Faire employee has equal access to opportunities, growth, and success.

 Faire was founded in 2017 by a team of early product and engineering leads from Square. We’re backed by some of the top investors in retail and tech including: Y Combinator, Lightspeed Venture Partners, Forerunner Ventures, Khosla Ventures, Sequoia Capital, Founders Fund, and DST Global. We have headquarters in San Francisco and Kitchener-Waterloo, and a global employee presence across offices in Toronto, London, and New York. To learn more about Faire and our customers, you can read more on our blog .

 Faire provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, genetics, sexual orientation, gender identity or gender expression.

 Faire is committed to providing access, equal opportunity and reasonable accommodation for individuals with disabilities in employment, its services, programs, and activities. Accommodations are available throughout the recruitment process and applicants with a disability may request to be accommodated throughout the recruitment process. We will work with all applicants to accommodate their individual accessibility needs.  To request reasonable accommodation, please fill out our Accommodation Request Form ( https://bit.ly/faire-form) 

 Privacy 

 For information about the type of personal data Faire collects from applicants, as well as your choices regarding the data collected about you, please visit Faire’s Privacy Notice (https://www.faire.com/privacy)

dayforce:fieldeffect:695.description:
Field Effect is helping organizations around the world strengthen their cybersecurity posture through powerful, accessible solutions that simplify the complexity of cyber risk.
As we continue to grow, we're looking for a Director of Product Marketing to shape how we bring our products to market, tell our story, and help customers understand the value we deliver. This is a highly strategic role that sits at the intersection of our technical and go-to-market teams.
You'll be responsible for defining market positioning, leading go-to-market programs, driving competitive and market intelligence, supporting revenue growth through sales enablement, and ensuring our voice in the market remains differentiated and compelling.
What You'll Do:

Own product positioning, messaging, and value propositions across Field Effect's cybersecurity solutions.
Lead market research and competitive intelligence initiatives, gathering insights on customer needs, market trends, buyer behaviour, pricing, and the competitive landscape.
Develop and execute go-to-market strategies for new products, features, and strategic initiatives.
Act as the bridge between technical and go-to-market teams, delivering alignment across stakeholders, and ensuring product innovation is translated into differentiated market positioning, compelling customer messaging, and measurable business results.
Serve as the voice of the customer and market across the organization, helping shape how products are positioned, communicated, and brought to market.
Drive sales enablement initiatives, including battlecards, sales playbooks, solution briefs, presentations, and training programs that support pipeline growth and revenue generation.
Lead analyst relations and market influence programs to strengthen Field Effect's visibility and positioning within the cybersecurity industry.
Collaborate across Product, Research & Development, Marketing, Sales, and Customer Success teams to ensure consistent messaging and successful product launches.
Measure and communicate the impact of product marketing programs on awareness, pipeline, adoption, and revenue.
Build and scale product marketing processes, programs, and team capabilities as the organization grows.

Skills & Experience We Look For:

Deep cybersecurity industry expertise, with a strong understanding of the threat landscape, cybersecurity technologies, buyers, and market trends.
10+ years of experience in Product Marketing or related marketing leadership roles within cybersecurity organizations.
15+ years working in or alongside cybersecurity analysts or other technical cybersecurity roles.
Experience within an EDR, MDR, XDR, or adjacent cybersecurity vendor, with a strong understanding of selling to mid-market and enterprise organizations through both direct and channel-led motions, including MSPs and VARs.
Demonstrated success developing product positioning, messaging, and go-to-market strategies for cybersecurity products and solutions.
Demonstrated ability to influence business outcomes through product positioning, market strategy, sales enablement, and go-to-market execution.
Ability to translate complex technical concepts into clear, compelling customer value and business outcomes.
Experience partnering closely with technical and go-to-market teams, translating deeply technical concepts for personas and stakeholders of varied technical backgrounds.
Strong understanding of market research, competitive intelligence, sales enablement, and product launch execution.
Exceptional written, verbal, presentation, and storytelling skills.
Advanced stakeholder management skills, with a detailed approach to documentation and communication across internal teams to deepen alignment.
Fluent in using AI for Product Marketing workflows; you should be comfortable using Claude Cowork or Microsoft Copilot in your day to day, and adopting new tooling as needed.
Bachelor’s degree in marketing, business, communications, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.

Why Join Field Effect?

Be part of a company creating real impact by helping organizations identify, prioritize, and reduce cybersecurity risk.
Collaborate with some of the industry's leading cybersecurity experts, researchers, and software developers.
Shape how innovative cybersecurity solutions are positioned, communicated, and brought to market.
Influence business growth and market strategy at a pivotal stage in the company's evolution.
Operate with autonomy and accountability in a high-trust, results-oriented environment.
Work flexibly in ways that fit your life and help you perform at your best, with benefits and rewards that matter.
When we ask employees what makes Field Effect special, the answer is almost always the same: the people. We hire talented individuals who are not only great at what they do, but great to work with.

If this sounds exciting, we would love to hear from you! Please note that only the candidate(s) selected for the next phase of the hiring process will be contacted directly. 
Field Effect is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants are given consideration regardless of race, religion, colour, gender, sex, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, marital status, citizenship status, disability, veteran status, or any other protected class as provided in applicable employment laws. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please contact us.    
About Us:  
Field Effect is a global cybersecurity company on a mission to make intelligence-grade protection accessible to organizations of all sizes. Our managed detection and response platform combines advanced technology with expert insight to help businesses identify risks early, respond quickly, and stay ahead of evolving threats.
Founded by world-class experts, we take a practical, streamlined approach, building intuitive tools and delivering human expertise that helps organizations strengthen their security without added complexity.
We’re building a collaborative, high-performing team that values curiosity, accountability, and continuous improvement. Field Effect has been recognized as one of Canada’s Top 100 Small and Medium Employers and a top employer in Ottawa.

This posting reflects a current, actively recruited opening at Float. All applications are being reviewed on a rolling basis.



ABOUT FLOAT

Float is on a mission to simplify finance for Canadian businesses, empowering them to eliminate complexity and unlock new opportunities. Through our innovative platform, Float enables businesses to streamline financial operations and optimize cash flow, so they can focus on what matters most: growth. 

 

As one of Canada’s fastest growing companies https://www.theglobeandmail.com/business/rob-magazine/top-growing-companies/article-ranking-canadas-top-growing-companies-of-2024/ and top-rated startups in 2025 https://www.linkedin.com/posts/floatfinancial_were-proud-to-share-that-float-has-been-activity-7387093684720300032-2DDz/, 2024 https://www.linkedin.com/pulse/linkedin-top-startups-2024-15-canadian-companies-rise-linkedin-news-llihe/ and 2023 https://lnkd.in/TSU23CA, Float is customer-obsessed, passionate and entrepreneurial, with a team that includes leaders from Uber, Stripe, Shopify, Top Hat, Ada, Doordash, Snowflake, and Wealthsimple.

 

At Float, everyone is an owner, bringing their unique perspective to our team and product. Your voice is important, and we take having a culture based on feedback seriously. We openly share our thoughts and differing opinions so we can continue to improve. We do our best to keep our decision-making decentralized so that all team members feel ownership in our success.

 


OUR PRODUCT

Float is Canada’s intelligent financial operating system, combining modern financial services and software to help businesses spend, save, and grow. Trusted by more than 10,000 Canadian companies, Float provides high-limit corporate cards, automated expense management, next-day bill payments, high-yield accounts, and industry-leading support, all built in Canada, for Canada. Float recently announced our $85 million Series C https://floatfinancial.com/press/float-financial-raises-cad-85-million-series-c, and is backed by world-class investors, including Inovia Capital, Growth Equity at Goldman Sachs Alternatives, OMERS Ventures, and Silicon Valley Bank.

 

Our team is a collection of ambitious, collaborative and mission-driven people from all walks of life but with one goal: helping Canadian companies not just survive but thrive. And we’re looking for bold innovators to help shape the future of business finance in Canada.




AI USE IN OUR HIRING PROCESS

We use technology, including artificial intelligence (AI), to support parts of our hiring process. This may include AI-assisted scheduling and candidate communications, and AI-generated interview notes, guides or summaries to help our team focus on the conversation. All hiring decisions are made by our hiring team.




ABOUT THE ROLE

We’re hiring a Head of Product Marketing to lead the function responsible for helping customers understand, adopt, and get more value from Float’s growing multi-product platform across the full customer journey. You’ll report to the SVP GTM Strategy & Marketing and lead a team spanning product marketing, lifecycle marketing, and customer marketing, with a mandate that spans acquisition, launch support, product adoption and usage.



This is a high-impact role at the core of the business. It offers the opportunity to refine Float’s product narrative, strengthen adoption across the customer lifecycle, and enable Product, Sales, Customer Success, and Marketing to more effectively communicate and deliver the platform’s value.




WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Refine Float’s positioning and messaging so the multi-product platform story lands clearly across target audiences and ongoing launches.

 - Build pre- and post-sale programs that improve product adoption and help customers realize more value across the customer journey.

 - Partner with Product on launches, readiness, and activation so new products and features translate into customer understanding and usage.

 - Equip Sales, Customer Success, and Marketing with messaging, playbooks, collateral, and activation tools that improve field effectiveness and adoption outcomes.

 - Build customer programs such as advocacy and advisory motions that strengthen product adoption and the broader commercial flywheel.

 - Use data, experimentation, and customer insight to evolve positioning, lifecycle strategy, and adoption programs over time.

 - Lead and develop a high-performing team with high standards for ownership, clarity, speed, and modern AI-enabled workflows.




ABOUT YOU


HERE’S WHAT SETS YOU UP FOR SUCCESS AT FLOAT: 

 - You Put Customers First, Always. You anchor strategy in real customer pain, understanding, and value realization. You care about whether customers actually adopt and use what the business builds.

 - You Act Like an Owner. You are comfortable owning outcomes, not just functions. You make hard prioritization calls, move quickly in ambiguity, and do what is best for the business.

 - You Think Big and Move Fast. You can shape the longer-term product narrative while still building the systems, playbooks, and programs that move adoption now.

 - You Constantly Learn and Grow. You are a strong market sensor who updates positioning, messaging, and strategy as evidence changes. You are practical and curious about how AI can improve leverage and quality in your work.

 - You Raise the Bar. You hold a high quality threshold for strategy, execution, and talent. You do not settle for polished activity that does not move the business.

 - You Win as a Team. You build trust and clarity across Product, Sales, CS, and Marketing. You can influence without authority and make cross-functional work better, not heavier.




IN ADDITION TO LIVING OUR VALUES...

 - 8+ years of relevant experience across product marketing, customer marketing, lifecycle, enablement, monetization, or adjacent growth work in B2B SaaS, fintech, or transaction-based businesses, with meaningful leadership scope.

 - Direct ownership of measurable outcomes such as acquisition, adoption, expansion, retention, competitive performance, enablement uptake, or other commercial metrics.

 - Strong product marketing craft across positioning, messaging, launches, enablement, and customer / field activation, with evidence that your work changed behavior or results.

 - Experience building systems, not just campaigns including pre-sale and post-sale motions that helped internal teams and customers understand what to do next.

 - Data fluency and experimentation discipline with comfort using analytics, research, and operating judgment to refine strategy over time.

 - Practical AI workflow integration with examples of using AI to accelerate research, synthesis, experimentation, or content iteration while keeping judgment human-led.

 - Leadership and cross-functional credibility with a track record of coaching teams, aligning stakeholders, and raising the quality bar around you.




THIS MAY NOT BE THE ROLE FOR YOU IF:

 - You have strong launch or PMM experience but little direct accountability for acquisition, adoption, expansion, retention, or other measurable business outcomes.

 - You prefer well-established playbooks and stable scope over ambiguity, experimentation, and building new systems from scratch.

 - You are highly strategic but do not enjoy driving execution details, enablement, or cross-functional follow-through.

 - You struggle with direct feedback, healthy conflict, or high-ownership team environments.

 - You are not data-fluent or do not use evidence to sharpen priorities and programs over time.

 - You treat AI as optional, superficial, or someone else’s job rather than a meaningful source of leverage in modern GTM work.




OUR HIRING PHILOSOPHY

We hire for character, curiosity, and learning velocity before credentials. Titles matter less than impact, and every hire is expected to raise the bar for Float as a whole.




WHY YOU SHOULD JOIN

 - Work at one of Canada's fastest-growing fintech companies

 - Make a real impact in a high-autonomy, high-growth role

 - Collaborate with an ambitious and supportive team

 - Competitive compensation, equity options, and benefits

 - Hybrid work model – we are based in Toronto with in-office days for connection and collaboration

 - Enjoy catered team lunches every Tuesday, Wednesday and Thursday

 - Bring your pup to our dog-friendly office

 - Thrive in a high-trust, high-performance culture where your work truly matters

 


IN SHORT

At Float, you’ll thrive if you’re bold, curious, and eager to make a real impact. We're building something special—and having a lot of fun along the way. If you’re excited to build, grow, and win together, we’d love to meet you.

 

We’re committed to building a workplace that’s welcoming and accessible for everyone. If you need any accommodations during the hiring process or once you join Float, just let us know! You can reach out to Vic https://www.linkedin.com/in/victoria-boult-b21b2053/ (victoria@floatfinancial.com), and we’ll work with you to make sure you have what you need to succeed.

ABOUT THE ROLE

Float is building the future of Canadian financial services — scaling a credit business powered by modern, innovative underwriting and monitoring infrastructure that will unlock new digital-first credit and financial products for Canadian businesses. Fraud detection, AML compliance, payments operations, and dispute resolution already run on this decisioning backbone today. What’s missing is a single owner. 



As the founding Product Manager for Credit & Risk Engineering, you’ll turn this shared decisioning and monitoring layer into a truly owned product: fast, accurate, and relentlessly efficient as volume scales. You’ll sit at the intersection of Float’s credit roadmap and growth funnel, sequencing a small engineering team across real infrastructure debt and a flagship new build — the FlexLine decisioning engine — while ensuring the systems you own keep Float’s day-to-day risk operations safe and scalable.




WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Own the roadmap and sequencing for the Credit & Risk Engineering squad across three domains — starting with the trade-off between paying down risk infrastructure debt and building the FlexLine decisioning engine.

 - Own the decisioning and automation systems that drive KYB/KYC approval speed and accuracy, delivered so Float's risk operations team can hit its approval-time targets.

 - Own the tooling behind fraud detection, AML compliance, payments operations, and dispute resolution — daily infrastructure the company already depends on.

 - Own risk decision operating cost per account as your team's primary efficiency metric, proving the systems scale without proportional headcount growth.

 - Own the in-app credit experiences — applying for credit, viewing balances and limits, setting up repayments — and their target speed, in support of Float's credit product roadmap.

 - Be the standing source of truth on where the credit product roadmap ends and credit-engineering scope begins, in ongoing partnership with the GM of Credit.




ABOUT YOU
