Mastercard Identity is seeking a Manager, Product Management to support key areas of the Account Protection portfolio, contributing to the development of a trusted intelligence layer that enables persistent defense across the full lifecycle of an account—from onboarding through monitoring, recovery, and investigation.
Mastercard Identity, within the Security Solutions organization, leads the development of products and services that enable global commerce, power financial inclusion, prevent crime, and deliver seamless digital experiences. As part of Mastercard Identity, the Account Protection team supports the development and management of products, programs, and services focused on account risk management—both pre- and post-onboarding—addressing critical threats such as account takeover, synthetic identity fraud, and mule activity.
The Manager of Product Management, Account Protection plays a key role in Mastercard’s Identity team by contributing to the development of scalable, interoperable solutions that help businesses securely identify and trust consumer accounts across digital ecosystems. This role supports product development, execution, and commercialization of Account Protection solutions powered by network-scale identity data, risk signals, and intelligence.
The Manager partners closely with product leaders and cross-functional teams—including engineering, data science, privacy, commercialization, and legal—to support product development, define requirements, and help ensure products are market ready. Through customer insights, analysis, and execution support, this role helps deliver Account Protection solutions that improve security outcomes, mitigate fraud risk, and support commercial objectives aligned with Mastercard Identity’s strategy.

The Role
- Support the execution of Account Protection products across the account lifecycle
- Contribute to product roadmap development, prioritization, and business case inputs
- Identify and analyze expansion opportunities across monitoring, recovery, modification, and investigation phases
- Support the product lifecycle, including discovery, definition, build, launch, and iteration
- Define and document product requirements and data needs in partnership with Engineering and Data Science
- Engage with customers (issuers, fintechs, platforms) to gather feedback and validate product features

- Support go-to-market efforts, including product positioning, sales enablement, and customer discussions

- Support innovation efforts to enhance fraud detection and account security capabilities
- Collaborate with stakeholders to align on priorities, timelines, and deliverables
Support adoption efforts through API integrations, partnerships, and regional rollouts

All About You

- Foundational understanding of account lifecycle risk (onboarding through monitoring and recovery)

- Solid analytical and problem-solving abilities
- Clear written and verbal communication skills, with ability to build relationships with stakeholders
- Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint, and Word

- Working knowledge of identity, digital payments, and security landscape is a plus

ABOUT MECKA AI

Mecka AI is building the data infrastructure layer for robotics and embodied AI.
We design and operate global systems for data capture, data labeling, and hardware-enabled workflows used by leading AI labs and robotics companies to train and validate humanoid and embodied AI systems.
We work closely with frontier robotics teams to bridge real-world data, simulation, learning-based systems, and deployed hardware.

The Role
You'll turn data requirements into capture programs that work across devices, operators, and locations. You will lead the execution that lets Mecka expand real-world data collection while meeting demanding standards for quality and delivery. The role connects engineering decisions to the realities of recording in the field. That means validating pilots, understanding what makes output usable, and building plans that hold up as operations grow.

What You'll Do

 - Turn dataset requirements into capture programs with clear quality standards, capacity plans, and delivery milestones.

 - Coordinate device availability, operator training, recording capacity, and data review across a program.

 - Plan and validate pilot captures before expanding operations.

 - Investigate data-quality issues with engineering and operations teams, and verify that corrective actions work.

 - Use measured capacity and data acceptance rates to forecast delivery, identify risks, and adjust the plan.

What You Bring
Must-have:

 - Experience delivering technical programs that combine hardware, software, and field operations.

 - Ability to build practical schedules, map dependencies, and resolve technical blockers across teams.

 - Understanding of sensor data, calibration, synchronization, and common recording failures.

 - Skill in analyzing throughput, quality, capacity, and cost using spreadsheets, queries, or scripts.

 - Ability to inspect recordings and diagnostic logs, ask precise engineering questions, and verify that a fix works.

 - Clear written communication, including operating procedures, technical decisions, and realistic delivery forecasts.

Nice-to-have:

 - Experience with robotics datasets or recording programs involving several sensor types.

 - Experience improving operator workflows or automating data-quality checks.


A NOTE ON APPLYING

Studies show women and candidates from underrepresented groups often only apply when they meet 100% of the listed qualifications, while others apply after meeting 60%. If you don't check every box above but believe you can do the job, we encourage you to apply — we're looking for capability and trajectory, not a perfect checklist match.

We are committed to creating an inclusive and supportive candidate experience. Should you require any accommodation whatsoever during the interview process, please inform us without any hesitation. Mecka is dedicated to ensuring equal treatment and opportunity in all phases of recruitment, selection, and employment, in compliance with employment law. Mecka is proud to be an equal opportunity employer, fostering a culture of inclusivity and maintaining a work environment that is free from discrimination, harassment, and retaliation.

Use of Artificial Intelligence in Recruitment

Mecka uses artificial intelligence (AI) responsibly to support administrative and efficiency-focused aspects of our recruitment process. This includes activities such as drafting job descriptions, generating interview questions, note-taking and recordings, and supporting sourcing and scheduling workflows. All candidate evaluations, interviews, and hiring decisions are made by members of the Mecka team. While AI tools may assist with screening and assessment, they do not replace human judgment in selection decisions. Our use of AI is intended to streamline routine tasks, improve consistency, and enhance the overall candidate experience. We are committed to upholding principles of fairness, transparency, and accountability in all hiring activities. Overview 
 Are you insatiably curious, deeply passionate about the realm of databases and analytics, and ready to tackle complex challenges in a dynamic environment in the era of AI? If so, we invite you to join our team as a Cloud & AI Solution Engineer in Innovative Data Platform for  commercial customers  at Microsoft . Here, you'll be at the forefront of innovation, working on cutting-edge projects that leverage the latest technologies to drive meaningful impact. Join us and be part of a team that thrives on collaboration, creativity, and continuous learning. 
 Databases & Analytics is a growth opportunity for Microsoft Azure, as well as its partners and customers. It includes a rich portfolio of products including IaaS and PaaS services on the Azure Platform in the age of AI. These technologies empower customers to build, deploy, and manage database and analytics applications in a cloud-native way. 

 As an Innovative Data Platform Solution Engineer (SE), you will play a pivotal role in helping enterprises unlock the full potential of Microsoft’s cloud database and analytics stack across every stage of deployment. You’ll collaborate closely with engineering leaders and platform teams to accelerate the Fabric Data Platform, including Azure Databases and Analytics, through hands-on engagements like Proof of Concepts, hackathons, and architecture workshops. This opportunity will allow you to accelerate your career growth, develop deep business acumen, hone your technical skills, and become adept at solution design and deployment. You’ll guide customers through secure, scalable solution design, influence technical decisions, and accelerate database and analytics migration into their deployment workflows. In summary, you’ll help customers modernize their data platform and realize the full value of Microsoft’s platform, all while enjoying flexible work opportunities.

 As a trusted technical advisor, you’ll guide customers through secure, scalable solution design, influence technical decisions, and accelerate database and analytics migration into their deployment workflows. In summary, you’ll help customers modernize their data platform and realize the full value of Microsoft’s platform.

 Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond. 

 Responsibilities 

- Drive technical sales with decision makers using demos and PoCs to influence solution design and enable production deployments. 

- Lead hands-on engagements—hackathons and architecture workshops—to accelerate adoption of Microsoft’s cloud platforms. 

- Build trusted relationships with platform leads, co-designing secure, scalable architectures and solutions 

- Resolve technical blockers and objections, collaborating with engineering to share insights and improve products. 

- Maintain deep expertise in Analytics Portfolio: Microsoft Fabric (OneLake, DW, real-time intelligence, BI, Copilot), Azure Databricks, Purview Data Governance and Azure Databases: SQL DB, Cosmos DB, PostgreSQL. 

- Maintain and grow expertise in on-prem EDW (Teradata, Netezza, Exadata), Hadoop & BI solutions. 

- Represent Microsoft through thought leadership in cloud Database & Analytics communities and customer forums 

 Qualifications 
 Required/minimum qualifications
•    Master's Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field AND 4+ years technical pre-sales or technical consulting experience OR Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field AND 6+ years technical pre-sales or technical consulting experience OR 7+ years technical pre-sales or technical consulting experience OR equivalent experience.
 Additional or preferred qualifications
•    8+ years technical pre-sales, technical consulting, or technology delivery, or related experience OR equivalent experience.
•    6+ years experience with cloud and hybrid, or on premises infrastructures, architecture designs, migrations, industry standards, and/or technology management.
•    Certification in relevant technologies or disciplines (e.g., Office 365, Power BI, Azure Architect and Development exams, Cloud Platform Technologies, Information Security, Architecture).
•     Expert on Azure Databases (SQL DB, Cosmos DB, PostgreSQL) from migration & modernize and creating new AI apps.
•    Expert on Azure Analytics (Fabric, Azure Databricks, Purview) and competitors (BigQuery, Redshift, Snowflake) in data warehouse, data lake, big data, analytics, real-time intelligent, and reporting using integrated Data Security & Governance.
•    Proven ability to lead technical engagements (e.g., hackathons, PoCs, MVPs) that drive production-scale outcomes.
•    Proficient on data warehouse & big data migration including on-prem appliance (Teradata, Netezza, Oracle), Hadoop (Cloudera, Hortonworks) and Azure Synapse Gen2.

eightfold:microsoft.com:1970393557004887.description:
Overview 
 With over 17,000 employees worldwide, the mission of the Customer Experience & Success (CE&S) organization is to empower customers to accelerate business value through differentiated customer experiences that leverage Microsoft’s products, services, and partnerships. Come join CE&S and help us build a future where customers achieve their business outcomes faster with technology that does more.   

 We are looking for a Cloud Solution Architect (CSA), specializing in Security who is passionate about driving our customers’ security transformation on the Microsoft Azure and Microsoft 365 Platforms to support the Canadian business. This is a customer-facing role, owning the technical relationship between the customer and Microsoft, helping customers to leverage their Microsoft investments through architecture, implementation, and operational health engagements. This role is flexible in that you can work up to 50% from home.   

 As a Cloud Solution Architect (CSA), you will enable customers to achieve their outcomes, based on their investments in Microsoft technology. Leveraging your Security, Microsoft 365 and Microsoft Azure technical subject matter expertise you will lead technical conversations with customers to drive value from their MS investments, including identifying resolutions to issues blocking customer success projects. This opportunity will allow you to accelerate your career growth, honing your technical and collaboration skills, and deepening your cloud expertise.    

 Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.   

 Responsibilities 

- You will drive positive Customer Satisfaction and become a trusted advisor as well as provide feedback and insights from customers/partners and be the Voice of Customer to share insights and best practices, connect with Global Security teams at Microsoft, Engineering and Product teams to remove blockers and influence the solution roadmap.   

- You will land an end-to-end value proposition for Security (i.e., Zero Trust) which spans the breadth of Microsoft Security offerings, and with focus on Purview / Data Security, Threat Protection, ID + Access Management and Cloud Security.   

- You will position and deliver solutions that drive Security product usage as you develop opportunities to drive Customer Success business results & help Customers get value from their Microsoft investments and identify resolutions to Customer blockers by leveraging SA subject matter expertise.  Deliver according to MS best practices & using repeatable IP.  ​   

- You will accelerate Business Value of overall Security adoption by improving security posture and ensuring that the solution exhibits “Secure by Design” framework, such as high-performance levels, security, scalability, maintainability, appropriate reusability and reliability upon deployment.   

- You will align your individual skilling to team/area demands & Customer Success goals as you accelerate customer outcomes and share your expertise, contribute to Intellectual Property (IP) creation & re-use to accelerate customer outcomes.    

- You will run Architectural Design Sessions to build a plan for implementing the solution – governing design in line with customer business goals and their technical environment.  Outcome is consensus on solution design and next steps toward production.   

- You will collaborate and orchestrate with other Cloud Solution Architects and MS stakeholders including FastTrack, partner, and Microsoft Consulting in developing complex end-to-end Enterprise solutions with the Microsoft Security platform. 

 Qualifications 

 Required/minimum qualifications

- Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Business, Liberal Arts, or related field AND 4+ years experience in cloud/infrastructure technologies, information technology (IT) consulting/support, systems administration, network operations, software development/support, technology solutions, practice development, architecture, and/or consulting OR equivalent experience.

 Other Requirements: 
 This role requires the ability to meet Microsoft, customer, and/or government security screening requirements. These requirements include, but are not limited to the following specialized security screenings:  

- Microsoft Cloud Background Check: This position will be required to pass the Microsoft Cloud background check upon hire/transfer and every two years thereafter.  

- Reliability Status screening: This position requires that the successful candidate obtain and maintain a Reliability Status security screening with the Government of Canada. Microsoft will work with individuals on a case-by-case basis to determine if the requisite screening can be obtained within required timelines.  

 Preferred Qualifications:  

- Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Business, or related field AND 4+ years experience in cloud/infrastructure technologies, information technology (IT) consulting/support, systems administration, network operations, software development/support, technology solutions, practice development, architecture, and/or consulting OR equivalent experience 

- Breadth of technical experience and knowledge, with depth / Subject Matter Expertise in: 

- Purview / Data Security (IRM, MIP P2) and All Defender Workloads, strategies and solutions 

- Identity and Access Management  

- Zero Trust strategies including, Zero trust Foundations, Defend Against Threats, Protect and Govern Sensitive Data 

- Deep knowledge of solution architecture, design, implementation, and/or support of Cloud Security in order to identify business needs and determine solutions to business problems, process improvement, organizational change, or strategic planning and policy development. 

- Proven track record of building deep technical relationships with senior IT executives in large or highly strategic accounts. Experience in managing various stakeholder relationships to get consensus on solution/projects.  

- Presentation skills with a high degree of comfort with both large and small audiences (Senior Executives, Messaging/collaboration/Network/Security administrators, and solution architecture teams). 

- Ability to understand customer’s Security related business requirements and customer problems and solve them through Microsoft cloud technologies.  

- Competitive Landscape knowledge of Security platforms. Technical aptitude and experience to learn new cloud technologies and understand relevant cloud market trends.  

- Understanding of how Microsoft Security, compliance, and identity solutions can span across solution areas to provide a holistic and end-to-end solution.

 Do you have a passion for Azure and using best-in-class tools created by Microsoft? Are you looking for a role where you can interact directly with large enterprise customers to improve the stability and performance of the solutions they are deploying in Azure? Do you want to join one of Microsoft's fastest growing businesses? If so, we are looking for you!
Support for Mission Critical is a team within Microsoft that provides solution-specific expertise designed to drive peak health and optimum performance of a customer’s most important solutions. As a key technical resource for the customer, you will be primarily focused on delivering proactive services such as education workshops, delivering assessments, and providing tailored guidance.  Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. •    Drive and participate in proactive delivery management, spot performance issues, analyze problems, and provide solutions to meet customer needs.

•    Apply lessons learned for continuous process and delivery improvement for the customer.

Overview 
 With over 17,000 employees worldwide, the mission of the Customer Experience & Success (CE&S) organization is to empower customers to accelerate business value through differentiated customer experiences that leverage Microsoft’s products, services, and partnerships. Come join CE&S and help us build a future where customers achieve their business outcomes faster with technology that does more.
 We are looking for a Cloud Solution Architect (CSA), specializing in Security who is passionate about driving our customers’ security transformation on the Microsoft Azure and Microsoft 365 Platforms to support the Canadian business. This is a customer-facing role, owning the technical relationship between the customer and Microsoft, helping customers to leverage their Microsoft investments through architecture, implementation, and operational health engagements. This role is flexible in that you can work up to 50% from home.

 As a Cloud Solution Architect (CSA), you will enable customers to achieve their outcomes, based on their investments in Microsoft technology. Leveraging your Security, Microsoft 365 and Microsoft Azure technical subject matter expertise you will lead technical conversations with customers to drive value from their MS investments, including identifying resolutions to issues blocking customer success projects. This opportunity will allow you to accelerate your career growth, honing your technical and collaboration skills, and deepening your cloud expertise.

 Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.

 Responsibilities 

- You will drive positive Customer Satisfaction and become a trusted advisor as well as provide feedback and insights from customers/partners and be the Voice of Customer to share insights and best practices, connect with Global Security teams at Microsoft, Engineering and Product teams to remove blockers and influence the solution roadmap.

- You will land an end-to-end value proposition for Security (i.e., Zero Trust) which spans the breadth of Microsoft Security offerings, and with a focus on Threat Protection, ID + Access Management and Cloud Security.

- You will position and deliver solutions that drive Security product usage as you develop opportunities to drive Customer Success business results & help Customers get value from their Microsoft investments and identify resolutions to Customer blockers by leveraging SA subject matter expertise. Deliver according to MS best practices & using repeatable IP.  ​ 

- You will accelerate Business Value of overall Security adoption by improving security posture and ensuring that the solution exhibits “Secure by Design” framework, such as high-performance levels, security, scalability, maintainability, appropriate reusability and reliability upon deployment.

- You will align your individual skilling to team/area demands & Customer Success goals as you accelerate customer outcomes and share your expertise, contribute to Intellectual Property (IP) creation & re-use to accelerate customer outcomes. 

- You will run Architectural Design Sessions to build a plan for implementing the solution – governing design in line with customer business goals and their technical environment.  Outcome is consensus on solution design and next steps toward production.

- You will collaborate and orchestrate with other Cloud Solution Architects and MS stakeholders including FastTrack, partner, and Microsoft Consulting in developing complex end-to-end Enterprise solutions with the Microsoft Security platform.

 Qualifications 
 Required/minimum qualifications

- Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Business, Liberal Arts, or related field AND 7+ years experience in cloud/infrastructure technologies, information technology (IT) consulting/support, systems administration, network operations, software development/support, technology solutions, practice development, architecture, and/or consulting OR equivalent experience.
 Other Requirements: 
 This role requires the ability to meet Microsoft, customer, and/or government security screening requirements. These requirements include, but are not limited to the following specialized security screenings:  

- Microsoft Cloud Background Check: This position will be required to pass the Microsoft Cloud background check upon hire/transfer and every two years thereafter.  

- Reliability Status screening: This position requires that the successful candidate obtain and maintain a Reliability Status security screening with the Government of Canada. Microsoft will work with individuals on a case-by-case basis to determine if the requisite screening can be obtained within required timelines.  

 Additional or preferred qualifications

- Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Business, Liberal Arts, or related field AND 12+ years experience in cloud/infrastructure technologies, information technology (IT) consulting/support, systems administration, network operations, software development/support, technology solutions, practice development, architecture, and/or consulting OR Master's Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Business, Liberal Arts, or related field AND 8+ years experience in cloud/infrastructure technologies, technology solutions, practice development, architecture, and/or consulting OR equivalent experience

- 6+ years experience working in a customer-facing role (e.g., internal and/or external).

- 6+ years experience leading technical projects.

- Technical Certification in Cloud (e.g., Azure, Amazon Web Services, Google, security certifications).

- Breadth of technical experience and knowledge, with depth / Subject Matter Expertise in: 
- Sentinel, all Defender Workloads and Data Security strategies and solutions

- Identity and Access Management

- Zero Trust strategies including, Zero trust Foundations, Defend Against Threats, Protect and Govern Sensitive Data

- Deep knowledge of solution architecture, design, implementation, and/or support of Cloud Security in order to identify business needs and determine solutions to business problems, process improvement, organizational change, or strategic planning and policy development.

- Understanding of how Microsoft Security, compliance, and identity solutions can span across solution areas to provide a holistic and end-to-end solution.

- An active Canadian Government Secret Clearance or the ability to secure Secret Clearance with the Canadian Industrial Security Directorate (CISD) of Public Services and Procurement Canada.

- Proven track record of building deep technical relationships with senior IT executives in large or highly strategic accounts. Experience in managing various stakeholder relationships to get consensus on solution/projects. 

- Presentation skills with a high degree of comfort with both large and small audiences (Senior Executives, Messaging/collaboration/Network/Security administrators, and solution architecture teams).

- Ability to understand customer’s Security related business requirements and customer problems and solve them through Microsoft cloud technologies.

- Competitive Landscape knowledge of Security platforms. Technical aptitude and experience to learn new cloud technologies and understand relevant cloud market trends.

eightfold:microsoft.com:1970393557038899.description:
Overview 

 We help customers turn technology investment into meaningful progress for their businesses and the people they serve. Our culture values curiosity, inclusion, accountability and trusted collaboration. We seek architects who combine sound judgment with hands-on engineering, share what they learn and create an environment where colleagues and customers can challenge ideas openly. 
 A frontier company is not defined by adopting the newest technology first. It is defined by the judgment to translate emerging capabilities into secure, reliable and measurable outcomes. This means framing ambiguous problems, making explicit tradeoffs among cost, reliability and speed, and deciding responsibly with incomplete information. It also means knowing when not to use AI, controlling scope and establishing what must be true before a solution is ready for release. 
 ISD’s frontier consulting practice brings industry understanding, solution expertise and engineering discipline together. We use AI to strengthen how we explore, design and deliver, while keeping people accountable for decisions and quality. We build early working artifacts, validate them with customers and learn from delivered work rather than self-assessment. Adoption, change and capability transfer begin at the outset, so progress becomes sustained customer value rather than a successful demonstration alone. 
 Based in the Greater Toronto Area, the Senior Solution Architect in ISD Canada will lead strategic customer engagements, with a particular focus on financial services. The role requires fluency in customer workflows, data and risk considerations before selecting products or platforms. You will partner with executives and customer engineering teams to establish a credible baseline, define success measures and connect architecture decisions to business priorities across the Toronto and Canadian market. 
 This is both a strategic and a hands-on architecture role. You will guide multidisciplinary teams, maintain full-stack depth and collaborate with specialists to validate critical design choices in working solutions. A practical AI Usage Plan will help each significant engagement improve delivery with measured benefits, clear accountability and appropriate guardrails. The opportunity is to deliver reviewed, tested and operationally ready solutions, help customers adopt them, and create reusable patterns and capabilities that other teams actually use. 

 Responsibilities 

 The Sr. Solution Architect role is organized around five key accountability areas: 

- Business Outcome-Led Architecture  

- Engage executives to understand business priorities, establish baseline performance and define measurable outcomes and success criteria that guide architecture and investment decisions. 

- Translate business requirements into actionable solution architecture, applying financial-services workflow, data and risk fluency to the customer’s operating context before recommending products or platforms. 

- Challenge assumptions, frame ambiguous problems and make explicit cost, reliability and speed tradeoffs. Decide with incomplete data, control scope and say no when a proposed approach, including AI, is not justified. 

- Develop clear, decision-oriented proposals for executive audiences that explain options, dependencies, risks and the recommended path in terms of business outcomes. 

- Technical Team & AI Leadership  

- Serve as Lead Architect and accountable technical authority on complex engagements, aligning design decisions and hands-on technical direction with customer outcomes. 

- Lead and mentor multidisciplinary teams through trust, candor and shared ownership. Encourage constructive challenge, make responsibilities clear and support colleagues in developing sound technical judgment. 

- Govern human and AI-assisted teams, including agent orchestration, context, retrieval and memory. Define action authority, authorization boundaries, blast radius, human approvals and auditability so AI operates within explicit controls. 

- Partner with Program Directors and Project Managers to maintain technical governance, delivery quality and transparent management of scope, dependencies and risks. 

- Strengthen the architecture community through reusable patterns, mentoring and capability transfer. Share evidence from delivered work and help customer and delivery teams apply assets in practice. 

- AI-Powered Delivery  

- Establish and execute an AI Usage Plan for each significant engagement as a practical operating plan, not a paperwork exercise. Define measurable benefits, accountable owners, appropriate use cases, verification responsibilities and guardrails. 

- Use AI across requirements, code, tests, documentation and architecture, with human review and verification appropriate to the work. Demonstrate improved throughput without sacrificing reviewed and tested quality. 

- Deliver the smallest viable working slice early, use demos and customer validation to test assumptions, and iterate on evidence. Seek credible proof-of-value in weeks where appropriate without compromising regulated-production readiness. 

- Measure cycle time, quality, cost and business value against the engagement baseline. Adapt the AI Usage Plan and delivery approach based on observed results rather than activity counts or self-assessment. 

- Engineering-Grade Rigor  

- Maintain engineering discipline through architecture documentation, design reviews, code review, testing, CI/CD and operational readiness. Ensure that critical design choices are validated in working artifacts. 

- Conduct solution reviews that address security, reliability and maintainability, including AI evaluations, authorization controls and the behavior of agent-based components where relevant. 

- Identify risks proactively and establish evidence-based release criteria. Lead production go/no-go recommendations with explicit attention to unresolved risks, readiness gaps and customer operating requirements. 

- Promote shared engineering accountability and honest risk escalation. Surface limitations and uncertainty early, and work with delivery leaders and customer teams to resolve issues rather than defer them. 

- Create and maintain reusable, tested reference architectures, accelerators and frameworks. Validate that other teams can adopt them and use feedback from real engagements to improve them. 

- Full Stack Solution Capability  

- Apply broad Microsoft solution capability across Data & Analytics, AI & ML, Application Development and Cloud Infrastructure to shape end-to-end customer solutions. 

- Integrate data, applications, infrastructure, identity and security into cohesive architectures, with clear interfaces, dependencies and operational ownership. 

- Maintain technical depth in two to three domains while providing full-stack architectural guidance. Validate critical assumptions hands-on through code, prototypes, tests and working demonstrations. 

- Collaborate with specialists, product teams and customer engineers to resolve complex technical issues, apply the right expertise and transfer capability without losing end-to-end architectural accountability. 
 Additional Accountabilities  

- Make the Market—shape strategic Toronto/Canada FSI opportunities and add-on scope tied to outcomes. 

- Drive & Accelerate production cloud solutions responsibly aligned with customer and Microsoft strategy. 

- Deliver Business and Operational Excellence, including adoption, realized value and customer capability transfer. 

 Qualifications 
 Required/minimum qualifications

- Master's Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or related field AND 10+ years experience in technology solutions, practice development, architecture, consulting, and/or technology domain (e.g., Security) OR Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or related field AND 12+ years experience in technology solutions, practice development, architecture, consulting, and/or technology domain (e.g., Security) OR equivalent experience.

- 4+ years managing multiple, complex projects or portfolios.

- 2+ years experience leading blended, multidisciplinary teams.
 Additional or preferred qualifications

 Technical Skills — Full Stack Coverage Across:  

- Data & AI

- Azure Data Platform (Azure Synapse, Fabric, Data Factory, Databricks) 

- AI & Machine Learning (Azure OpenAI, Azure AI Studio, Cognitive Services, MLOps) 

- Big Data architectures (Lambda, Kappa), Enterprise Data Warehouse, Advanced Analytics 

- Application Development 

- Modern application architecture, microservices, API-first design 

- DevOps, CI/CD pipelines, GitHub Advanced Security, container platforms 

- App modernization, .NET, Java, and open-source software stacks 

- Cloud Infrastructure 

- Azure IaaS and PaaS services, subscription design, network architecture 

- Identity and Access Management (Azure AD, Entra), security architecture 

- Private/Hybrid/Public cloud configurations, migrations, and governance 

- Security

- Security reviews, threat modeling, Zero Trust architecture 

- Credential theft mitigation, compliance, and regulatory considerations in Canada 
 Leadership & Delivery Capabilities  

- Demonstrated ability to lead solution delivery as the Lead Architect on complex, multi-team engagements. 

- AI literacy — actively using AI tooling in day-to-day architecture and delivery work. 

- Experience writing and executing AI usage plans or equivalent AI integration strategies for customer engagements. 

- Ability to execute recognized Software Architecture methods, processes, and tools. 

- Experience applying engineering-grade practices: architecture review boards, design patterns, quality gates, test automation. 

- Ability to give compelling presentations to executive audiences, linking technical decisions to business outcomes. 

- Proven ability to build and sustain trusted relationships at the executive level (C-suite, VP, and Board) — engaging as a peer, not just a vendor, and maintaining those relationships across the full engagement lifecycle.

Through deep technical expertise and differentiated go-to-market execution, we win competitively, capture market share, and scale repeatable growth motions.  We’re looking for a Cloud Solution Architect (CSA) focused on Cloud & AI Data to help customers build unified, governed, secure, and AI-ready data estates on Microsoft Azure. In this customer-facing role, you’ll work with customers to design and deliver data platform, analytics, and database solutions that enable production-scale AI and agent scenarios. You’ll lead technical engagements across architecture design, proof of concepts, and production deployments, using repeatable IP, Factory, Unified VAS, and data acceleration programs to move customers from data foundation to scalable, production-grade outcomes. As part of the Cloud & AI Data team, you’ll help customers grow data platform adoption, improve workload health, resiliency, security, and capacity, and unlock value from Microsoft Fabric, Azure Databricks, Microsoft Purview, Azure SQL, Azure Database for PostgreSQL, Azure Database for MySQL, Cosmos DB, Microsoft IQ, and related AI capabilities. 

 Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond. 

 Responsibilities 

- Engage customer IT and business leaders to understand data estates, AI priorities, governance needs, success measures, and business outcomes; design secure, scalable Cloud & AI Data solutions for unified, governed, AI-ready estates.   

- Lead architecture design, create Data & AI platform roadmaps, and drive POCs, pilots, and production milestones across analytics, database, Fabric, Foundry, Microsoft IQ, and agent-enabled scenarios.   

- Own technical delivery for dispatched engagements, partnering with CSAMs to ensure Azure consumption and customer success plans are accurate, aligned, and feasible.   

- Use and contribute repeatable IP, templates, frameworks, and agents to accelerate deployment, improve consistency, grow Data share, and support Azure consumption outcomes.   

- Provide delivery oversight and escalation support for Factory, Unified, and data acceleration engagements across Data & Analytics workloads.   

- Lead workload health, resiliency, sovereignty, security, capacity management, and optimization for mission-critical data workloads and production-scale AI and agent use cases.   

- Resolve technical blockers and adoption issues and share customer and field feedback with product and engineering teams to improve platform readiness and outcomes.   

- Maintain deep expertise in Cloud & AI Data priorities, market trends, competitive insights, and Microsoft’s evolving data, AI, and agent capabilities.   

- Maintain advanced proficiency in priority workloads, including Microsoft Fabric, Azure Databricks, Microsoft Purview, Azure SQL, PostgreSQL, MySQL, Cosmos DB, Microsoft IQ, and related AI/agent scenarios.

Overview 
 Aperçu  

 Avec plus de 17 000 employés dans le monde, la mission de l’organisation Customer Experience & Success (CE&S) est de permettre aux clients d’accélérer la création de valeur grâce à des expériences client différenciées qui s’appuient sur les produits et services de Microsoft, portées par nos collaborateurs et notre culture. Rejoignez CE&S et aidez-nous à bâtir un avenir où les clients atteignent plus rapidement leurs objectifs d’affaires grâce à des technologies plus performantes.  

 Nous recherchons un architecte de solutions cloud (CSA) passionné par l’innovation applicative et la transformation par l’IA de nos clients sur la plateforme Microsoft. Dans le cadre de ce rôle, vous serez responsable d’engagements techniques auprès des clients et travaillerez sur certains des projets les plus complexes et stimulants de la base de clients Microsoft Azure, Azure Machine Learning et GitHub. Ce poste en contact direct avec les clients est un rôle technique pratique couvrant la conception, la création et les opérations, avec un accent sur la résolution des problèmes afin d’éliminer les obstacles techniques et les défis liés à l’adoption.  

 L’innovation applicative et l’apprentissage automatique sont désormais indissociables : les applications créées par nos clients sont de plus en plus intelligentes, et les modèles sont entraînés, déployés, gouvernés et exploités comme des composants à part entière de la solution. Nous attendons donc une expertise démontrée d’Azure Machine Learning et d’Azure AI Foundry, ainsi qu’une solide expérience du développement d’applications modernes. Vous dirigerez des discussions approfondies sur l’architecture technique avec des cadres supérieurs chez les clients, des architectes d’entreprise, des scientifiques des données, des ingénieurs de plateforme et des développeurs. Vous collaborerez également avec des équipes internes et externes pour développer des projets pilotes et superviser des projets de mise en œuvre.  

 La mission de Microsoft est de donner à chaque personne et à chaque organisation les moyens d’accomplir davantage. En tant qu’employés, nous adoptons une mentalité de croissance, innovons pour donner aux autres les moyens de réussir et collaborons afin d’atteindre nos objectifs communs. Chaque jour, nous nous appuyons sur nos valeurs de respect, d’intégrité et de responsabilité pour créer une culture inclusive où chacun peut s’épanouir au travail et au-delà. 

 Overview 
 With over 17,000 employees worldwide, the mission of the Customer Experience & Success (CE&S) organization is to empower customers to accelerate business value through differentiated customer experiences that leverage Microsoft’s products and services, ignited by our people and culture. Come join CE&S and help us build a future where customers achieve their business outcomes faster with technology that does more. 
 We are looking for a Cloud Solution Architect (CSA) who is passionate about driving our customers’ application innovation and AI transformation on the Microsoft platform. As part of this role, you will be responsible for technical customer engagements, working with the most challenging and exciting projects within the Microsoft Azure, Azure Machine Learning and GitHub customer base. This customer-facing position is a hands-on technical role spanning across design, build, and operations, with a focus on issue resolution to remove customer technical obstacles and adoption challenges. 
 Application innovation and machine learning are now inseparable: the applications our customers build are increasingly intelligent applications, where models are trained, deployed, governed and operated as first-class components of the solution. We therefore expect demonstrated depth in Azure Machine Learning and Azure AI Foundry alongside modern application development. You will lead deep technical architecture discussions with senior customer executives, enterprise architects, data scientists, platform engineers and developers, and collaborate with internal and external teams to develop pilots and oversee implementation projects. 
 Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond. 

 Responsibilities 
 Responsabilités 

- Comprendre les priorités d’affaires et informatiques des clients en matière d’ingénierie de plateforme, de développement d’applications cloud et d’adoption de l’apprentissage automatique génératif, agentique et classique, notamment les situations où Azure Machine Learning constitue la plateforme appropriée pour entraîner, déployer et gouverner les modèles. 

- Démontrer une expertise pratique approfondie d’Azure Machine Learning. Il s’agit d’une exigence du rôle et non d’un simple atout : architecture des espaces de travail avec réseau géré et points de terminaison privés, stratégie de calcul et de quotas GPU, ressources de données et magasins de caractéristiques, AutoML et entraînement distribué, registres de modèles, suivi des expériences avec MLflow, ainsi que points de terminaison en ligne et par lots gérés avec un déploiement sécuritaire. 

- Concevoir et mettre en œuvre des pratiques MLOps en production : intégration et déploiement continus pour les modèles, les composants et les invites avec Azure DevOps ou GitHub Actions, promotion entre les espaces de travail au moyen de registres, infrastructure en tant que code et surveillance de la dérive des données et des modèles avec des déclencheurs de réentraînement définis. 

- Diriger l’architecture de l’IA générative et agentique dans Azure AI Foundry et Azure Machine Learning : sélection des modèles, flux d’invites, génération augmentée par récupération avec Azure AI Search, compromis entre l’ingénierie d’invites, l’ajustement fin et la récupération, évaluation et mesures d’ancrage, sécurité du contenu et observabilité en production. 

- Veiller à ce que les applications intelligentes répondent aux attentes de l’entreprise en matière de sécurité, d’évolutivité, de facilité de maintenance et de fiabilité lors du déploiement. S’assurer également que les charges de travail d’apprentissage automatique respectent les exigences relatives à l’accès aux données fondé sur l’identité, à l’isolation réseau, au contrôle des coûts et à l’IA responsable, notamment l’équité, l’interprétabilité et la transparence. 

- Agir comme porte-parole du client en transmettant de nouveaux commentaires à l’ingénierie et des informations sur les tendances d’utilisation et d’application. Aider à accélérer la livraison des solutions grâce à des revues d’architecture, des preuves de concept, des applications de produit minimum viable (MVP), des projets pilotes de modèles et la configuration des environnements. 

- Soutenir le développement des compétences des clients en formulant des recommandations de formation ou en animant des discussions techniques, des ateliers pratiques sur Azure Machine Learning et Azure AI, ainsi que d’autres activités de préparation au cloud destinées aux développeurs, aux scientifiques des données et aux équipes de plateforme. 

- Stimuler la croissance de la consommation des services cloud et de soutien en développant des occasions qui produisent des résultats d’affaires pour la réussite client. Trouver des solutions aux obstacles des clients en s’appuyant sur une expertise spécialisée et sur les processus d’escalade internes de Microsoft. 

- Développer les relations avec les clients et les partenaires afin d’anticiper, de signaler et de résoudre les obstacles techniques. Utiliser la connaissance des plateformes d’IA et d’apprentissage automatique de Microsoft et de ses concurrents pour repérer des occasions de croissance. 

- Rester au fait des capacités d’Azure, d’Azure Machine Learning, d’Azure AI Foundry et de GitHub. Continuer à pratiquer un ou plusieurs langages d’entreprise, notamment .NET, Python, Java ou JavaScript/Node.js, avec une maîtrise pratique de la pile Python pour l’apprentissage automatique. 

- Partager des idées, des observations et des orientations techniques stratégiques avec les équipes techniques et les communautés internes. Participer à des événements techniques externes et favoriser la réutilisation de la propriété intellectuelle, le partage des meilleures pratiques et l’accélération de la consommation. 

 Responsabilities 

- Understand customers’ business and IT priorities for platform engineering, cloud application development, and the adoption of generative, agentic and classical machine learning — including where Azure Machine Learning is the right platform for training, deploying and governing models. 

- Bring demonstrated, hands-on depth in Azure Machine Learning — a requirement of this role, not a nice to have: workspace architecture with managed networking and private endpoints, compute and GPU quota strategy, data assets and feature stores, AutoML and distributed training, model registries, MLflow experiment tracking, and managed online and batch endpoints with safe rollout. 

- Design and deliver production MLOps: CI/CD for models, components and prompts with Azure DevOps or GitHub Actions, promotion across workspaces through registries, infrastructure as code, and monitoring for data and model drift with defined retraining triggers. 

- Lead generative and agentic AI architecture on Azure AI Foundry and Azure Machine Learning — model selection, prompt flow, retrieval-augmented generation with Azure AI Search, the prompting/fine-tuning/retrieval trade-off, evaluation and groundedness metrics, content safety, and production observability. 

- Ensure intelligent applications meet enterprise expectations for security, scalability, maintainability and reliability on deployment, and that machine learning workloads meet requirements for identity-based data access, network isolation, cost control and Responsible AI — fairness, interpretability and transparency. 

- Act as the voice of the customer by driving new feedback into engineering and insights on usage and application patterns, and help accelerate solution delivery through architectural reviews, proof of concept and MVP applications, model pilots and environment setup. 

- Support customer skilling by making skilling recommendations or delivering technical discussions, hands-on Azure Machine Learning and Azure AI workshops, and other cloud readiness activities for developers, data scientists and platform teams. 

- Drive consumption growth across Cloud and Support by developing opportunities that deliver Customer Success business results, and identify resolutions to customer blockers using subject matter expertise and internal Microsoft escalation processes. 

- Drive customer and partner relationships to anticipate, escalate and resolve technical blockers, and use knowledge of Microsoft and competitor AI and machine learning platforms to identify growth opportunities. 

- Stay current with Azure, Azure Machine Learning, Azure AI Foundry and GitHub capabilities, and remain a practitioner of one or more enterprise languages — .NET, Python, Java, JavaScript/Node.js — with working proficiency in the Python machine learning stack. 

- Share ideas, insights and strategic technical input with technical teams and internal communities, participate in external technical community events, and drive IP reuse, best practice sharing and consumption acceleration. 

 Qualifications 
 Qualifications requises  

- Baccalauréat en informatique, en technologies de l’information, en ingénierie, en administration des affaires ou dans un domaine connexe, ET au moins 4 ans d’expérience dans les technologies cloud ou d’infrastructure, le conseil ou le soutien en technologies de l’information, l’administration de systèmes, les opérations réseau, le développement ou le soutien logiciel, les solutions technologiques, le développement de pratiques, l’architecture et/ou le conseil OU expérience équivalente.  

 Qualifications privilégiées

Overview 

 ENGLISH TEXT FOLLOWS FRENCH 
 Avec plus de 17 000 employés à travers le monde , l’organisation Customer Experience & Success (CE&S) a pour mission d’aider les clients à accélérer la création de valeur pour leur entreprise grâce à des expériences client différenciées tirant parti des produits et services Microsoft, portées par nos employés et notre culture. Joignez-vous à CE&S et contribuez à bâtir un avenir où les clients atteignent plus rapidement leurs objectifs d’affaires grâce à des technologies qui accomplissent davantage.
 Nous sommes à la recherche d’un Architecte de solutions infonuagiques (Cloud Solution Architect - CSA) spécialisé en données et analytique , passionné par l’accompagnement des clients commerciaux d’entreprise canadiens dans la modernisation de leur environnement de données et l’accélération de leur transformation en intelligence artificielle sur Microsoft Azure .
 Il s’agit d’un rôle technique pratique, orienté client, couvrant la conception, la mise en œuvre et les opérations. Vous serez responsable de la relation technique entre le client et Microsoft pour l’ensemble du portefeuille Azure de données et d’analytique, notamment Microsoft Fabric, Power BI, Azure Databricks et Azure Databases (Azure SQL, PostgreSQL, MySQL et Cosmos DB).
 Vous dirigerez des discussions approfondies sur l’architecture technique avec des dirigeants, architectes d’entreprise, ingénieurs de données et équipes d’analytique chez les clients. Vous collaborerez également avec des équipes internes et externes afin de livrer des projets pilotes, des déploiements en production et des optimisations opérationnelles pour des charges de travail critiques liées aux données.
 La mission de Microsoft est de permettre à chaque personne et à chaque organisation de réaliser davantage. En tant qu’employés, nous adoptons un état d’esprit axé sur la croissance, innovons pour donner aux autres les moyens de réussir et collaborons afin d’atteindre nos objectifs communs. Chaque jour, nous incarnons nos valeurs de respect, d’intégrité et de responsabilisation afin de créer une culture inclusive où chacun peut s’épanouir, au travail comme ailleurs.
 Responsabilités

- Comprendre l’environnement de données des clients, leurs priorités d’affaires et informatiques ainsi que leurs indicateurs de réussite liés à la modernisation des données, à la gouvernance, à l’analytique et à la préparation à l’IA générative et agentique. Identifier de façon proactive des occasions d’accroître l’adoption du nuage à grande échelle en fonction de la valeur d’affaires.

- Concevoir et déployer des plateformes de données modernes sur Azure. Diriger les initiatives de modernisation et de migration de systèmes existants vers Microsoft Fabric (OneLake, Data Factory, Data Warehouse, Real-Time Intelligence), Azure Databricks, Azure Data Lake et Azure Databases (Azure SQL, PostgreSQL, MySQL, Cosmos DB et Oracle Database@Azure).

- Guider les clients vers des solutions bien architecturées, sécurisées, résilientes, prêtes pour l’IA et optimisées en matière de coûts et de performance. Appliquer les bonnes pratiques du Well-Architected Framework, des landing zones, de la modélisation des données, des processus ETL/ELT et de l’optimisation des performances afin d’assurer la préparation opérationnelle et une adoption durable.

- Assurer la santé, la résilience, la sécurité, la gestion de capacité et la souveraineté des données pour les charges de travail critiques. Veiller au respect des exigences de résidence des données et de conformité réglementaire applicables aux entreprises canadiennes et aux secteurs réglementés (services financiers, secteur public, santé, etc.).

- Fournir un leadership technique lors des revues d’architecture, des preuves de concept (POC), des produits minimums viables (MVP) et des déploiements en production. Soutenir les scénarios d’analytique avancée et d’apprentissage automatique à l’aide de Microsoft Fabric, Azure Databricks, Azure Machine Learning et Azure AI Foundry.

- Développer les relations avec les clients et partenaires afin d’anticiper, identifier, escalader et résoudre les obstacles techniques. Représenter la voix du client en transmettant les commentaires sur les produits et les apprentissages liés à l’adoption aux équipes d’ingénierie Microsoft afin d’influencer l’évolution des produits.

- Appuyer le développement des compétences des clients au moyen d’ateliers techniques, de hackathons et d’activités de préparation au nuage. Partager les meilleures pratiques et les actifs intellectuels réutilisables au sein de la communauté d’architecture de données et maintenir une expertise approfondie des services de données Azure, des tendances du marché et de la concurrence, notamment en SQL, Python, Spark/PySpark, KQL ou DAX.

 Qualifications minimales requises

- Baccalauréat en informatique, technologies de l’information, génie, administration des affaires, arts libéraux ou domaine connexe ET au moins 4 années d’expérience dans les technologies infonuagiques ou d’infrastructure, le soutien ou la consultation en TI, l’administration de systèmes, les opérations réseau, le développement ou le soutien logiciel, les solutions technologiques, le développement de pratiques, l’architecture ou la consultation;
 OU 
 une combinaison équivalente de formation et d’expérience.

- Chez Microsoft, vous travaillerez de manière intégrée avec des collègues à travers le monde. Afin de faciliter cette collaboration, la maîtrise de la communication orale et écrite en anglais et en français est requise pour ce rôle.
 Qualifications additionnelles ou privilégiées

- Baccalauréat en informatique, technologies de l’information, génie, administration des affaires, arts libéraux ou domaine connexe ET au moins 8 années d’expérience pertinente;
 OU 
 maîtrise dans un domaine pertinent ET au moins 6 années d’expérience pertinente;
 OU 
 expérience équivalente.

- Au moins 4 années d’expérience dans un rôle orienté client (interne ou externe).

- Au moins 4 années d’expérience dans la réalisation de projets techniques.

- Certification technique infonuagique (Azure, Amazon Web Services, Google Cloud ou certifications en sécurité).

- Expérience des stratégies de migration et de modernisation des données vers le nuage pour des bases de données relationnelles et non relationnelles, incluant une expérience pratique des technologies de mégadonnées (Big Data) et de calcul distribué.

- Expertise des plateformes de données et d’analytique à l’échelle de l’entreprise : entrepôts de données, architectures lakehouse et Big Data, intégration de données (ETL/ELT), intelligence d’affaires, analytique en temps réel ainsi que cadres de gouvernance, sécurité et conformité des données (par exemple Microsoft Purview).

- Maîtrise de Microsoft Fabric, Power BI, Azure Databricks et Azure Databases.

- Excellentes compétences en communication et en gestion des parties prenantes, avec la capacité d’influencer des décideurs techniques et d’affaires de niveau supérieur.

- Capacité à travailler avec des clients partout au Canada dans le segment Entreprise Commercial. La maîtrise professionnelle de l’anglais et du français constitue un atout.

 Job Overview 

 With over 17,000 employees worldwide, the mission of the Customer Experience & Success (CE&S) organization is to empower customers to accelerate business value through differentiated customer experiences that leverage Microsoft’s products and services, ignited by our people and culture. Come join CE&S and help us build a future where customers achieve their business outcomes faster with technology that does more.   

 We are looking for a Cloud Solution Architect (CSA) specializing in Data & Analytics who is passionate about helping our Canadian Enterprise Commercial customers modernize their data estate and accelerate their AI transformation on Microsoft Azure. This is a customer-facing, hands-on technical role spanning design, build, and operations, owning the technical relationship between the customer and Microsoft across the Azure data and analytics portfolio – Microsoft Fabric, Power BI, Azure Databricks, and Azure Databases (Azure SQL, PostgreSQL, MySQL, Cosmos DB). You will lead deep technical architecture discussions with senior customer executives, enterprise architects, data engineers, and analytics teams, and collaborate with internal and external teams to deliver pilots, production deployments, and operational optimization for business-critical data workloads. 

 Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond. 

 Responsibilities 

- Understand customers’ data estate, business and IT priorities, and success measures – data modernization, governance, analytics, and Generative and Agentic AI readiness – and proactively identify opportunities for cloud consumption at scale based on business value. 

- Architect and deliver modern data platforms on Azure, leading modernization and migration from legacy systems to Microsoft Fabric (OneLake, Data Factory, Data Warehouse, Real-Time Intelligence), Azure Databricks, Azure Data Lake, and Azure Databases (Azure SQL, PostgreSQL, MySQL, Cosmos DB, Oracle Database@Azure). 

- Guide customers toward well-architected solutions that are secure, resilient, AI-ready, and cost- and performance-optimized, applying the Well-Architected Framework, landing zones, and proven data modelling, ETL/ELT and performance-optimization practices to prepare them for operational readiness and sustainable adoption. 

- Lead the health, resiliency, security, capacity management and data sovereignty of mission-critical data workloads, including data residency and regulatory compliance requirements applicable to Canadian enterprise and regulated industries (e.g., financial services, public sector, healthcare). 

- Provide technical leadership in architecture reviews, proofs of concept (POCs), minimum viable products (MVPs) and production deployments, and enable advanced analytics and machine learning scenarios through Microsoft Fabric, Azure Databricks, Azure Machine Learning and Azure AI Foundry. 

- Drive customer and partner relationships to anticipate, identify, escalate and resolve technical blockers, acting as the voice of the customer by channelling product feedback and adoption insights back into Microsoft engineering to influence roadmap improvements. 

- Support customer skilling through technical workshops, hackathons and cloud readiness activities, share best practices and reusable intellectual property (IP) across the data architecture community, and maintain deep, current knowledge of Azure data services, market trends and competitive insights as a practitioner of SQL, Python, Spark/PySpark, KQL or DAX. 

 Qualifications 
 Required/minimum qualifications 

- Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Business, Liberal Arts, or related field AND 4+ years experience in cloud/infrastructure technologies, information technology (IT) consulting/support, systems administration, network operations, software development/support, technology solutions, practice development, architecture, and/or consulting OR equivalent experience. 

- At Microsoft, you will be working in an integrated fashion with colleagues around the world. To facilitate this collaboration, proficiency in verbal and written communication in both English and French is required for this role.

 Additional or preferred qualifications 

- Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Business, Liberal Arts, or related field AND 8+ years experience in cloud/infrastructure technologies, information technology (IT) consulting/support, systems administration, network operations, software development/support, technology solutions, practice development, architecture, and/or consulting OR Master's Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Business, Liberal Arts, or related field AND 6+ years experience in cloud/infrastructure technologies, technology solutions, practice development, architecture, and/or consulting OR equivalent experience. 

- 4+ years experience working in a customer-facing role (e.g., internal and/or external). 

- 4+ years experience working on technical projects. 

- Technical Certification in Cloud (e.g., Azure, Amazon Web Services, Google, security certifications). 

- Experience with cloud-based data migration and modernization strategies across relational and non-relational databases, including hands-on experience with big data technologies and distributed computing. 

- Technical experience and knowledge of enterprise-scale data and analytics platforms – data warehousing, lakehouse and big data architectures, data integration/ETL-ELT, business intelligence, real-time analytics, and data governance, security and compliance frameworks (e.g., Microsoft Purview). Proficient with Microsoft Fabric, Power BI, Azure Databricks and Azure Databases. 

- Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence senior technical and business decision makers. 

- Ability to work with customers across Canada in the Enterprise Commercial segment; professional proficiency in English and French is an asset.

About Miovision: 

At Miovision, we’re unlocking transportation networks that move you. Our vision and mission is to enable smart, fast, safe communities that simply flow, as we drive the Intelligent Mobility Revolution. Backed by the world’s most advanced traffic AI, Miovision’s innovations in traffic signal planning and operations are making it possible for cities to improve the transportation experience for drivers, cyclists and pedestrians.

Our values drive us. They’re at the core of everything we do. If they align with yours, proceed through the GREEN light!

 - All in to win: We're driven by a winning mindset, approaching every challenge with intensity, clarity, and speed.

 - One Miovision: We succeed as one team, uniting diverse talents, building on trust, and putting our shared mission before ego.

 - Be better every day: We're committed to continuous growth, staying curious, building mastery, and embracing challenges as learning opportunities.

 - Make it happen: We are proactive and results-driven, taking ownership, acting with urgency, and focusing on solutions that deliver real impact.

 - Earn the customer: We are deeply customer-centric, focused on earning our customers' partnership every day by delivering exceptional experiences that drive their success.


POSITION SUMMARY: 

As our Sr. Technical Program Manager - Product Development, you will sit in the driver's seat of our product delivery programs. You are the central traffic controller who leads the cross functional execution of product intent into shipped outcomes.  Working closely with hardware, software, operations, and go-to-market teams, you will map out the optimal route for new product introductions: establishing the plan, driving alignment, surfacing tradeoffs, managing dependencies, and holding the organization accountable to scope, schedule, technical readiness, and launch quality. If you excel at transforming potential roadblocks into smooth, predictable execution without losing speed, this is your green light to lead.

Reporting to the Sr. Director, Hardware, you will operate as the technical program integrator across Engineering, Product Management, Operations, Quality, and other key partners. On many programs, you will work alongside a second Technical Program Manager (TPgM) focused on detailed hardware execution. In that model, you would own the integrated product plan and cross-functional delivery system, while partnering closely with the hardware TPgM to keep hardware execution, software delivery, system integration, operational readiness, and go-to-market planning aligned. The Sr. Technical Program Manager does not replace functional technical leaders, but must understand the system deeply enough to connect decisions across disciplines, expose hidden dependencies early, and drive the right conversations at the right time.

Location: This is a flexible hybrid role based out of our HQ in Kitchener Ontario. 




OBJECTIVES AND RESPONSIBILITIES: 

 - Direct Flagship Delivery: Lead 1–3 concurrent complex product programs across hardware, firmware, cloud software, and operations to turn strategic vision into fully validated, commercially ready products.

 - Build Integrated Master Plans: Connect architecture, validation, release, and launch milestones into a single clear execution roadmap to maintain absolute visibility over critical paths and key dependencies.

 - Unify Cross-Functional Teams: Serve as the connective tissue between Engineering, Product Management, Quality, and Go-To-Market teams to keep all domain execution plans aligned.

 - Drive Risk & Tradeoff Mitigation: Identify system-level interdependencies and navigate tradeoffs between scope, cost, and schedule to resolve bottlenecks before they disrupt launch timelines.

 - Enforce Launch & Phase Readiness: Establish evidence-based entry/exit criteria for pilot builds and commercial releases to ensure flawless quality upon market release.

 - Optimize Program Governance: Elevate program management tools, decision logs, and cadence frameworks to increase predictability and accountability across the entire organization.


IDEAL PROFILE: 

 - Cross-Functional Leadership: Proven experience leading complex, end-to-end product programs spanning hardware, firmware, software, and operational launch.

 - Systems Thinking & Technical Depth: Strong ability to evaluate how hardware, firmware, cloud, and operational decisions interact across the entire product ecosystem.

 - Integrated Product Delivery: Deep knowledge of hardware/software lifecycles, cross-domain integration, system validation, and commercial launch readiness.

 - Program Governance: Expertise in building and driving integrated master schedules, dependency maps, risk mitigation strategies, and executive-level reporting.

 - Technical Credibility: Skilled at engaging with technical leads, constructively challenging incomplete plans, and surfacing hidden risks or assumptions early.

 - Cross-Domain Collaboration: Experience partnering with engineering, product, operations, and quality teams to align roadmaps and shared deliverables.

 - Go-To-Market Execution: Demonstrated ability to coordinate technical, operational, and commercial workstreams through launch and initial customer adoption.

 - Leadership & Ambiguity: Exceptional communication and stakeholder management skills, with a track record of driving clarity, consensus, and accountability in dynamic environments.


ADDITIONAL ASSETS: 

 - Experience delivering connected devices or other products where hardware, firmware, cloud, and application releases must come together for a successful launch.

 - New Product Introduction (NPI), manufacturing ramp, regulatory compliance, and post-launch operational handoffs.

 - Background in a related industry such as transportation technology, IoT, edge systems, intelligent infrastructure, or similarly complex product environments.
   
   


WHAT YOU’LL ACHIEVE IN YEAR ONE

 - Build Strong Partnerships: Establish clear ownership, trust, and a seamless collaborative model across hardware, software, operations, and cross-functional leadership.

 - Drive End-to-End Visibility: Create high-integrity tracking for program scope, dependencies, and risk—enabling proactive decision-making and eliminating late-stage surprises.

 - Deliver a Major Milestone: Successfully drive a significant product launch across technical, operational, and go-to-market teams with strict readiness criteria.

 - Raise the Bar for Delivery: Implement scalable planning frameworks, review mechanisms, and accountability structures that make future product launches faster and more predictable.

This posting is for an actual vacancy. 

Your Rewards & Well-being:
We invest in our team with benefits designed for modern life and true work-life balance.

 - Comprehensive Coverage: Your well-being is covered from day one with comprehensive health benefits, 24/7 virtual healthcare access, and dedicated wellness programs.

 - Financial Future: Build for tomorrow with our RRSP/401K Matching Plan and share in the company's success through our Variable Incentive Plan.

 - Time to Recharge: Truly unplug with our unique Mio-Days and flexible vacation policy.

 - Work & Life Support: We support you with flexible work options, an internet subsidy, a remote work allowance, and enhanced leave for new parents.

Sound like your next adventure? Apply now and let's start building together!

We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. Please indicate if you require accommodation on your application, and our team will work with you to meet your accessibility needs.

Miovision may use artificial intelligence (AI) to assist in the hiring process for tasks such as helping to identify qualified candidates, taking meeting notes, creating summaries, and streamlining administrative work. These tools are one of several factors considered in the hiring process and do not replace human judgement. We do not use AI to make any final hiring or interview decisions.

PLEASE BE AWARE OF FRAUD: Applicants interested in applying for roles at Miovision should apply directly via the details provided on our careers page. We communicate directly with applicants and will not request banking information, payment, or fees during any point of the recruitment process. We do not conduct interviews via text message. If you suspect that a third party is impersonating Miovision or requesting payment for recruitment on behalf of Miovision, please alert us via recruitment@miovision.com.

To all recruitment agencies: Miovision does not accept agency solicitation or resumes. Please do not forward resumes to our HR alias e-mail address, to any Miovision employee, or to other Miovision e-mail addresses. Miovision will not pay any fees related to unsolicited resumes.

 - The User-Obsessed Explorer: You always start with the user and work backwards, building continuous discovery loops and utilizing multi-modal data to validate critical assumptions before committing a single engineering resource.

 - The Mission-Driven Innovator: You are genuinely passionate about the impact of your work—eager to shape technology that actively saves lives, accelerates public transit, and optimizes massive commercial fleets.
