Product Manager 

 Job Description: 
 Thomson Reuters is seeking a dynamic Product Manager to drive the development and commercialization of innovative analytical solutions, ensuring alignment with customer needs and strategic business objectives.

 The Product Manager owns the vision, direction, and priorities for a larger, more complex, or strategic product or group of products, managing the full product lifecycle from strategic planning through to tactical execution. They understand the needs of the customers the product is designed to serve in depth, communicate those needs crisply across the organization, and work with design and engineering to translate them into clear priorities, compelling roadmaps, and high-impact solutions. They reason across the full system understanding how decisions in their area impact adjacent products, teams, and the end-to-end customer experience and bring the right people into the room to make trade-offs visible. 

 They confidently shape product direction with a clear view of commercial impact, balancing short-term delivery with long-term system health and customer trust, and maintain a sharp sense of focus on the right problems, the right customers, and the right investments, treating scope creep and the impulse to build for everyone as the strategic risks they are. The balance between tactical execution and strategic vision is critical at this level, as is the ability to coordinate across multiple functions simultaneously and to lead in building AI-enabled products and experiences with depth and credibility. This is a hybrid role

 Key Responsibilities: 

- Lead the entire product lifecycle from ideation through launch and post-launch optimization, focusing on analytical solutions.

- Conduct thorough market research and competitive analysis to identify new opportunities and inform product strategy.

- Translate complex customer needs and market insights into clear product requirements and user stories.

- Collaborate cross-functionally with engineering, design, sales, and marketing teams to ensure successful product development and commercialization.

- Develop and execute go-to-market strategies, including pricing, positioning, and promotional activities.

- Monitor product performance, gather customer feedback, and iterate on features to drive continuous improvement and customer engagement.

- Effectively communicate product vision, roadmap, and updates to internal and external stakeholders.

- Manage multiple projects simultaneously, prioritizing tasks to maximize organizational efficiency.

 Required Qualifications: 

- Proven experience in product management, particularly with analytical solutions.

- Strong understanding of product development methodologies and product commercialization processes.

- Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to articulate complex ideas clearly.

- Demonstrated ability in group problem solving and strategic execution.

- Proficiency in computer literacy, including advanced skills in Microsoft Office Suite.

- Experience with marketing and customer engagement strategies.

- Highly organized, detail-oriented, and capable of effective multitasking.

- Strong researching abilities to inform product decisions and market understanding.

 Preferred Qualifications: 

- Experience managing tax, accounting, or other regulated professional-services software, ideally enterprise products serving large firms.

- Hands-on experience building and launching AI/ML-enabled products or features, including working with engineering on responsible AI, data quality, and governance.

- Demonstrated ownership of commercial outcomes such as adoption, retention, and revenue, with experience in pricing, packaging, and business-case development.

- Experience mentoring junior Product Managers and leading cross-functional initiatives without direct authority.

- Familiarity with product analytics and customer-feedback tools (e.g., Pendo, Amplitude) to drive data-informed prioritization.

- Experience with Agile practices and road mapping/backlog tools (e.g., Azure DevOps, Lucid).

- Strong relationships with enterprise customers: running advisory boards, executive briefings, and customer-success partnerships.

ashby:trulioo:29ac1954-3d7e-406a-8d1b-54.description:
Are you ready to embark on a career that truly affects people around the world? Trulioo invites you to be a catalyst for change in the dynamic realm of digital identity verification. As the global front-runner in our industry, we are redefining how businesses grow, innovate and comply online.



Picture yourself at the forefront of innovation, contributing to our award-winning platform that enables organizations worldwide to quickly onboard customers, optimize costs and combat fraud. Fueled by Silicon Valley support, Trulioo stands as the trusted platform that can verify more than 5 billion people and 700 million business entities spanning 195 countries.



But Trulioo is more than a tech company. We are a united force of dedicated experts committed to establishing trust online - and we’re proud to be recognized as a BC Top Employer for the second consecutive year, reflecting our commitment to an inclusive, collaborative, and people-first workplace.



Headquartered in Vancouver and with strategic hubs in San Diego and Dublin, we foster a culture of collaboration and open communication. Our offices support a hybrid model and staff typically work three days per week at a hub location. Join us where excitement meets innovation and contribute to a world where trust and technology unite.



What We Offer

 - Comprehensive Benefits: We provide a robust benefits package for full-time, permanent employees, including health, dental, and vision coverage, retirement plans with company match, paid time off, parental leave, and an annual education & training stipend (equivalent to $1,000 in local currency). Specific benefits may vary by location and will be discussed further during the interview process.

 - Flexible Hybrid Working Environment: Our offices are designed to support both collaboration and flexibility. Enjoy weekly lunches, quality coffee, and regular social events. Many locations also feature parent rooms, on-site gyms, comfortable lounges, and adaptable workstations to support your comfort and productivity.

 - Wellness: We care about your well-being. Team members have access to wellness workshops and events, as well as a complimentary Headspace subscription to help you stay focused, grounded, and energized.

 - Employee Resource Groups: Belonging is an important part of doing your best work. Our ERGs provide an inclusive space, support and community for employees of diverse backgrounds and allies. We host informative, fun sessions and celebrations that are often open to the entire organization.
   
   


POSITION SUMMARY

Trulioo verifies businesses and the people behind them at global scale. Our Business Verification (KYB) product is the system enterprises and high-growth companies trust to onboard merchants, meet regulatory needs, and stop bad actors before they enter the platform - across 195+ countries, with the data, document, and watchlist coverage to back it. 



We're hiring a Product Manager to own the strategy and roadmap for a core area of KYB - setting direction, leading discovery, and shipping new product classes that change how fast and how confidently our customers can onboard a business anywhere in the world. You'll have a point of view on where KYB goes next, defend it with evidence, and change it when the evidence says otherwise. We need a strategic operator who can take new capabilities from concept to launch, adoption, and revenue-generating. 



This role is expected to leverage AI and emerging technologies to improve productivity, enhance decision-making, and continuously optimize how work is performed.



This will be a full-time, permanent position working out of the Vancouver office on a hybrid model (3 days per week in the office). However, this role can be done remotely for the right person.




WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING:

 - Strategy and roadmap for key KYB capabilities - including the prioritization trade-offs, the bets we're making, and the work we're explicitly not doing 

 - Customer discovery to develop a deep understanding of enterprise and SMB onboarding, risk, and compliance workflows, translating customer problems into clear product narratives, business cases, and launch plans 

 - Market and competitive analysis to identify where KYB needs to lead, where parity is enough, and where new product classes should be invented 

 - Detailed technical requirements developed with Engineering and Data teams, including APIs, platform workflows, data needs, edge cases, acceptance criteria, and trade-offs that unblock execution and support global scale 

 - New product launches end-to-end - partnering with Product Marketing, Sales, Customer Success, Solutions Engineering, and Support to land new capabilities with enterprise and SMB customers 

 - Define and manage success metrics such as adoption, conversion, verification rate, match quality, processing time, manual review reduction, revenue impact and customer satisfaction




WHAT YOU'LL BRING:

 -  5+ years in product management, with a track record of shipping work that moved measurable business or customer outcomes 

 - Technical fluency - comfortable specifying API behavior, reasoning about platform and data architecture trade-offs, and engaging with engineers as a peer on scope, edge cases, and build-vs-buy decisions 

 - Analytical rigor - defining the right metrics, instrumenting learning loops, and using data to drive prioritization decisions 

 - Customer discovery - regularly talking to customers and internal teams, synthesizing qualitative and quantitative signals, and separating urgent asks from durable product opportunities 

 - Go-to-market experience taking new products from concept through launch with sales, marketing, and CS - ideally including enterprise selling motions 

 - Stakeholder management and influence without authority across Product, Engineering, Sales, Customer Success, Support, Marketing, and Compliance, including driving durable alignment on difficult trade-offs 

 - AI fluency as a default - you use modern AI tools to accelerate research, drafting, prototyping, and engineering communication 

 - Clear written communication - your strategy docs and PRDs should require minimal interpretation 




NICE TO HAVE:

 - Background in KYB/KYC/AML, merchant onboarding, identity verification, risk, RegTech, financial services, payments, or e-commerce platforms 

 - Experience shipping AI-powered features, including evaluation methodology and reasoning about non-deterministic outputs 

 - Experience with global product surfaces - multi-jurisdiction compliance, localization, or international data sourcing 




INTERVIEW PROCESS:

At Trulioo, we strive to create an interview experience that is transparent, engaging, and respectful of your time. Our process is designed to help us learn more about your skills and experience while giving you insight into our team, culture, and the impact of the work we do.

Here's what you can expect throughout the interview process:

 - Recruiter Interview: 30 minutes

 - Hiring Manager Interview: 45 minutes

 - Panel Interview: 60 minutes

 - Final Leadership Interview: 30 minutes




WHY TRULIOO:

 KYB sits at the center of how the global economy onboards trust. The work compounds: every new jurisdiction, data source, and signal we add changes what's possible for our customers. You'll own a meaningful surface of that, with the autonomy to set direction and the team to actually ship it.


Thriving at Trulioo

At Trulioo, you’re not just an employee. You’re a valued member of our Trulicrew on a journey of professional and personal growth with a world-class organization. With Trulioo, you have the power to revolutionize the intersection of technology, digital trust and online identity to open the global economy to everyone. Together, we can shape the digital future.



We’re on the lookout for exceptional people to empower with trust, autonomy and the freedom to cultivate their potential. Your curiosity, meticulous attention to detail and passion to contribute are highly valued. If that resonates with you, apply today to become a part of our team. Join us in shaping a future where your career isn’t just a journey but also a boundless exploration into the possibilities of technology and digital identity verification. 



Get an inside look at life at Trulioo by following us on LinkedIn https://ca.linkedin.com/company/trulioo, or learn more about us at www.trulioo.com http://www.trulioo.com



If you don’t see yourself fully reflected in every job requirement listed on the posting above, we still encourage you to reach out and apply. Research has shown that minorities and underrepresented groups often only apply when they feel 100% qualified. We are committed to creating a more equitable, inclusive and diverse company and we strongly encourage applicants of all genders, ages, ethnicities, cultures, abilities, sexual orientations, and life experiences to apply.

Trulioo welcomes applications from people with disabilities. Support is available upon request for candidates taking part in all aspects of the selection process. Finally, we know from time-to-time emergencies happen and you may need to reschedule an interview - we understand and encourage you to be in communication without worrying about losing the opportunity or your credibility.



Privacy Notice

As part of our job application process, Trulioo collects, processes, and discloses personal data for the purpose of identifying suitable candidates for our job openings. For more detail, please visit Trulioo’s Website Privacy Policy https://www.trulioo.com/website-privacy-policy in the section “When you apply for a job”.

POSITION SUMMARY

We are looking for a highly driven, intellectually curious Senior Product Manager to lead Trulioo's KYC Fraud & Risk product line. This is a high-visibility individual contributor role at the centre of one of the digital economy's most critical unsolved problems: consumer identity fraud and risk.



You will own the end-to-end product lifecycle for KYC fraud and risk solutions — from strategy and roadmap definition through discovery, build, launch, and iteration. You will work at the intersection of identity verification, machine learning, compliance, and financial services, directly shaping how global enterprises onboard customers, detect synthetic identities, and prevent fraud at scale.



This role sits at a pivotal moment for Trulioo: we are investing aggressively in unified identity, fraud and intelligence — and the KYC Fraud & Risk team is central to that vision.



This role is expected to leverage AI and emerging technologies to improve productivity, enhance decision-making, and continuously optimize how work is performed.



This will be a full-time, permanent position working out of the Vancouver office on a hybrid model (3 days per week in the office).




WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING:

Product Strategy & Roadmap

 - Own and continuously evolve the multi-quarter product roadmap for KYC fraud and risk solutions, balancing customer urgency, business value, and technical feasibility.

 - Define product vision aligned with Trulioo's broader platform strategy, contributing to internal roadmap communications and external partner/customer conversations.

 - Conduct rigorous market evaluations and competitive analyses to recommend build, partner, or buy decisions with clear rationale.

 - Identify and seize whitespace opportunities in consumer identity fraud, KYC compliance, and risk decisioning — bringing forward new product bets that could materially expand Trulioo's addressable market.

Discovery & Customer Insight

 - Serve as the primary voice of the customer, regularly conducting discovery interviews with enterprise clients across financial services, fintech, payments, and regulated industries.

 - Collect and synthesize qualitative and quantitative feedback to surface unmet needs, validate hypotheses, and inform prioritization decisions.

 - Partner with Sales and Business Development to engage prospects early in the sales cycle, representing the product and gathering signals on market demands.

 - Monitor product performance metrics, client feedback loops, and support escalations to drive continuous improvement post-launch.

Cross-Functional Execution

 - Lead cross-functional squads — Engineering, Data Science, Design, Legal, and Compliance — to deliver fraud and risk capabilities within expected timelines using agile methodologies.

 - Partner closely with ML and Data Science teams to identify predictive signals, validate model performance, define feedback loops, and deliver explainable risk scores that drive adoption.

 - Decompose complex product problems into incremental delivery milestones, managing trade-offs transparently with stakeholders.

 - Communicate product vision, roadmap updates, and strategic changes clearly to diverse audiences, including executive leadership and external clients.




WHAT YOU'LL BRING:

 - 8+ years of product management experience, with a significant portion focused on KYC, identity verification, fraud detection, or risk decisioning in FinTech, RegTech, Payments, or Financial Services.

 - Deep domain expertise in KYC fraud — including synthetic identity fraud, document fraud, account takeover, and consumer onboarding risk — with a clear understanding of how these differ from KYB risk and compliance workflows.

 - Hands-on experience working with ML and Data Science teams: defining model requirements, interpreting model outputs, managing feedback loops, and translating model insights into product features.

 - Proven track record of owning a product roadmap end-to-end, shipping impactful products in agile environments, and influencing without authority across cross-functional teams.

 - Strong analytical and problem-solving skills; ability to structure ambiguous problems, make defensible recommendations, and break them into deliverable increments.

 - Excellent oral and written communication skills, with the ability to distill complex technical or regulatory topics into crisp narratives for diverse audiences.

 - Experience working with third-party data providers such as credit bureaus, identity data networks, or risk data vendors.

 - Bachelor's degree in a STEM, Business, or related field — or equivalent practical experience.
   
   


NICE TO HAVE:

 - Experience with AML/BSA compliance frameworks, adverse media screening, PEPs/sanctions data, or regulatory reporting.

 - Familiarity with AI/ML Ops practices, LLMs, or agentic AI systems applied to fraud detection or identity workflows.

 - Prior experience integrating fraud APIs, risk orchestration platforms, or decisioning engines (e.g., case management, rules engines).

 - Exposure to global identity data ecosystems across multiple regions (North America, Europe, APAC) and their regulatory nuances.

 - An active network within the identity verification or fraud prevention industry.




INTERVIEW PROCESS:

At Trulioo, we strive to create an interview experience that is transparent, engaging, and respectful of your time. Our process is designed to help us learn more about your skills and experience while giving you insight into our team, culture, and the impact of the work we do.

Here's what you can expect throughout the interview process:

 - Recruiter Interview: 30 minutes

 - Hiring Manager Interview: 45 minutes

 - Panel Interview: 60 minutes

 - Final Leadership Interview: 30 minutes
   
   


HOW YOU THRIVE AT TRULIOO:

At Trulioo, we look for people who embody the following ways of working:

 - Customer Obsessed — You start with the customer problem and work backwards. You speak directly with clients, not just through proxies.

 - High Agency — You drive results in ambiguous circumstances. You identify the right questions, find the right people, and independently move projects forward.

 - Data-Informed — You review data methodically, question assumptions, and back recommendations with evidence — while knowing when intuition is the right call.

 - Collaborative — You impress and inspire across cross-functional teams; you don't win alone. You make others around you better.

 - Bias for Learning — You bring a curious mindset and eagerness to experiment, especially at the frontier of AI-driven identity and fraud detection.





Thriving at Trulioo

At Trulioo, you’re not just an employee. You’re a valued member of our Trulicrew on a journey of professional and personal growth with a world-class organization. With Trulioo, you have the power to revolutionize the intersection of technology, digital trust and online identity to open the global economy to everyone. Are you ready to embark on a career that truly affects people around the world? Trulioo invites you to be a catalyst for change in the dynamic realm of digital identity verification. As the global front-runner in our industry, we are redefining how businesses grow, innovate and comply online.



Picture yourself at the forefront of innovation, contributing to our award-winning platform that enables organizations worldwide to quickly onboard customers, optimize costs and combat fraud. Fueled by Silicon Valley support, Trulioo stands as the trusted platform that can verify more than 5 billion people and 700 million business entities spanning 195 countries.



But Trulioo is more than a tech company. We are a united force of dedicated experts committed to establishing trust online - and we’re proud to be recognized as a BC Top Employer for the second consecutive year, reflecting our commitment to an inclusive, collaborative, and people-first workplace.



Headquartered in Vancouver and with strategic hubs in San Diego and Dublin, we foster a culture of collaboration and open communication. Our offices support a hybrid model and staff typically work three days per week at a hub location. Join us where excitement meets innovation and contribute to a world where trust and technology unite.



What We Offer

 - Comprehensive Benefits: We provide a robust benefits package for full-time, permanent employees, including health, dental, and vision coverage, retirement plans with company match, paid time off, parental leave, and an annual education & training stipend (equivalent to $1,000 in local currency). Specific benefits may vary by location and will be discussed further during the interview process.

 - Flexible Hybrid Working Environment: Our offices are designed to support both collaboration and flexibility. Enjoy weekly lunches, quality coffee, and regular social events. Many locations also feature parent rooms, on-site gyms, comfortable lounges, and adaptable workstations to support your comfort and productivity.

 - Wellness: We care about your well-being. Team members have access to wellness workshops and events, as well as a complimentary Headspace subscription to help you stay focused, grounded, and energized.

 - Employee Resource Groups: Belonging is an important part of doing your best work. Our ERGs provide an inclusive space, support and community for employees of diverse backgrounds and allies. We host informative, fun sessions and celebrations that are often open to the entire organization.
   
   


POSITION SUMMARY:

The Chief of Staff at Trulioo is a critical leadership role that drives strategic alignment, operational execution, and organizational effectiveness at the highest levels of the company. Acting as a trusted advisor and right-hand to the CEO, you will ensure that executive priorities are translated into action, internal processes are optimized, and cross-functional collaboration is seamless.



You will work closely with the CEO and the executive team, serving as a thought partner, problem-solver, and operational lead across a wide array of strategic initiatives. This role requires exceptional judgment, discretion, communication, and project management capabilities. The ideal candidate brings a blend of strategic thinking, execution excellence, and operational rigor, paired with the humility and flexibility to operate both behind the scenes and in leadership settings.



A defining part of this role is AI fluency: you will be the executive team’s go-to person for identifying where AI tools can remove friction, accelerate decisions, and free up leadership time and you’ll model that adoption yourself before asking others to follow.



This is a full-time position available on either a permanent or fixed-term basis, with a preference for a permanent hire. Remote work may be considered for the right candidate




WHAT YOU’LL BE DOING:

 - Set and sustain the operating rhythm. Own executive meetings, business reviews, board meetings, and offsites, including agendas, pre-reads, decisions, and follow-through. Ensure everyone leaves clear on what was decided and who owns it.

 - Run the goal-setting system. Own the OKR process end-to-end, and give the CEO and leadership team an honest read on where the business actually stands.

 - Prepare the CEO for high-stakes moments. Build board materials, executive presentations, and briefings for critical internal and external meetings.

 - Lead what nobody owns. Find the gaps, lead the cross-functional initiatives that fill them, then hand them off cleanly. Expect two or three running at a time, including initiatives to identify, pilot, and roll out AI tools that streamline internal processes across teams.

 - Extend the CEO's reach. Shape communications for town halls, company updates, and speaking engagements. Stand in for the CEO where appropriate, knowing what to decide and what to bring back.

 - Be a candid thought partner. Help the CEO prioritize and pressure-test decisions.

 - Champion AI adoption across the executive team. Act as the internal evangelist and coach for practical AI use, identifying high-value use cases, vetting new tools, running lightweight trainings, and helping executives build AI-augmented habits into their own workflows.
   
   


WHAT YOU’LL BRING:

 - Proven experience supporting C-level executives or founders in a Chief of Staff, Business Manager, or Strategic Advisor role.

 - Strong strategic thinking and problem-solving capabilities, with the ability to connect the dots and drive clarity across complexity.

 - Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to craft high-impact executive communications.

 - Highly organized, detail-oriented, and able to manage multiple initiatives simultaneously under tight deadlines.

 - High EQ and interpersonal intelligence - able to influence, mediate, and build trust across all levels of the organization.

 See yourself at Twilio 

 Join Twilio as a Program Manager, Carrier Operations & Governance — a tech-forward business analyst and program manager within a brand-new function built from the ground up to reshape how Twilio manages, governs, and optimizes its global telecom carrier and wholesale supplier ecosystem.

 About the job 

 This isn't a role that inherits an existing playbook — it's a role that writes one. Twilio is building a highly visible, cross-functional operations & governance team dedicated to optimizing its telecom carrier and wholesale supplier ecosystem. Reporting into leadership that maintains regular cadences with Twilio's CEO, CFO, CRO, and Audit Committee, you will serve as the primary owner of critical end-to-end improvements spanning multiple areas of the business, and build internal operating models that unlock new levels of operational maturity and rigor.

 In this role, you will bring together, understand, and implement the policies, processes, systems, tools, and controls necessary to build a world-class operating environment. You will own the creation and stand-up of the team operating model, cadences, and runbooks while taking direct ownership of the team's internal Run-the-Business (RTB) engine.

 If you thrive in high-visibility environments, love designing systems from first principles, and want to own program execution end-to-end, this opportunity is built for you.

 Responsibilities 

 In this role, you will lead program execution across four core pillars:

 Cross-Functional Governance & Leadership 

- Drive Visible Governance Programs: Serve as the core Program Manager for a highly visible, cross-functional governance initiative spanning multiple areas of the business - including building and operationalizing programs from diagnosis, design, implementation, and change management

- Maintain Executive Visibility: Package and present operational narratives, risks, and performance metrics to cross-functional leadership, feeding into C-suite and Audit Committee reviews.

- Implement Core Infrastructure: Lead end-to-end process improvements across carrier operations — understanding, synthesizing, and deploying cohesive policies, workflows, systems/tools, and data-driven controls.

 Operating Model, Enablement & Team Infrastructure 

- Build Team Foundations: Design and stand up the new Carrier Operations & Governance operating model, operational cadences, and internal team structures.

- Author Runbooks & Standards: Author, maintain, and roll out standard operational runbooks, supply policies, and Rules of Engagement (ROEs) for internal stakeholders and carrier partners.

- Design Enablement & Change Management: Design and create comprehensive enablement programs, training materials, and frameworks to accelerate organizational transformation — actively shifting teams from relationship- and assumption-driven decision-making to a rigorously governed, data-informed operating model.

 Insights & Reporting  

- Business Intelligence: Leverage quantitative research, machine learning models, performance monitoring, and scalable data foundations that enable fast, economically sound insights.

- Data & Reporting Quality: Execute analytical requests from IRSG, Legal, Finance, and GTM stakeholders, delivering accurate data pulls, ad-hoc analyses, and structured summaries. Perform data quality checks and validation to ensure accuracy and consistency across reporting pipelines. 

- Design Enablement & Change Management: Design and create comprehensive enablement programs, training materials, and frameworks to accelerate organizational transformation — actively shifting teams from relationship- and assumption-driven decision-making to a rigorously governed, data-informed operating model.

- Drive Team RTB Engine: Own and manage the day-to-day Run-the-Business (RTB) cadence at the team level, ensuring operational momentum and accountability.

- Facilitate Operational Rhythms: Facilitate regular operational forums, including team OKR tracking, and deal approval workflows.

 Run-the-Business (RTB) Ownership 

- Drive Team RTB Engine: Own and manage the day-to-day Run-the-Business (RTB) cadence at the team level, ensuring operational momentum and accountability.

- Facilitate Operational Rhythms: Facilitate regular operational forums, including team OKR tracking, and deal approval workflows.

 Qualifications  

 Twilio values diverse experiences from all kinds of industries, and we encourage everyone who meets the required qualifications to apply. If your career is just starting or hasn't followed a traditional path, don't let that stop you from considering Twilio. We are always looking for people who will bring something new to the table!

 *Required: 

- 5+ years of experience in management consulting or as a Program Manager or Chief of Staff in telecom, RevOps, or strategy and operations. 

- Proven track record leading highly visible, cross-functional programs across business, technical, legal, and financial stakeholders.

- Demonstrated expertise driving end-to-end process improvements by integrating policies, business processes, IT/systems tools, and operational controls.

- Direct experience standing up operating models, team cadences, and operational documentation (runbooks, frameworks, ROEs).

- Proven track record in designing enablement content and driving organizational change. 

- Experience driving Run-the-Business (RTB) cadences, OKR tracking, and operational reporting.

- Strong capability in process mapping, business case writing, and translating complex operational needs into IT system specs.

- Sharp written and verbal communication skills with experience presenting to executive leadership.

- Strong analytical proficiency using data tools (Excel/Google Sheets, SQL, or Looker) to measure performance and policy compliance.

- Team player who thrives in a fast-paced environment.

 Desired: 

- Background in management consulting, high-growth tech, or global telecom environments.

- Six Sigma or formal Program / Process Management / Prosci Change Management certification.

- Operational experience within commercial Deal Desks, supplier QBR management, or revenue assurance.

- Domain knowledge of A2P SMS, international voice/messaging, carrier billing, or AIT/IRSF fraud frameworks.

- Familiarity with workflow and dashboarding tools (Airtable, Jira, Confluence) and operational automation (Python, Coefficient, AI tooling).

 Location 

 This role will be remote and based in Ontario, British Columbia or Alberta, Canada.

 Travel  

 We prioritize connection and opportunities to build relationships with our customers and each other. For this role, you may be required to travel occasionally to participate in project or team in-person meetings.

 What We Offer 

 Working at Twilio offers many benefits, including competitive pay, generous time off, ample parental and wellness leave, healthcare, a retirement savings program, and much more. Offerings vary by location. Based on role, employees may also be eligible for additional compensation and benefits, including but not limited to incentive programs, commissions, equity grants, health and wellness benefits, retirement contributions, and paid time off.

 The estimated pay ranges for this role are as follows:

- 

- $ 90,800.00 - $ 113,500.00 

- Target Bonus Percentage 12.5%

 The successful candidate’s starting salary will be determined based on permissible, non-discriminatory factors such as skills, experience, and geographic location.

 Application deadline information  

 Applications for this role are intended to be accepted until November 1, 2026 but may change based on business needs. 
 Twilio thinks big. Do you? 

 We like to solve problems, take initiative, pitch in when needed, and are always up for trying new things. That's why we seek out colleagues who embody our values — something we call Twilio Magic . Additionally, we empower employees to build positive change in their communities by supporting their volunteering and donation efforts.

workday:unitytech/Unity:JOBREQ-2616621.description:
The opportunity 

 Unity powers the majority of top mobile games and underpins real-time 3D experiences in nearly every country on earth. When studios and developers decide how to build, ship, and monetize, Unity is usually what they choose. The tools we build shape what the entire industry can make. 

 Product marketing at Unity spans the engine developers build in, the services they use to ship and operate live games, the ecosystem of tools and partners around them, and the AI capabilities now being built into all of it. Each of those reaches a technical audience that evaluates claims carefully and has little patience for marketing that outruns the product. 
 We are looking for an experienced product marketer to take on a defined body of that work on a contract basis. You will pick up a product area or a set of launches, own the marketing for it end to end, and produce work that ships. This is a role for someone who can arrive with limited context, ask the right questions quickly, and start producing positioning, launch plans and enablement material without waiting to be told how. 

 Scope of the engagement 

- Duration: initial engagement of 1yr, with the possibility of extension based on business need. 

- Location: fully remote or near one of our many hub locations: NYC, SF, MTV, MTL, etc . We ask for meaningful working-hour overlap with US time zones, since product and marketing reviews run on that clock. 

- Commitment: full-time equivalent hours for the duration of the engagement. 

 What you'll be doing 

- Positioning and narrative — Own the positioning and messaging for the product areas assigned to you. Translate technical capability into obvious workflow value, and write the narrative that Sales, Community and Content all work from. 

- Go-to-market execution — Lead go-to-market for launches, betas and feature rollouts: tiering, audience targeting, channel plan, enablement and launch-day execution, followed by an honest read on what worked. 

- Audience definition — Define precisely who a product is for, from indie creators to technical directors, and document it clearly enough that other teams can act on it without reinterpreting it. 

- Developer credibility — Developers are inherently skeptical of marketing claims, and increasingly so of AI claims. Write messaging that earns credibility with practitioners rather than hyping past them, working with Community and DevRel to meet developers where the real discussions happen. 

- Competitive and market intelligence — Track the relevant landscape and turn market shifts into sharp positioning and usable sales material. 

- Voice of the customer — Turn forum threads, interviews and community feedback into signal that product and marketing teams can actually use. 

- Enablement and content — Equip Sales, Success and Support with pitch decks, battlecards and objection handling. Partner with Content marketing on launch assets and developer-facing material. 

- Partner and ecosystem marketing — Where an initiative involves third-party tools or platform partners, drive the joint go-to-market and co-marketing motion. 

- Measurement — Work with Product and Analytics to define what success looks like for each launch in advance, and report against it afterwards. 

 What we're looking for 

- 7-9 years in product marketing or go-to-market roles , with a clear track record of owning a product line or a major launch end to end. 

- Game production fluency — a background in games, or a deep grasp of modern development pipelines and creator workflows. Strongly preferred. 

- Proven experience marketing to technical audiences such as developers, engineers or technical artists, and the credibility to win over users whose default posture is skepticism. 

- Exceptional writing. You can turn complex technology into a crisp, obvious narrative across a launch page, a keynote section, a battlecard or a Slack thread with engineers. 

- Independent operator. Contract engagements come with less context and less standing than a permanent role. You need to be comfortable getting yourself oriented, driving work forward across teams you have just met, and producing finished artifacts rather than waiting for direction. 

- High comfort with ambiguity , including early-stage products where the strategy is still moving and the roadmap shifts underneath you. 

- Strong data literacy. You can set the right metrics, read performance signals honestly, and change course on evidence. 

- Strong with AI tools such as Claude Code, Gemini or similar, and a practical sense of how to use them to move faster without letting the output go out unchecked. 

 Nice to have 

- Platform and ecosystem go-to-market — experience marketing developer platforms, game engines, SDKs or plugin ecosystems. 

- Direct experience with AI or ML products , and the technical judgment to tell a production-ready capability from a good demo. 

- Hands-on creation experience — you have shipped something in Unity or a comparable real-time creation tool. 

- Partner co-marketing — a track record running joint go-to-market motions with major technology partners. 

- Category creation — experience taking a product through a market shift and educating users on a new way of working. 

- Prior contract or consulting experience inside a large matrixed organisation, where you have had to be effective without formal authority. 

 Base Salary Range: We determine the base salary range for this role based on your primary work location: 

 Zone A: $72.12 – $90.14 USD/hour
 Zone B: $81.25 – $103.37 USD/hour
 Zone C: $91.59 – $114.47 USD/hour

 Cette fourchette correspond au salaire de base prévu pour ce poste. En plus du salaire de base, ce poste peut donner droit à des attributions d’actions et à une participation à nos programmes d’incitation de l’entreprise, comme des primes annuelles discrétionnaires ou des commissions de vente. Le montant final de l’offre dépendra de plusieurs facteurs, notamment l’emplacement géographique ainsi que l’expérience pertinente, le parcours professionnel et les compétences du/de la candidat(e).

 This range reflects the anticipated base salary for this position. Beyond base salary, this role may be eligible for equity awards and participation in our company incentive plans (such as annual discretionary bonuses or sales commissions). The final offer amount will depend on several factors, including geographic location and the candidate’s relevant experience, professional background, and skill set. 
 Avantages 

 Chez Unity, nous voulons que nos membres d’équipe s’épanouissent. Nous offrons un large éventail d’avantages conçus pour soutenir le bien-être et l’équilibre travail-vie personnelle.

 Veuillez noter: L’admissibilité aux avantages, les offres spécifiques et la couverture varient selon le pays et le statut d’emploi.

 Bien que les avantages précis puissent varier, voici certaines des façons dont nous nous efforçons de prendre soin de nos membres d’équipe admissibles à l’échelle mondiale : assurance santé, vie et invalidité complète | Subvention pour les déplacements | Participation des employés à l’actionnariat | Régimes de retraite/pension compétitifs | Vacances et congés personnels généreux | Soutien aux nouveaux parents grâce à des congés et des programmes de soutien aux familles | Collations offertes au bureau | Programmes et soutien en matière de santé mentale et de bien-être | Groupes-ressources pour employés | Programme mondial d’aide aux employés | Programmes de formation et de perfectionnement | Programme de bénévolat et de jumelage de dons

Vous serez intégré(e) au sein de nos équipes de développement, où vous recueillerez des données et des commentaires détaillés afin d'orienter nos feuilles de route, tout en dégageant une vision claire de l'utilisation par la clientèle, de la demande pour les fonctionnalités déployées, de celles en cours de développement, ainsi que des futurs axes de croissance.

 Ce que vous ferez 

- Piloter la feuille de route de la plateforme mobile en déterminant les investissements requis pour permettre aux développeur(se)s de lancer des jeux performants et de haute qualité sur l'ensemble du matériel mobile.

- Collaborer étroitement avec la clientèle et les gestionnaires de produit de la plateforme pour cerner de nouveaux besoins, définir les exigences relatives aux fonctionnalités et valider celles en cours de développement.

- Négocier avec les partenaires de plateforme et harmoniser les orientations afin qu'Unity conserve une longueur d'avance sur les changements de plateforme et l'arrivée de nouvelles catégories d'appareils.

- Traduire des feuilles de route hautement techniques en récits stratégiques destinés aux dirigeant(e)s et aux publics externes, tout en assurant le lien entre les équipes de plateforme d'Unity afin que les enjeux transversaux soient soulevés, harmonisés et planifiés adéquatement.

- Une excellente maîtrise des plateformes mobiles, incluant une solide compréhension des cycles de vie du développement logiciel, des API et de l'abstraction matérielle, avec une expertise reconnue sur Android.

- Des antécédents éprouvés d'influence auprès de la haute direction, de gestion des interdépendances organisationnelles complexes et de relations avec de multiples parties prenantes.

- De solides compétences en communication technique et la capacité de transformer les commentaires et les demandes de la clientèle en besoins sous-jacents et en objectifs plus larges, tout en formulant des concepts complexes de façon claire et concise pour les collaborateur(rice)s non technique(s).

- De solides capacités analytiques et une expérience avec les outils d'analyse de données, ainsi qu'une empathie démontrée envers les utilisateur(rice)s et une prise de décision fondée sur les données.

 Atouts additionnels 

- Une expérience pratique du lancement d'un jeu ou d'une application interactive à l'aide d'Unity, ou d'autres outils de développement 3D en temps réel.

- Une expérience en profilage et en optimisation de la performance sur du matériel mobile.

Zone B : 165 400 $ CA – 248 000 $ CA (brut)
Zone A : 157 800 $ US – 236 800 $ US (brut)

 As a Staff Technical Product Manager at Unity, you will be part of the platform product management team with a focus on the systems and capabilities that bring Unity's features to the mobile ecosystem, ensuring developers get a seamless, high-quality experience on every device they ship to. This is a senior role driving the mobile platform roadmap across performance optimization, cross-platform expansion, and developer tooling. You'll be embedded alongside our engineering teams, gathering detailed data and feedback to help shape our roadmaps and providing insight into customer use, demand for shipped features, features in development, and future areas of growth.  

 What you’ll be doing 

- Own the mobile platform roadmap, identifying where Unity must invest so developers can ship high-quality, high-performing games across the full range of mobile hardware. 

- Work closely with customers and platform PMs to discover new user needs, define feature requirements, and validate features in development. 

- Negotiate and align with platform partners to keep Unity ahead of platform shifts and new device categories. 

- Translate highly technical roadmaps into strategic narratives for executive and external audiences, and serve as connective tissue across Unity's platform teams so cross-team concerns are surfaced, aligned on, and planned appropriately. 

 What we’re looking for 

- Technical product management experience shipping complex developer tools or OS-level products, or a strong engineering or game development background in combination. 

- Deep mobile platform fluency , including a solid understanding of software development lifecycles, APIs, and hardware abstraction, with demonstrated Android depth . 

- A proven track record of influencing senior leadership, navigating large organizational dependencies, and managing complex stakeholder relationships. 

- Strong technical communication skills and the ability to convert customer feedback and requests into hidden needs and deeper goals, while articulating sophisticated concepts concisely for non-technical collaborators. 

- Strong analytical abilities and experience working with data analysis tools, and demonstrated user empathy and data-driven decision-making. 

 You might also have (optional) 

- Hands-on experience shipping a game or interactive application using Unity, or other real-time 3D development tools. 

- Experience with performance profiling and optimization on mobile hardware.

greenhouse:varicent:5435569008.description:
At Varicent, we’re not just transforming the Sales Performance Management (SPM) market—we’re redefining how organizations achieve revenue success. Our cutting-edge SaaS solutions empower revenue leaders globally to design smarter go-to-market strategies, maximize seller performance, and unlock untapped potential. Varicent stands at the forefront of innovation, celebrated as a market leader in the  2025 Forrester Wave Report for SPM ,  2023 Ventana Research Revenue Performance Management (RPM) Value Index ,  Gartner Peer Insights ,  2024 Gartner SPM Market Guide , and  G2.  Our solutions are trusted by a diverse range of global industry leaders like T-Mobile, ServiceNow, Wawanesa Bank, Shaw Industries, Moody's, Stryker and hundreds more. Here’s why you’ll thrive at Varicent:

- Innovate with Purpose: Build impactful solutions for customers worldwide. 

- Join Excellence: Work in a diverse, collaborative, and innovative team. 

- Shape the Future: Lead in redefining revenue optimization. 

- Grow Together: Unlock your potential in a supportive environment. 

 Join us at Varicent—where your talent and ambition meet limitless opportunities for success!

 Summary of the Role and Team 

 As Director of Deal Desk & Pricing, you will lead and scale Varicent's Deal Desk function, serving as the central authority for deal governance, pricing operations, quote-to-booking processes, and commercial execution. You'll work closely with Sales, Customer Success, Renewals, Finance, Legal, Product, and Revenue Operations to drive pricing accuracy, data integrity, operational efficiency, and compliance throughout the customer lifecycle. This role combines strategic leadership with hands-on execution — you'll establish the processes, governance frameworks, systems alignment, and team structure that enable scalable growth. This is a people leadership role: you'll manage and grow Deal Desk professionals while improving deal velocity, profitability, forecasting accuracy, and operational excellence.

 What You Will Be Doing 

- Lead and develop the Deal Desk team, including coaching, performance management, capacity planning, and workload prioritization.

- Establish and run Deal Desk operating processes: deal intake, approvals, escalations, service-level expectations, and stakeholder communications.

- Own quote-to-booking governance for new business, renewals, expansions, and cross-sell opportunities, ensuring pricing accuracy and policy compliance.

- Work with Sales and Customer Success on deal structuring, pricing decisions, exception management, and commercial approvals.

- Maintain data integrity and system alignment across Salesforce, CPQ platforms, pricing tools, and related commercial systems.

- Partner with Finance on forecasting activities, revenue recognition requirements, commercial risk assessments, and audit readiness.

- Build and maintain governance frameworks, policies, documentation, and enablement resources that drive consistent business practices.

- Lead process improvement and change management initiatives to reduce deal cycle times and improve scalability and reporting quality.

 What You Bring 

- Demonstrated expertise in Deal Desk, Pricing, Revenue Operations, Commercial Operations, FP&A, Commercial Finance, or related business functions (typically gained over 10–12+ years)

- Experience leading teams, programs, or cross-functional operational functions (typically 5+ years)

- Experience with complex B2B sales motions, including new business, renewals, expansions, and cross-sell transactions

- Expertise in Deal Desk operations, pricing governance, quote-to-booking workflows, commercial approvals, and process design

- Experience working with Salesforce, DealHub CPQ, or comparable CPQ/CRM platforms

- Solid grasp of how pricing structures, commercial terms, ACV, and contract structures impact forecasting and revenue recognition

- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with a track record of using operational data to improve business processes and decisions

- Ability to influence senior stakeholders across Sales, Finance, Legal, Customer Success, Product, and Revenue Operations

 Success Outcomes 

 First 90 Days 

- Build a working understanding of Varicent's pricing structure, commercial processes, systems landscape, and quote-to-booking workflows.

- Establish strong relationships with Sales, Customer Success, Finance, Legal, Product, and Revenue Operations stakeholders.

- Assess current Deal Desk processes, governance controls, approval workflows, and reporting capabilities.

- Identify opportunities to improve deal execution efficiency, data quality, and process consistency.

 Within 6 Months 

- Roll out clear governance frameworks, approval structures, and operational standards across the Deal Desk function.

- Raise quote quality, pricing accuracy, and first-pass approval rates while cutting rework and processing delays.

- Set up consistent forecasting workflows with Finance using Deal Desk insights and commercial data.

- Strengthen data integrity and alignment across Salesforce, CPQ platforms, pricing tools, and related systems.

- Develop scalable team operating rhythms and performance metrics aligned to business objectives.

 Within 12 Months 

- Position Deal Desk as a go-to strategic partner across Go-To-Market, Finance, and Executive teams.

- Show measurable gains in deal cycle times, pricing governance, compliance, and forecasting accuracy.

- Deliver scalable quote-to-booking processes that support growth while maintaining strong controls and audit readiness.

- Build a high-performing Deal Desk organization with clear accountability and operational excellence.

- Create a sustainable operating model that supports revenue growth, profitability objectives, and commercial scalability.

 This posting is for a  existing vacancy.   

 This hiring process utilizes artificial intelligence tools to assist in candidate screening and assessment. Our AI tools are designed to complement — not replace — human decision-making.   

 Overview of Benefits:   

- Health & Wellness — Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage tailored to your local needs 

- Time Off — PTO and public holidays to rest, recharge, and do what matters most 

- Volunteer Days — Dedicated time to give back and support the communities that matter to you 

- Ignite Days — Dedicated learning days to support continuous growth, skill development, and professional learning 

- Financial — Compensation that reflects your market and your value 

- Retirement — Retirement plans designed to help you build long-term financial security 

- Tuition Assistance — Invest in your growth with support for continuing education and professional development 

- Flexibility — Work where you thrive, with remote and hybrid options available across most regions 

 Varicent is committed to creating a diverse environment and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status. If you require accommodation at any time during the recruitment process please email accomodations@varicent.com

 Varicent is also committed to compliance with all fair employment practices regarding citizenship and immigration status.  Summary of the Role and Team 

 As the Senior Director, Product Marketing, you will lead Varicent’s Product Marketing function and play a critical role in shaping the company’s go-to-market strategy, market positioning, category narrative, commercialization approach, and revenue growth initiatives.

 Reporting as a senior marketing leader, you will lead and develop a team of Product Marketing professionals responsible for translating market insights, customer needs, competitive intelligence, and product innovation into differentiated messaging, sales enablement, launch execution, and measurable business results.

 This role partners closely with Product, Sales, Customer Success, Revenue Operations, Alliances, Marketing, and Executive Leadership to strengthen Varicent’s market position, accelerate growth, and support the successful adoption and expansion of Varicent’s solutions.

 What You Will Be Doing 

- 
 Lead and develop the Product Marketing organization, establishing priorities, operating rhythms, team goals, and performance measures aligned to business objectives

- 
 Define and evolve product positioning, messaging frameworks, buyer personas, value propositions, and market narratives across Varicent’s solution portfolio

- 
 Partner with Product leadership to influence roadmap priorities, commercialization strategies, packaging decisions, and market readiness activities

- 
 Lead product launches and go-to-market initiatives, ensuring alignment across Product, Sales, Customer Success, Demand Generation, Enablement, and Partner organizations

- 
 Drive sales enablement programs, competitive intelligence initiatives, and value-based messaging that improve seller effectiveness and customer engagement

- 
 Lead market, customer, analyst, and competitive research efforts to identify growth opportunities, market trends, and differentiation strategies

- 
 Champion the strategic use of AI-enabled workflows and modern marketing technologies to improve research, content creation, enablement, and operational effectiveness

- 
 Provide strategic market insights and recommendations to executive leadership regarding category evolution, competitive dynamics, growth opportunities, and go-to-market performance

 What You Bring 

- 12+ years of experience in B2B technology organizations, with significant experience in enterprise SaaS, Revenue Operations, Sales Performance Management, sales technology, HR technology, financial planning technology, or related enterprise software markets

- 7+ years of Product Marketing experience , including ownership of positioning, messaging, go-to-market strategy, commercialization, or product launches

- 3+ years of experience leading and developing Product Marketing teams , including managing senior individual contributors, people leaders, or Product Marketing managers

- Demonstrated success influencing go-to-market strategy and driving measurable business outcomes such as pipeline growth, revenue impact, customer adoption, retention, expansion, or market differentiation

- Experience partnering with Product, Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, and Executive teams on commercialization and growth initiatives

- Ability to transform market insights, customer challenges, and product capabilities into compelling business narratives and positioning strategies

- Experience leveraging generative AI technologies and AI-enabled workflows to improve marketing effectiveness, scalability, and insight generation

- Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business, Communications, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent experience

 Nice to Have 

-

workday:visa/Visa:REF087532W.description:
About Us 
Visa is a world leader in payments technology, facilitating transactions between consumers, merchants, financial institutions and government entities across more than 200 countries and territories, dedicated to uplifting everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid.

 At Visa, you'll have the opportunity to create impact at scale — tackling meaningful challenges, growing your skills and seeing your contributions impact lives around the world.

 Join Visa and do work that matters – to you, to your community, and to the world. Progress starts with you.

 Job Description 

 Commercial and Money Movement Solutions (CMS) represents a key strategic growth area for Visa globally as we expand beyond consumer payments into business payments and broader money movement flows among individuals, businesses and governments. As part of our suite of solutions, including Visa Commercial Solutions, Visa Direct, Visa B2B Connect and Visa Cross-Border Solutions, Visa offers payment services that help clients, including issuers, fintechs, acquirers, processors, merchants and service providers, facilitate payment and money movement between accounts, cards and digital wallets in Canada and around the world.   

 The Senior Manager, Strategy & Operations will support the VP, Head of Commercial & Money Movement Solutions (CMS) for Visa Canada and the CMS Canada leadership team in driving growth planning, strategic initiatives, performance management and business operations for this high-growth business in Canada. This role will help translate CMS priorities into clear plans, operating rhythms, reporting, insights and execution support across the Canadian business.   

 Operating in a matrixed environment, this role will work closely with teams across Visa Canada and North America, including Visa Commercial Solutions, Visa Money Movement Solutions, Real-Time Payments, Open Banking, sales, product, client consulting, marketing, corporate communications, legal, finance, risk and other functional partners. Strong organizational skills, analytical capability and interpersonal effectiveness are critical, as this role helps coordinate cross-functional activities and support alig nment against CMS Canada's business objectives.   

 The ideal candidate will be able to quickly build subject matter depth across a range of payments, commercial and money movement topics, synthesize qualitative and quantitative information, and translate analysis into practical insights and recommendations for leadership. The role requires strong analytical and critical thinking skills, comfort working through ambiguity, and the ability to manage multiple workstreams while maintaining attention to detail and execution discipline.   

 Best-suited candidates will be clear communicators, highly collaborative, self-motivated, analytical and comfortable working with stakeholders from a diversity of backgrounds. The Senior Manager will be expected to support strategy development, operating cadence, executive reporting, business planning and priority initiatives that help CMS Canada continue to grow and operate effectively.   

 Essential Functions   

 Financial Management & Scorecard Reporting   

- Support CMS Canada management reporting including scorecards, dashboards, financial reporting, business performance updates and strategic initiative tracking.   

- Track budgets, contractual commitments and key business metrics in partnership with Finance and business owners, identifying risks, gaps and areas requiring leadership attention.   

- Maintain reporting discipline and data quality by coordinating inputs, validating information and ensuring timely updates through appropriate tools and processes, including Dynamics where applicable.   

 Sales Enablement & Operations   

- Support core sales operations activities including client engagement survey reporting, action planning, client event coordination and management of priority sponsorship assets for client engagement.   

- Partner with sales and product teams to organize client-facing priorities, track follow-ups, prepare materials and help ensure key initiatives move from planning to execution.   

- Help improve operating processes by identifying friction points, documenting requirements and recommending practical ways to improve speed, visibility and accountability.   

 Annual Planning Process   

- Support annual business planning for CMS Canada including planning calendars, inputs, goal setting, objective tracking, scorecard development and coordination of annual account sales plans.   

- Prepare analysis and materials to support leadership discussions on priorities, resources, performance expectations and growth opportunities.   

- Coordinate planning inputs across functions and help ensure alignment with Canada market priorities and North America CMS planning requirements.   

 Strategic Initiatives & PMO Support   

- Lead or support workstreams for CMS Canada strategic initiatives including project plans, milestones, risks, dependencies, business cases, analysis and action plans.   

- Act as PMO support for priority initiatives by tracking progress, coordinating stakeholders, surfacing issues and ensuring follow-through against agreed actions.   

- Develop fact-based analysis and recommendations to support strategic and financial soundness, including quantitative analysis, market context and stakeholder input.   

 Strategic Alignment with Functional Partners   

- Collaborate with Marketing, Communications, Government Relations and other functional teams to support external presence strategy across CMS business lines, including industry events, speaking opportunities, client forums and market-facing materials.   

- Facilitate alignment with internal strategy and operations partners including Canada market teams and North America functional groups across Visa Commercial Solutions, Visa Direct, Consumer Payments and related teams.   

- Support operating rhythms and governance that help CMS Canada leadership make timely decisions, manage priorities and maintain cross-functional accountability.   

 Insights & Thought Leadership Development   

- Generate data-driven insights by analyzing Visa data, market reports, benchmarks and internal performance information to identify opportunities, risks and trends.   

- Monitor payments industry developments and competitor strategies and develop executive summaries or strategic responses that inform CMS Canada priorities.   

- Support quarterly strategy, planning and operations reviews by developing clear, concise and leadership-ready analysis, narratives and presentation materials.   

 CMS Canada Narrative & Executive Materials   

- Support development of internal and external leadership materials including senior executive briefings, Visa Canada Advisory Board content, client quarterly business reviews, industry forum presentations and strategic updates.   

- Translate complex topics into clear business narratives that connect CMS Canada strategy, performance, market context and client priorities.   

- Maintain a consistent CMS Canada narrative across planning, reporting, leadership forums and priority communications.   

 Team Culture & Operational Effectiveness   

- Support CMS Canada team culture and engagement activities including team-wide communications, operating meetings, engagement initiatives, recruiting process support and priority event coordination.   

- Track progress against key operational initiatives and help ensure actions, owners and timelines are clear across the CMS Canada team.   

- Provide ad hoc strategic and operational support to the Head of CMS Canada and leadership team to enable effective management of the business.   

 Visa requires at least 3 days in office, expectations of these days will be confirmed by your Hiring Manager.   

 Qualifications 

 Basic Qualifications: 

- 8 or more years of relevant work experience with a Bachelor's Degree or at least 5 years of experience with an Advanced Degree (e.g. Masters, MBA, JD, MD) or 2 years of work experience with a PhD.

 Preferred Qualifications: 

- 9+ years of relevant work experience with a Bachelor’s Degree, or 7+ years of relevant work experience with an Advanced Degree (e.g., Masters, MBA, JD, MD), or 3+ years of work experience with a PhD.   

- Experience in strategy, business operations, sales operations, business planning, performance management, management consulting, payments, financial services, fintech, banking or related technology sectors.   

- Strong analytical skill set with the ability to frame business opportunities and risks in commercial, operational and financial terms.   

- Excellent project management skills, including the ability to manage multiple workstreams, stakeholders, dependencies and deadlines simultaneously.   

- Demonstrated ability to synthesize qualitative and quantitative information, develop actionable insights and prepare clear recommendations for leadership.   

- Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to produce executive-ready presentations, dashboards, briefing materials and business narratives.   

- Strong interpersonal skills with the ability to build trust, collaborate effectively and influence across a matrixed organization without direct authority.   

- Experience with management reporting, scorecards, dashboards, financial tracking, business reviews, strategic planning or operating cadence management preferred.   

- Knowledge of payments, commercial payments, money movement, Visa Direct, Visa Commercial Solutions, real-time payments, open banking, card-based payments or related ecosystems is an asset.   

- Technology and data savvy, with comfort using data insights, financial models, operational reporting or CRM / sales tools to support business growth and decision-making.   

- Creative self-starter with a bias toward action, strong attention to detail and the ability to move work forward in a fast-paced environment.   

- Curiosity and willingness to learn, with high integrity, sound judgment and strong business ethics.   

- Team-oriented, collaborative, diplomatic and flexible, with the ability to work effectively with stakeholders from diverse backgrounds and functions.   

- MBA or relevant graduate degree preferred.   

 Visa is an EEO Employer 
 Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or protected veteran status. Visa will also consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with EEOC guidelines and applicable local law.

 Visa welcome and encourages application from persons with disabilities. Accommodations are available on request for candidates taking part in all aspects of the selection process.

ashby:visier:d4cbef2a-5935-4ac4-9ae9-449.title: Privacy and AI Program Manager
ashby:visier:d4cbef2a-5935-4ac4-9ae9-449.description:
Visier is the global leader in Workforce Intelligence that powers every people decision. We bring Workforce AI to life for HR departments through our award-winning, agentic AI technology by surfacing the insights leaders need to plan, decide, and act with confidence in the moments that matter most. As the market leader in people analytics, workforce planning, organizational design, and manager effectiveness solutions, we fuel smarter decision-making for organizations across the globe. Our mission is to help businesses lead with insight at scale as they continuously transform.

Founded in 2010 by the pioneers of business intelligence, we have over 85,000 customers in 75 countries—including enterprises like BASF, Panasonic, Domino’s Pizza, Experian, Amgen, eBay, and Ford Motor Company.


POSITION OVERVIEW



As the Privacy and AI Program Manager, you will operationalize the evolution of our privacy program to encompass the rapidly changing landscape of artificial intelligence. You will embed responsible AI, Privacy by Design, and data protection across our SaaS development lifecycle, directly enabling our strategic shift toward outcomes-based selling. By acting as the operational bridge between legal, product, security, and our customers, you ensure our data practices build the trust required to accelerate deal velocity and drive measurable business impact.

You are a seasoned privacy enabler who thrives on simplifying complexity for diverse stakeholders, ensuring our customers feel confident in our data governance. You will use your deep domain expertise in global privacy and AI regulations to protect our business while empowering our sales and product teams to move fast and win.





WHAT YOU WILL DELIVER:

 - Outcomes-Based Sales Enablement: Accelerate the sales cycle and drive revenue by clearly articulating our privacy posture and AI governance to enterprise prospects, directly supporting our transition to outcomes-based selling.

 - EU AI Act & Global Compliance: Operationalize strategic readiness for the EU AI Act and other emerging global AI regulations, translating complex legislative requirements into actionable product standards.

 - Automated Decision Making Governance: Establish and maintain robust frameworks for transparency, fairness, and human oversight in automated decision-making processes, mitigating bias and ensuring compliance with evolving data protection laws.

 - Responsible AI Integration: Partner internally to conduct Data Protection Impact Assessments (DPIAs) and review AI use cases, identifying risks early in the software development lifecycle.

 - Data Subject Protection & Trust: Champion the continuous privacy and protection of data subjects across both Visier's internal employee workforce and the millions of employees represented within our customers' data. With a customer base that includes a significant portion of the Fortune 1000 and major multinationals, you will ensure our data governance strategies provide uncompromising security, ethical handling, and compliance for highly sensitive information at global scale.
   
    


WHAT YOU WILL BRING TO THE TABLE:

 - Education & Experience: 4+ years of blended experience managing global privacy programs (GDPR, CCPA) within a B2B Enterprise SaaS environment, including direct exposure to AI/ML data governance.

 - Commercial Muscle: A proven track record of supporting enterprise sales and renewal cycles by translating complex privacy controls into customer-facing value and trust.

 - Regulatory Competency: Core understanding of current data protection laws and emerging frameworks (including the EU AI Act and automated decision making legislation), with the ability to operationalize these rules without slowing down the pace of development.

 - Technical Fluency: Solid understanding of data flows, cloud infrastructure, and AI models, enabling you to confidently collaborate with engineering teams on system design.

 - Cross-Functional Influence: Strong communication skills geared toward building productive working relationships with technical, legal, and commercial stakeholders.

 - Agile Problem Solving: A scrappy, roll-up-your-sleeves mentality with a proven track record of finding practical, scalable solutions to novel compliance challenges.
   
    



Benefits and working arrangements may vary depending on your seniority, location and employment type. The compensation offered will be determined by factors such as relevant qualifications, experience, knowledge and skills. Many of our positions are eligible for additional compensation such as commission or bonus plans. Your Talent Acquisition partner will walk through the details if you interview for the role.



AI in Hiring
As a people analytics company, we think carefully about how AI is used in decisions that affect people, including our own. Our Talent Acquisition team uses AI tools to help review resumes and application responses, so every candidate's application is assessed quickly and consistently against the role's requirements. AI may also assist with scheduling and summarizing interview notes. These tools support our team; they don't replace it. Every hiring decision at Visier is made by a person, not an algorithm.


How you prepare is up to you, and there's no issue with using AI as a helpful tool along the way. What matters most to us is that what you share, whether in your application or in conversation with us, reflects your own real experience and skills. We ask that live interviews be AI-free, so we can get to know how you communicate, think through problems, and describe the work you've actually done. We reserve the right to end the interview early if candidate fraud is suspected.


If you have questions about how AI is used in our process or how your data is handled, review our Visier Candidate Privacy Notice https://www.visier.com/candidate-privacy-notice-and-recruiter-policy/ or reach out to us.
