Waabi, founded by AI visionary Raquel Urtasun, is the leader in Physical AI. With a world-class team, we're unlocking the next era of autonomous transportation with technology that's powering commercial autonomous trucks and robotaxis. Waabi is backed by and partners with world leaders in AI, automotive, logistics, and deep tech.
 
With offices in Toronto, San Francisco, Dallas, and Pittsburgh, Waabi is growing quickly and looking for diverse, innovative and collaborative candidates who want to impact the world in a positive way. To learn more visit: www.waabi.ai


We are seeking a Product Manager to lead product definition for the hardware platform that carries the Waabi Driver, across autonomous trucks and robotaxi. This is our first dedicated hardware product role, and it requires someone who is grounded in hardware: a product leader who can turn the needs of autonomy, safety, operations, riders, and the public into clear requirements, and who knows enough about hardware to tell an ambitious idea from an impossible one. You will sit at the line between requirements and implementation, laying out scenarios, testing ideas in mock-ups and vehicles, partnering with hardware engineering on high-level solutions, and representing product with our OEM and supplier partners until the product is right end-to-end.
You will...
Own product requirements for Waabi's hardware platform across trucks and robotaxi, turning field and integration feedback into requirements for future revisions and new vehicle platforms.
Define how our vehicles interact with the people around them, including riders, law enforcement, first responders, and the public. This covers exterior communication and signaling, cabin monitoring and security, in-cabin safety, and resilience to tampering and vandalism.
Lead product definition for new hardware programs before engineering kickoff, turning real-world scenarios into requirements with clear acceptance criteria and a plan to verify and validate each one.
Bring an industrial design and human factors perspective to physical touchpoints like displays, lighting, reach, and controls, and validate them hands-on in mock-ups and real vehicles.
Build trusted relationships with OEM and supplier partners, understanding their constraints and processes and keeping requirements aligned across organizations.
Represent hardware credibly in cross-functional product decisions about what's possible, what's costly, and what's out of scope.
Qualifications:
A hardware background, through an engineering degree (mechanical, electrical, systems, or similar) or equivalent hands-on experience, deep enough to earn engineering teams' trust while you work at the requirements level.
8+ years of experience in product management, hardware product, or systems engineering roles on physical products, ideally in automotive, autonomous vehicles, robotics, or complex consumer hardware.
A track record of taking hardware from concept to production, with an understanding of how requirements evolve across prototype and sample stages.
Industrial design experience, through formal training or close work with industrial designers on shipped products, and strong instincts for HMI and human factors.
Strong requirements writing skills. You can turn a messy real-world scenario into a clear, testable requirement, with acceptance criteria and a verification method such as test, analysis, inspection, or demonstration.
Experience building working relationships with OEMs and suppliers, and an understanding of how they develop, source, and deliver hardware.
A commitment to trust, transparency, and honesty in a safety-critical environment.
Willingness to be on site regularly for mock-ups, vehicle evaluations, and testing.
Bonus/nice to have:
Experience on autonomous vehicles or robotaxi, especially rider experience, external communication with road users, or first responder interaction.
Familiarity with automotive development processes such as APQP, PPAP, and A/B/C sample phases.
Exposure to functional safety and AV safety standards such as ISO 26262, SOTIF (ISO 21448), or UL 4600, or to vehicle regulations.

Waabi's Commercial Product team defines and delivers the end-to-end commercial product that makes autonomous trucking deployable, scalable, and valuable to customers. We sit between autonomy, operations, business development, and customers, turning driverless capability into a real-world product that can be launched, sold, operated, and scaled.
As Waabi rapidly scales from commercial pilots to large-scale driverless deployments, this role serves as the critical integration layer between truck supply, customer commitments, expansion efforts, site activations, and autonomy capabilities. You will manage the execution of the commercial plan, proactively tracking dependencies and mitigating risks to drive clear commercial progress.
We are hiring a Senior Program Manager to own and align the single integrated commercialization plan, ensuring every element converges seamlessly.
While functional program leads manage their respective areas, you will integrate their milestones into the overarching commercial plan. Success relies on sound judgment: identifying critical dependencies, distinguishing real timeline slips, and resolving decision bottlenecks. A year from now, when leadership asks whether we are on track for a launch, a truck delivery or a customer commitment, the answer should be one page, current, and believed by every team on it.
What You'll Do
You will own the integrated commercialization roadmap for trucking and the weekly operating cadence around it. This includes:
Build and own the integrated roadmap that ties customer commitments, OEM truck supply, autonomy and ODD readiness, lane and site activation, Mission Control, operations readiness and Account Management launches to dates, with the dependencies between them made explicit. You own the plan end to end.
Maintain the honest picture: the critical path, the slips, the risks and the decisions needed, surfaced early enough to act on and framed for the people who have to decide.
Lead the execution of key company milestones involving multiple departments at Waabi.
Run the operating cadence, including a weekly cross-functional Truck Program meeting.
Help establish repeatable frameworks, procedures, and decision loops that allow fast and efficient scale.
Produce executive-ready updates and program artifacts.
Communicate clearly with technical, operational, commercial and executive audiences that value first-principles thinking.
What Success Looks Like
Success in this role means the commercial plan converges on purpose rather than by heroics. Specifically, you will have:
Within 90 days, one integrated roadmap that Autonomy, Operations, Sales and Account Management believe, with the Truck Program meeting running off it.
A first driverless launch with no dependency discovered in the final month that was knowable in the first.
Leadership learning about a slip from you, with options, before they learn about it from a customer.
Decisions with a date, an owner and a record, so the same question is not re-decided in three meetings.
Qualifications Required
7+ years in program or product leadership in a complex technical and operational environment (autonomous vehicles, automotive, aerospace, robotics, aviation, defense, logistics or other physical-world deployment).
Track record of integrating programs across teams you did not control, in a business with hardware, software, safety and operations in the loop.
Enough technical fluency to understand why an autonomy or hardware milestone slipped and whether the recovery plan is credible, without needing to be the engineer.
Separates facts, assumptions and risks in how you write and speak; comfortable telling senior people something they do not want to hear, early, with options.
Builds the minimum structure that works and removes or upgrades it when it stops working.
Executive-grade verbal and written communication; most of this role's influence happens in documents and in how a problem is framed.
Set direction for a program others execute, with no direct reports, and being accountable for the outcome anyway.
Strongly Preferred
Ownership mentality: takes initiative and gets into the trenches with key stakeholders.
Varies the degree of detail to the audience and the moment.
Experience running a weekly holistic program review.
Experience taking a physical product from pilot to commercial deployment, where readiness gates and launch dates were real.
Experience working alongside a safety or systems-engineering function on go/no-go decisions.
Experience with OEM or supplier delivery schedules as a dependency in a commercial plan.
Zero-to-one program experience at an early-stage or scaling company.
Nice to have
Direct experience in autonomous trucking, freight or AV commercialization.
Experience working with operations and/or commercial teams.
 
The US yearly salary range for this role is: $140,000 - $180,000 USD in addition to competitive perks & benefits. Waabi US Inc.’s yearly salary ranges are determined based on several factors in accordance with the Company’s compensation practices. Note: The Company provides additional compensation for employees in this role, including equity incentive awards and an annual performance bonus.

Solid problem solving using dependency mapping, critical-path analysis and risk management, with clear options for leadership.
Strong written and verbal communication, equally effective in an OEM executive review and a test-vehicle debug session.
Comfort with ambiguity and a startup pace: filters signal from noise and adds structure without adding overhead.
Open-minded and collaborative team player with the willingness to help others.
Passionate about self-driving technologies, solving hard problems, and creating innovative solutions.
 
Bonus/nice to have:
Solid understanding of how vehicle OEMs plan, gate, validate and decide, including vehicle programs, DVP&R, V&V and supplier management.
Experience with commercial truck or heavy-duty vehicle platforms.
Hands-on experience with test vehicles, vehicle networks such as CAN, and field issue triage.
Experience with program tools such as Jira, and with AI tools that reduce manual tracking.
Technical experience in developing self-driving vehicles.

lever:waveapps:0a531bcc-dbdb-44b0-bfa0-3.description:

The Group Product Manager, Core Services is a strategic and highly technical product leader responsible for defining and scaling the shared services layer that powers product innovation across the organization. This role owns the strategy and execution of core shared services, including orchestration workflows, business capabilities, and reusable platform services, that enable customer-facing product teams to build, launch, and scale experiences efficiently, consistently, and at scale.   This leader manages a team of Product Managers and brings deep platform product management experience with a strong internal customer mindset – driving adoption of shared services, APIs, and workflow capabilities while balancing short-term delivery needs with long-term platform health. This role requires strong business judgment, technical fluency, and influential leadership to partner across the organization and build toward a unified platform vision. ashby:wealthsimple:87df1a4c-b9b9-4080-b1.description:
BUILD SOMETHING PEOPLE LOVE

Wealthsimple is Canada’s leading financial innovator. The company offers a full suite of simple, sophisticated financial products across managed investing, do-it-yourself trading, cryptocurrency, tax filing, spending and saving. Wealthsimple currently serves more than 4 million Canadians and holds over $155 billion in assets under administration. The company was founded in 2014 by a team of financial experts and technology entrepreneurs, and is headquartered in Toronto, Canada.



We're proud of what we've built — and we're just getting started. Read our Culture Manual https://www.wealthsimple.com/en-ca/culture and learn more about how we work https://www.wealthsimple.com/en-ca/careers.




ABOUT THE TEAM

The Financial Risk team is responsible for protecting Wealthsimple and its clients from fraud while enabling safe, fast, and scalable money movement. We own the Decision Platform — a real-time rules engine that processes streaming data to make fraud decisions across every major payment rail — as well as the tooling and automations that power fraud investigation workflows, transaction decisioning, account restrictions, and deposit holds. Our systems are the infrastructure layer that payment and money movement teams plug into to move money safely.




ABOUT THE ROLE

This is a platform PM role with a dual mandate: prevent fraud by building and tuning real-time interventions and decision rules, and enable fraud investigations by building automations and tooling that make our fraud operations team faster and more effective. You'll own a broad surface area — from the streaming decision engine that blocks fraudulent withdrawals in milliseconds, to the case management system that routes alerts to investigators, to the restriction and suspension frameworks that protect compromised accounts.




WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Own the product vision and strategy for the Financial Risk platform, balancing fraud prevention with client experience - every intervention has a cost, and you'll need to make sharp tradeoffs between friction and protection.

 - Drive the roadmap for the Decision Platform, our real-time rules engine that evaluates fraud risk across withdrawals, deposits, e-transfers, crypto transactions, and cheque deposits.

 - Build and improve fraud investigation tooling and automations - including case management workflows, alert deduplication, and enrichment pipelines - that help our fraud operations team investigate and resolve cases faster.

 - Define and evolve the restriction and mitigation framework that enables the right response to fraud signals: suspensions, withdrawal blocks, spend switch blocks, and account-level restrictions.

 - Operate as a platform PM, designing extensible APIs, decision schemas, and integration patterns that payment and money movement teams can reliably plug into as new products and payment rails launch.

 - Partner deeply with Fraud and Data Science teams on fraud model integration, fraud rule development, and the feedback loops that improve detection accuracy over time.

 - Own key risk metrics - fraud loss rates, false positive rates, investigation cycle times, decision latency - and use data to drive prioritization.

 - Break down complex, behind-the-scenes infrastructure projects into discrete phases that deliver value incrementally - this is platform work where the "client" is often another engineering team.
   
   


SKILLS YOU BRING

 - 8+ years of product management experience with significant depth in fraud, risk, or trust & safety - you've built fraud prevention systems, investigation tooling, or risk decisioning platforms and understand the cat-and-mouse dynamics of financial fraud.

 - Experience operating as a platform PM: you've built systems that other teams consume, and you know how to balance internal developer experience with business outcomes. You think in APIs, schemas, and extensibility.

 - Strong technical fluency: you can go deep on streaming architectures, workflow orchestration, and ML model integration. You don't need to write code, but you need to reason about system design tradeoffs with engineering.

 - Comfort with breadth: this role spans real-time decisioning, investigation tooling, restrictions infrastructure, and regulatory reporting. You thrive when context-switching across a wide problem space, not when going narrow.

 - Data-driven decision making: you use quantitative analysis to identify fraud patterns, measure intervention effectiveness, and prioritize investments.

 - Experience working with fraud operations teams: you understand investigation workflows, alert triage, case management, and the tooling that makes analysts productive. You've closed the loop between detection and investigation.

 - A shipping mentality: we don't believe in spending forever analyzing and debating. The best way to validate a fraud rule is to ship it, monitor it, and iterate.

 - Strong communication skills: you can translate complex risk and platform concepts for engineering, operations, compliance, and executive stakeholders.

 - Ability to work independently: biasing towards action to drive projects forward across a broad surface area.




WHY WEALTHSIMPLE?

🌸 Top-tier health benefits and life insurance

📈 Long-term group savings with employer match, through Wealthsimple for Business

🌴 20 vacation days, 4 wellness days, and unlimited sick and mental health days per year*

✈️ 90 days away: work outside Canada for up to 90 days per year*

👥 Employee resource groups, including Rainbow (2SLGBTQ), Women of WS, and Black at WS

🌎 We are a hybrid team with over 1,500 employees across North America. The people are one of the best parts of working here: you'll collaborate with incredibly talented, curious, and driven teammates who are deeply committed to doing great work.

*Unlimited paid sick days, Wellness Days and the 90 day away program do not apply to certain roles. 




ICYMI

Technology & Innovation at Wealthsimple: We move quickly and build thoughtfully. That means we're always looking for better ways to work — whether that's new tools, AI, or rethinking how we approach a problem. We don't expect you to have all the answers, but we do expect curiosity and a willingness to evolve alongside the products we're building.



Inclusion Statement: We're building products for a diverse world, and we need a diverse team to do it well. We strongly encourage applications from everyone, regardless of race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, or disability status.



Accessibility Statement: We're committed to an accessible hiring experience. If you need any accommodations throughout the interview process, please let us know — we'll work with you to make sure you have what you need. We also welcome any feedback on how we can better accommodate candidates with accessibility needs.



AI in Hiring: We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of our hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses. These tools assist our team but don't replace human judgment – all final hiring decisions are made by people. If you have questions about how your data is used, reach out to us.

We’re looking for a Staff Product Manager to own Wealthsimple’s Connectivity Platform, spanning two critical areas:

 - Brokerage & Bank Linking: How clients securely and reliably connect external financial institutions to Wealthsimple.

 - Public API: How clients and partners securely access and use Wealthsimple financial data outside of Wealthsimple.



Together, these capabilities define how Wealthsimple connects to the broader financial ecosystem, and how every product team inside Wealthsimple builds on the external financial data that flows through it. This role will set the strategy for that platform and turn it into a reliable, scalable and differentiated capability for our clients, our product teams and our partners.



This is a platform role with a meaningful client experience surface. You’ll need to be equally comfortable thinking about APIs, data models and platform architecture as you are designing a client UX or deciding how Wealthsimple should work with an external provider.




ABOUT THE TEAM

The Brokerage & Bank Linking team builds the technology that lets clients link their outside bank and brokerage accounts to Wealthsimple. It owns the automated and manual linking experiences end to end, along with the three connectors behind them: Plaid, Flinks, and WST, our own in-house connector. That makes it one of the highest leverage surfaces in the company, and powers a growing set of experiences built by other product teams.




WHAT YOU’LL OWN

Connectivity Strategy

 - Set the long term vision and strategy for how Wealthsimple connects with the broader financial ecosystem.

 - Define the capabilities we should build ourselves, where we should rely on partners, and where we can create differentiated client value.

 - Develop a roadmap that balances immediate product needs with investments in reusable platform capabilities.

Brokerage & Bank Linking

 - Own the end to end experience for connecting external bank and brokerage accounts to Wealthsimple — automated and manual, including how clients recover when an automated connection fails.

 - Improve connection success, reliability and coverage across institutions, and own the routing strategy that decides which connector handles which institution and flow.

 - Own the client experience, including institution selection, authentication, errors, recovery and connection management.

 - Drive reliability and AI Powered  self-healing so connections detect and recover from failure without manual intervention.

 - Balance conversion against fraud exposure and operational load, making those tradeoffs deliberately with our risk and operations partners.

 - Develop the platform capabilities that allow Wealthsimple products to consume external financial data consistently.

 - Own relationships and product integrations with connectivity vendors such as Plaid and Flinks, and decide where our own connector should lead — including how much of the connector business Wealthsimple should be in long term and where it makes more sense to partner.

Public API

 - Own the strategy and roadmap for Wealthsimple’s Public API and external data connectivity.

 - Make it safe and easy for clients to permission their Wealthsimple financial data to the products and services they choose.

 - Define the platform capabilities required for authentication, consent, permissions, data access and partner integrations.

 - Identify and prioritize the partners and use cases that matter most to Wealthsimple clients.

 - Build toward a world where Wealthsimple is the financial institution where clients have the most control over their financial data.

 - Accelerate wealthsimple and our industry toward open banking.




SKILLS YOU BRING

You’re a strong product thinker who can operate across platform infrastructure, external ecosystems and client experience. You likely have:

 - Experience owning a platform, API, developer product or integrations platform, with a track record on metric-attached outcomes like conversion, success rate or reliability — not only feature delivery.

 - Enough technical depth to work closely with engineers on APIs, authentication, data models, routing and platform architecture.

 - Experience delivering through external vendors or partners whose roadmaps you don’t control, including making thoughtful build versus buy decisions and holding vendors accountable for product outcomes.

 - Comfort treating reliability as product work — error taxonomies, failure recovery, observability, and the operational load a product creates.

 - Experience weighing growth against fraud, risk and compliance, and holding both sides of that tradeoff.

 - The ability to turn a collection of technical capabilities into a clear product strategy and compelling long term vision, and to make the case for investing in it.

 - Strong analytical instincts and comfort using data to understand reliability, conversion, coverage and product performance, including building the measurement where it doesn’t exist yet.

 - Excellent cross functional leadership across Engineering, Design, Security, Legal, Compliance, Operations and external partners.

 - A bias toward simplifying complicated systems rather than layering more complexity on top of them.




NICE TO HAVES

 - Experience with open banking, Canada’s consumer-driven banking framework, or building to a data sharing standard

 - A background in financial data aggregation, whether at an aggregator, a bank, or a fintech consuming one

 - Experience shipping a public API or developer platform as a commercial product, including partner onboarding and support




WHAT GREAT LOOKS LIKE

You won’t just operate Bank Linking and ship API endpoints.



You’ll create a coherent connectivity strategy for Wealthsimple: making it easier for clients to bring their financial life to Wealthsimple, easier to move their financial data where they want it to go, easier for any team at Wealthsimple to build on that data, and increasingly less dependent on the slow pace of connectivity innovation from incumbent financial institutions.

Our team, Consolidation, owns the first mile of the Wealthsimple relationship: onboarding, the homescreen + first layer of the app, and our Tiers program (Premium and Generation). Our job is to get new clients in the door, funded, and consolidating more of their financial life with Wealthsimple.



Our fastest-growing segment this year were high-net-worth clients. We're seeing real organic pull, and continuing to grow net deposits at the rate we have means winning larger, more complex relationships. Clients who today are typically served by private bankers and expect a level of service, product depth, and recognition that we need to meet and then beat.



That's the mandate for this role: continue to expand Wealthsimple’s growth upmarket. It means evolving our Tiers program into something a high-net-worth client would choose over their bank, and it means using what we know about a client to make a sharper, more personal case for bringing the rest of their financial life here. Convincing millions of Canadians to consolidate their financial lives at Wealthsimple is the mission we've been on for over 10 years, and we're looking for someone who can lead the next phase of this work and own it end to end.




WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Help define the product vision and strategy for how Wealthsimple wins and serves high-net-worth clients, and own the roadmap to bring it to life.

 - Lead the planning, development, launch, and iteration of a step change in our Tiers program. The service, product depth, and recognition that makes a client choose us as their primary financial institution.

 - Build the personalized experiences that compel clients to consolidate: understanding a client's current financial life and making the case, in-product, for moving it to Wealthsimple.

 - Working across the funding and consolidation funnel end to end, from a client's first session through to a fully consolidated relationship. Crafting the right incentives, onboarding journey, and product experiences along the way.

 - Support a cross-functional team of engineers, designers, and data scientists as we collectively explore new ways of working.

 - Partner deeply with other product teams and departments across the company (e.g. Marketing, Operations, Client Experience, Legal and Compliance, and more). You'll own a meaningful piece of this directly and influence a much larger piece through others.

 - Help elevate the Product Management practice at Wealthsimple and create an inclusive and supportive team culture.




SKILLS YOU BRING

 - Years of shipping products people actually love — across both customer-facing and platform work. You've owned a product (or a big chunk of one) and know how to lead complex, cross-functional projects without losing momentum.

 - A bias to ship. We don't do endless debate. The fastest way to know if something works is to put it in front of clients — so we ship, learn, and iterate.

 - Enough technical fluency to keep up with engineers — you can talk architecture and tradeoffs, and you're hungry to learn what you don't know yet so you can make better calls.

 - A real belief in financial inclusion — you want to build things that give more people access to financial freedom, not fewer.

 - Bonus: Experience building, shipping, iterating and growing products from 0 to 1 over multiple years. We know building new client experiences that client love will require a sustained multi-year effort.




WHO YOU ARE

 - A systems thinker. You can take a messy pile of use cases and distill them into one simple, elegant solution.

 - A strong technical partner. You work hand-in-hand with engineering to turn a logical design into a real technical architecture.

 - Comfortable in the grey. You can take raw, messy data (qualitative or quantitative) and pull out the actual problem, the real insight, the requirement that matters.

 - A rigorous thinker. You don't skip steps. You work through problems systematically, and you know the difference between a good answer and a fast one.

 - Scrappy, and happy to wear different hats. Sometimes that means building a business case. Sometimes it's mapping a workflow. Sometimes it's sitting across the table from a vendor or regulator and negotiating the details.

 - A clear communicator. You can take something complicated and make it simple, without losing what matters.

 - A collaborative, empathetic leader. You know how to work with a wide range of stakeholders and make sure everyone's voice actually gets heard.




WHY WEALTHSIMPLE?

🌸 Top-tier health benefits and life insurance

📈 Long-term group savings with employer match, through Wealthsimple for Business

🌴 20 vacation days, 4 wellness days, and unlimited sick and mental health days per year*

✈️ 90 days away: work outside Canada for up to 90 days per year*

👥 Employee resource groups, including Rainbow (2SLGBTQ), Women of WS, and Black at WS

🌎 We are a hybrid team with over 1,500 employees across North America. The people are one of the best parts of working here: you'll collaborate with incredibly talented, curious, and driven teammates who are deeply committed to doing great work.

*Unlimited paid sick days, Wellness Days and the 90 day away program do not apply to certain roles. 




ICYMI

Technology & Innovation at Wealthsimple: We move quickly and build thoughtfully. That means we're always looking for better ways to work — whether that's new tools, AI, or rethinking how we approach a problem. We don't expect you to have all the answers, but we do expect curiosity and a willingness to evolve alongside the products we're building.



Inclusion Statement: We're building products for a diverse world, and we need a diverse team to do it well. We strongly encourage applications from everyone, regardless of race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, or disability status.



Accessibility Statement: We're committed to an accessible hiring experience. If you need any accommodations throughout the interview process, please let us know — we'll work with you to make sure you have what you need. We also welcome any feedback on how we can better accommodate candidates with accessibility needs.



AI in Hiring: We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of our hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses. These tools assist our team but don't replace human judgment – all final hiring decisions are made by people. If you have questions about how your data is used, reach out to us.

As part of Core Services within Workday's Platform organization, IXP delivers the foundational layers that every Workday application and agent is built on and every user interacts with. Through data-driven insights, cutting-edge technology, and strong cross-functional collaboration, the team multiplies the impact of every application team by delivering scalable, user-centric solutions and a cohesive, agent-ready foundation essential to Workday's next era of innovation. Managing and orchestrating required workstreams to achieve product milestones and customer needs, resolving ambiguity on product direction and serving as the ultimate product authority. 
 About You 

 Basic Qualifications  

- 10+ years of experience as a product management leader, conceiving, defining, and delivering transformative SaaS and/or (cloud-based) enterprise software products with market impact. 

- Bachelor's degree in a relevant discipline such as Business, Computer Science, or a related discipline; a Master's degree preferred or equivalent practical experience. 

 Other Qualifications 

- Exceptional ability to exert significant Business Influence across the organization and with external partners, driving strategic alignment and securing buy-in for major product initiatives. 

- Mastery in leading Cross-Team Collaboration, effectively working with and influencing Engineering, UX Design, Data Science, alongside executive stakeholders, to synchronize roadmaps and deliver unified, cross-functional initiatives to define and deliver complex, cross-functional product strategies and initiatives. 

- Proven ability to be a visionary Customer Advocate, deeply understanding and anticipating customer needs in product strategy and decisions, and driving a customer-obsessed culture throughout the organization through defining long-term customer experience principles and embedding customer-centricity directly into the platform architecture and agentic product vision. 

- Deep mastery of Customer Empathy, proactively identifying fundamental customer pain points and translating them into transformative product strategies and innovative user experiences by conducting deep-dive qualitative research, analyzing user sentiment across enterprise workflows, and mapping complex user journeys to uncover latent needs. 

- Exceptional skills in Data Analysis, using advanced product analytics, predictive modeling techniques, and A/B testing methodologies to inform product strategy, prioritize feature backlogs, and measure platform success through actionable KPIs to derive critical insights for shaping product strategy, driving prioritization at an organizational level, and establishing key performance indicators for long-term success. 

- Mastery in Decision Making in complex and strategic product-related matters, balancing user needs, business goals, and technical feasibility with a long-term, holistic perspective, and effectively communicating those decisions with clear strategic rationale and considering broad organizational impact using multi-criteria decision analysis, trade-off frameworks, and rigorous ROI modeling to ensure alignment with long-term platform strategy and organizational business objectives. 

- Deep and strategic Domain Knowledge of the relevant industry and market, with a comprehensive understanding of enterprise SaaS trends, UI/UX Platforms, AI/ML agentic frameworks, large-scale user experience patterns, and the evolving regulatory landscape surrounding generative AI. 

- Proven ability to lead and define Research strategies to inform product vision, identify disruptive opportunities, and gain deep understanding of user behavior at a fundamental level, utilizing generative research, ethnographic studies, and rapid prototyping feedback loops to identify disruptive innovation opportunities and validate platform enhancements. 

- Mastery in Stakeholder Management, effectively communicating with, influencing, and managing expectations of executive leadership teams, product peers across business units, and key strategic partners to ensure alignment on platform vision, investment priorities, and delivery timelines. 

- Exceptional Strategic Thinking skills, shaping the long-term vision and direction of a product portfolio or business unit and identifying disruptive opportunities by identifying white-space opportunities, formulating multi-year platform roadmaps, and architecting new market-entry strategies that drive competitive differentiation.

Workday Agent Factory builds autonomous AI agents that become standalone product lines, not incremental AI features bolted onto existing workflows. We operate as a 0-to-1 team inside Workday: identifying high-conviction bets in complex, regulated domains like finance and HCM, then building production-grade agents that will become revenue lines. Our PMs prototype with their own hands, ship fast, and navigate the real constraints of enterprise customers: compliance, auditability, and deeply embedded business processes. If you want to build the next generation of enterprise software, not just add AI to the current one, this is the team. 
 About the Role 

 We are looking for Principal Product Managers who have shipped production AI agent systems and want to do it again at enterprise scale. You will own an agent from concept through GA: scoping the bet, prototyping solutions, running early adopter programs, and scaling to Workday's global customer base. This is not a strategy-deck role. You will be hands-on with agent architectures, evaluation frameworks, and customer workflows daily, while also making sharp prioritization calls across a fast-moving portfolio.

 This role requires a rare combination: the scrappiness to prototype and build in weeks, the technical depth to design reliable agent systems, and the domain judgment to solve real problems in highly regulated, highly complex environments. 

 Responsibilities:

- Own an AI agent end-to-end, from identifying the opportunity through GA launch and beyond 

- Prototype and validate agent concepts rapidly, using real customer workflows and data to pressure-test viability before committing engineering resources 

- Design production-quality agent systems in collaboration with engineering, ensuring reliability, auditability, and trust in regulated domains 

- Run customer discovery and Early Adopter programs to validate value, generate references, and derisk at every stage 

- Identify the highest-ROI agent opportunities in finance and HCM, build conviction with data, and advocate for them within the organization 

- Define measurable value outcomes and evaluation frameworks that prove agent impact quantitatively 

- Collaborate deeply with domain PMs to understand workflows, constraints, and where autonomous agents unlock step-function value versus incremental improvement 

- Communicate agent vision and progress to executives, customers, field teams, and implementers, translating technical capability into business value

- 11+ years of product management experience 

- 5+ years in SaaS/B2B enterprise software 

- Direct experience building and shipping external, revenue generating AI forward product and /or agent systems to production (not just AI/ML features, but agents that reason, plan, and take action autonomously) 

- Deep technical acumen: you can evaluate agent architectures, debug failure modes, and make informed design tradeoffs with engineering 

- Strong communication and relationship-building skills across engineering, customers, and executive stakeholders 

 Other Qualifications: 

- Experience in regulated or complex domains (finance, HCM, healthcare, legal) where trust, compliance, and auditability are non-negotiable 

- Track record of 0-to-1 product development: you've taken something from idea to revenue, not just maintained an existing product 

- Bias for action, comfortable making high-stakes decisions with incomplete information and iterating from there 

- Experience managing Early Adopter or beta programs with enterprise customers 

- Ability to operate across multiple functions, influence senior executives, and drive alignment without authority 

 You'll be a great fit if: 

- You are already building agent systems, whether prototyping on weekends, shipping side projects, or pushing the boundaries at your current company 

- You have strong opinions on agent evaluation, reliability, and human-in-the-loop design, formed from hands-on experience, not just reading papers 

- You learn complex customer domains fast and can identify where agents create step-function value versus where they create risk 

- You are motivated by building new product lines from scratch, not optimizing existing ones 

- You are organized enough to track dozens of moving pieces across customers, engineering, and stakeholders while maintaining velocity

We operate like a 0-to-1 product team inside Workday: finding high-conviction bets, validating them with real customers, and scaling them into production-grade enterprise products.

Our PMs are builders. They work directly with engineering and go deep into customer workflows where data, knowledge, analytics, and AI intersect. We move quickly, but in domains where trust, auditability, compliance, security, and deeply embedded business processes matter. 
 About the Role 

 You will own a product line, not a feature backlog. You will have direct customer access, the autonomy to shape product decisions, and the mandate to turn Workday's data and domain knowledge into new categories of enterprise AI products. 

 About the Role 
 We are hiring Senior and Principal Product Managers to own AI agent products from the earliest bet through GA and scale. This is a hands-on product-building role: you will turn ambiguous customer problems into prototypes, evals, launch scopes, and shipped products with engineering, design, data science, field, and domain teams. 

 The best candidates will be hands-on with agent workflows, customer discovery, product instrumentation, evals, failure modes, and launch execution. You do not need years with the title "AI PM," but you do need to learn new technical domains quickly, build instead of wait, and turn ambiguity into shipped customer value. 

 In your first six months, you will shape a product thesis, validate it with design partners, and define the evidence and scope needed for GA. 

 Responsibilities 

- Own an AI agent product end-to-end, from opportunity discovery and product thesis through GA launch, adoption, and iteration. 

- Identify and validate high-ROI opportunities in finance and HCM by working backward from real customer pain, business value, data availability, knowledge quality, and failure tolerance. 

- Partner deeply with engineering to shape reliable agent architectures, evaluation harnesses, observability, human-in-the-loop controls, and production readiness. 

- Define product-quality evals that measure whether an agent is useful, trustworthy, and ready for customer use, not just whether a demo looks impressive. 

- Build conviction through working demos, measurable results, customer discovery, design partner programs, and clear decision memos, not polished roadmap theater. 

- Rally domain PMs, design, engineering, field, legal, security, and executives around the decisions needed to ship. 

 About You 

 Basic Qualifications 

- 8+ years of product management, founder, product lead, or equivalent product-building experience for Senior Product Manager; 11+ years for Principal Product Manager. 

- 5+ years building B2B or enterprise software where AI/ML, data, analytics, or decision-support products are central to the customer value proposition. 

- Track record of 0-to-1 product development: you have taken something from concept to first customers, revenue, or measurable business impact. 

- Demonstrated technical fluency with AI/ML systems, data or analytics products, enterprise platforms, or workflow automation. 

- Experience using customer evidence, product metrics, and structured judgment to make high-stakes product decisions with incomplete information. 

- High agency with modern AI tools: you use tools such as Claude, Cursor, Codex, or equivalents to prototype, analyze, write, test, research, or automate parts of your own product workflow. 

 Preferred Qualifications 

- Hands-on experience building, prototyping, or shipping AI agents, AI-native products, LLM features, workflow automation, decision-support systems, or data-intensive enterprise products. 

- Strong intuition for agent evaluation, reliability, hallucination risk, human-in-the-loop design, permissions, auditability, and production failure modes. 

- Experience in regulated or complex domains such as finance, HCM, healthcare, legal, planning, analytics, or enterprise operations. 

- Experience managing design partner, beta, Early Adopter, or lighthouse customer programs. 

- Strong product taste: you can simplify complex workflows into opinionated experiences that customers understand, trust, and adopt. 

 You'll Be a Great Fit If 

- You are already building with AI, whether at work, through side projects, prototypes, internal tools, or hands-on experimentation. 

- You have strong opinions about where agents should act autonomously, where humans must stay in control, and how to prove the difference. 

- You are candid about tradeoffs, including projects you killed, launches that missed, or bets that changed direction because the evidence demanded it.

We build AI first products, and automate manual work, freeing up our customers time and accelerating their businesses. 

You will be joining the Evisort AI team, which functions as a startup within Workday. This is your opportunity to build at the pace of innovation of a startup, while backed by the enormous support and impacting Workday’s incredible customer base of 70M+ users. 
 About the Role 

 This role isn’t a traditional Product Manager. It is part high-level Product Strategy, part Solutions Architecture, and part "Client Whisperer." Your mission is to bridge the gap between our cutting-edge AI Workday Contracts Management powered by Evisort, and the real-world customer environment, ensuring our global enterprise customers understand, trust, and adopt our product.

 As a Product Manager - Evisort AI , you won’t just be building features; you’ll be defining how AI is positioned, demo’ed, and evaluated. You will act as a thought partner to both our internal teams and our enterprise customers, helping them navigate one of the biggest shifts in legal history: evaluating the ROI of AI and mapping its impact across complex practice areas. - Pre-Sales Activation Strategy: Define the global strategy for activating AI agents. Set the bar for what great looks like in a technical evaluation and ensure Product and Sales are perfectly aligned. 

- Demo & POC Innovation: Shape how AI proofs-of-concept are approached. Partner with Solutions Consulting to ensure demos aren’t just "cool," but are credible, repeatable, and tied to real customer questions. 

- The Voice of the User: Act as the primary feedback loop. Translate field experience and client "pain points" into structured insights that directly inform product development and roadmap priorities. 

- Narrative & Value Definition: Define the technical narrative. Clarify AI differentiation and known limitations to ensure our messaging supports a credible, honest, and high-value customer evaluation. 

- Cross-Functional Partnership: Partner deeply with Solutions Architecture and Enterprise Architecture leadership to evolve our activation approach as our AI maturity grows. 

 What Success Looks Like: 

- Credibility: AI agents are represented with confidence and accuracy across all pre-sales engagements and post-sales implementations. 

- Impact: Evisort/Workday drives meaningful revenue impact through increased attach rates, expansion, net-new wins, and customer retention. 

- Adoption: Customers don't just buy the AI; they successfully adopt and use it post-sale because it was scoped correctly from day one. 

- Influence: You are the "calm, credible presence" that helps lawyers and engineers speak the same language. 

 About You 

 You come from a world of complex problem-solving, and you’ve never been content with the status quo. You are tech-curious and product-savvy—you don’t need to be a coder, but you must be passionate about navigating technical conversations around generative AI and technology implementation. - 4+ years of experience in product management and/or GTM implementation, defining, launching, and iterating on impactful SaaS and/or cloud-based enterprise software products. 

- Bachelor’s degree in a relevant discipline (Business, Computer Science, Law) or equivalent practical experience. 

- Industry Context: A background in law or legal tech, with experience at a top-tier firm, in-house legal team, or a disruptive legal-tech venture. 

 Other Qualifications 

- Business Influence & Stakeholder Management : Proven ability to exert significant influence across product teams and executive leadership to drive alignment. 

- Cross-Team Collaboration: A master of "translating" across disciplines—effectively leading Engineering, Design, and Marketing to deliver complex strategies. 

- Customer Empathy & Advocacy : Deep experience in identifying "thorny" operational problems and translating them into impactful product solutions. 

- Strategic Thinking : The ability to see the "big picture" of the legal business and how emerging technologies will improve existing processes. 

- Data-Driven Decision Making : Solid skills in using data analysis to derive actionable insights, prioritize roadmaps, and measure the success of AI initiatives. 

- Ambiguity Management : Proactive and self-directed, with the ability to bring structure to complex, fast-moving environments while juggling multiple high-stakes relationships

hibob:xanadu:fc75bb0b-e7de-4b99-88f6-d05.description:
About Xanadu: 
 Xanadu’s mission is to build quantum computers that are useful and available to people everywhere. 

At Xanadu, we are learners, innovators, researchers, collaborators and problem solvers. We are creating something that has never been built before. What we are doing is extremely hard, the classic moon shot. Few people in their life will be able to be a part of something like this, where if we are successful, the technologies we develop will solve some of the world’s most challenging problems, and literally change the world. And that is something to be excited about!

 Your role and responsibilities:
 As a Sr. Technical Program Manager, your primary mission is to ensure we successfully deliver new versions of our quantum hardware systems on schedule and within budget. You are the high-velocity driver of the project lifecycle, focused on identifying and clearing the path for our engineering teams. This role will specifically be tasked with handling our DARPA QBI program and other contracts with diverse agencies.

- Position Location: US Remote (regular monthly/quarterly travel to Toronto) or Toronto Office

- Schedule & Budget Ownership: Define and maintain the master program schedule, ensuring that all modular subsystem tranches meet critical milestones without cost overruns.

- Communication with DARPA: Be the primary contact with the DARPA team communicating our progress and other important information as the program progresses.

- Bottleneck Removal: Proactively identify technical and operational "blockers" in the development pipeline and orchestrate rapid-response solutions to keep delivery on track.

- Cross-Functional Alignment: Coordinate efforts across all teams to ensure that dependencies are managed and integration happens seamlessly and on time.

- Resource Management: Optimize the allocation of personnel and specialized equipment to ensure that the most critical path items receive the necessary support for timely completion.

- Process Efficiency: Drive process improvements to increase the reliability and repeatability of hardware deployment and validation workflows.

- Risk Mitigation: Perform continuous system risk analysis to anticipate potential delays and design recovery strategies before they impact the bottom line.

 Basic qualifications and experience:

- BSc or MSc in Engineering, Physics, or a related technical field.

- Proficient in MS Project Plan tool usage.

- PMP project management certification.

- 5+ years of experience in technical project or program management, specifically driving the delivery of complex hardware-software systems.

- Demonstrated expertise in project management tools and methodologies (Agile, Gantt, Critical Path Analysis) for hardware environments.

- Proven track record of managing multi-million-dollar budgets and complex technical supply chains.

- Exceptional leadership skills with a focus on accountability, timeline adherence, and resolving team-level friction.

 Preferred qualifications and experience:

- Experience delivering programs for US government entities such as DARPA, ARPA, NIST etc.

- Experience in high-stakes industries such as Semiconductor, Aerospace, Satellite engineering, or Quantum computing where schedule slips have significant mission impact.

- Experience with vendor management and defining tool acceptance criteria to ensure third-party delivery stays on schedule.

- Background in streamlining automated validation workflows to reduce time-to-delivery.

Our values are important. They are fundamental and lay the foundation for culture at Xanadu. Learn more about our values  here .

This is for a new position. Your base salary will be determined based on your location, experience, and internal benchmarks.

We are committed to building an inclusive, safe, and equitable culture and fostering an environment where our employees feel included, valued, and heard. We are committed to meeting the needs of all individuals and support a barrier-free workplace. About Xanadu: 
 Xanadu’s mission is to build quantum computers that are useful and available to people everywhere. 

At Xanadu, we are learners, innovators, researchers, collaborators and problem solvers. We are creating something that has never been built before. What we are doing is extremely hard, the classic moon shot. Few people in their life will be able to be a part of something like this, where if we are successful, the technologies we develop will solve some of the world’s most challenging problems, and literally change the world. And that is something to be excited about!

 Your role and responsibilities:
 Xanadu Quantum Technologies is seeking a Technical Product Marketing Manager to lead the messaging, positioning, and go-to-market strategy for PennyLane, our industry-leading open-source software framework for quantum machine learning and quantum computing.

As a Technical Product Marketing Manager at Xanadu, you will stand at the intersection of quantum physics, software engineering, and business strategy. You will serve as the strategic link between technical development and commercial growth, partnering closely with engineering, product management, and business development teams to shape how developers, researchers, and enterprise R&D departments build on PennyLane. In this role, you will translate cutting-edge quantum capabilities into compelling narratives and design targeted campaigns that attract new users and drive business pipeline.

Key Responsibilities:

- Collaborate directly with engineering and product leadership to inform product planning, synthesize technical feedback, and align PennyLane's development roadmap with market demands.

- Define, refine, and capture core positioning and value propositions for PennyLane.

- Architect, execute, and scale multi-channel marketing campaigns designed to attract new developers, students, and industry scientists expanding market share and directly generating qualified pipeline.

- Perform ongoing competitive analysis and SWOT evaluations across the quantum software ecosystem to refine messaging, map market trends, and defend key technical differentiators.

- Build high-value technical assets—whitepapers, blogs, customer stories, and technical presentations—and represent Xanadu as a technical evangelist at industry events and analyst briefings.

- Measure and report on the impact of product marketing initiatives, tracking platform adoption, developer engagement, and campaign contribution to overall revenue pipeline.

 Basic qualifications and experience:

- 5+ years in technical product marketing, product management, or technical developer marketing within open-source software, cloud computing, AI/ML, or deep tech.

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Physics, Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.

- Demonstrated experience partnering with software engineering teams on product planning, messaging, positioning, and competitive analysis.

- Proven track record of designing marketing campaigns that attract new customers and drive measurable sales or adoption pipeline.

- Demonstrated experience taking technical products to market.

- Ability to translate complex technical concepts into clear, impactful content and hands-on demonstrations.

- Strong analytical, communication, and cross-functional project management skills.

 Preferred qualifications and experience:

- Background or familiarity with quantum computing concepts, PennyLane, or classical ML frameworks.

- Experience launching and scaling open-source developer tooling or enterprise deep-tech platforms.

This is for a new position. Your base salary will be determined based on your location, experience, and internal benchmarks. The base salary range is 100,000 - 140,000 CAD. You will also be eligible for equity and benefits. 

Our values are important. They are fundamental and lay the foundation for culture at Xanadu. Learn more about our values here . 

We are an equal opportunity employer and encourage candidates of all backgrounds to apply. We are committed to building an inclusive, safe, and equitable culture and fostering an environment where our employees feel included, valued, and heard. We are committed to meeting the needs of all individuals and support a barrier-free workplace. Should you require accommodations at any point during the recruitment process please contact Recruiting at  recruiting@xanadu.ai .

Please be advised that we may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to assist in the screening and assessment of applicants for this position. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

Zafin is an AI platform company helping regulated institutions modernize how critical work is designed, governed, and delivered. Our technology enables organizations to move faster while maintaining the governance, accountability, and control required in highly regulated environments.

 Our portfolio includes Zafin AIOS , an agent orchestration platform for governed AI work; the Zafin Banking Platform , which helps banks modernize product, pricing, offers, billing, loyalty, and relationship management; and Zafin IO , an integration platform that connects data, systems, and workflows across complex enterprise environments.

 Headquartered in Toronto, Canada, Zafin partners with leading financial institutions across North America, Europe, the Middle East, Africa, and Asia-Pacific. As AI transforms the future of financial services, we're building the platforms that help regulated organizations adopt AI responsibly and at scale.

 What is the Opportunity?

 As a Product Manager, UX for AIOS, you will define and drive product experiences that make complex AI workflows clear, usable, and valuable for customers in regulated financial services.

 You will sit at the intersection of product management, user experience, engineering, AI, and customer delivery. Your focus will be understanding users, shaping the roadmap, defining product requirements, partnering closely with design, and ensuring AIOS experiences support real work: agent orchestration, workflow setup, monitoring, review, exception handling, and human-in-the-loop control.

 This role matters because governed AI only creates value when users can understand it, trust it, and operate it confidently. You will help AIOS move from technical capability to product experiences that customers can adopt at scale.

 What Will You Do?

- Define product strategy, roadmap priorities, and UX-focused product requirements for AIOS experiences and workflows.

- Deeply understand user needs through discovery, stakeholder interviews, customer feedback, workflow analysis, and collaboration with delivery teams.

- Partner closely with product designers to shape user journeys, wireframes, prototypes, interaction patterns, and design decisions for AIOS features.

- Translate customer problems, business goals, and technical constraints into clear product requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, and success measures.

- Work with engineering, AI, architecture, QA, and DevOps teams to make trade-offs, clarify implementation details, and deliver high-quality product capabilities.

- Define and track product success metrics such as adoption, task completion, workflow efficiency, user satisfaction, feature usage, quality, and support feedback.

- Prioritize the roadmap based on customer value, technical feasibility, delivery commitments, risk, and strategic fit with AIOS.

- Support demos, customer conversations, internal enablement, and go-to-market readiness for new AIOS product experiences.

- Champion usability, accessibility, clarity, and trust in AI-powered workflows, especially where users need transparency, control, and confidence.

- Continuously improve product discovery and delivery practices so the team can move quickly while staying anchored in customer outcomes.

 What Do You Need to Succeed?

 Must haves

- 3+ years of product management, technical product management, UX product management, product design leadership, or closely related experience in software products.

- 2+ years of experience working on enterprise SaaS, workflow, platform, data, AI, automation, or developer/productivity tools.

- Strong understanding of product discovery, roadmap planning, user research methods, requirement definition, prioritization, and product delivery.

- Demonstrated ability to partner with designers on UX strategy, user journeys, wireframes, prototypes, and usability feedback.

- Ability to translate ambiguous customer problems into clear product requirements, success metrics, and delivery-ready stories.

- Comfort working with technical teams and discussing APIs, data flows, AI behavior, system constraints, and implementation trade-offs.

- Strong analytical skills, including the ability to use qualitative feedback and quantitative data to make product decisions.

- Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to align engineering, design, delivery, leadership, and customer stakeholders.

- Bachelor's degree in Business, Computer Science, Design, Human-Computer Interaction, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

 Nice to have

- Experience with AI-powered products, LLM-based workflows, agent orchestration, human-in-the-loop systems, or responsible AI controls.

- Experience in banking, financial services, regulatory technology, enterprise operations, or other high-trust domains.

- Experience with Figma or similar product design and prototyping tools.

- Experience working with design systems, accessibility standards, and complex enterprise UX patterns.

- Experience supporting customer workshops, product demos, or executive-level product conversations.

- Experience taking a product from early concept through launch and post-launch iteration.

- Comfort working in a fast-moving environment where product direction evolves based on customer learning and technical discovery.

 Additional Job Details  

 At Zafin, we invest in our people. Our comprehensive rewards program is designed to support your health, financial well-being, and work-life balance, including:

- Fully company-paid health benefits

- Annual bonus opportunities

- Generous vacation and holidays

- RRSP matching

- Employer-paid insurance coverage

- Wellness resources

- Extensive paramedical benefits, and more

 Use of AI : Zafin may use Artificial Intelligence (AI) and/or other forms of automated technology to screen and/or assess applicants for this position. Zafin will not utilize AI for conducting interviews and/or making hiring decisions. 

 What’s in it for you 

 Joining our team means being part of a culture that values diversity, teamwork, and high-quality work. We offer competitive salaries, annual bonus potential, generous paid time off, paid volunteering days, wellness benefits, and robust opportunities for professional growth and career advancement. Want to learn more about what you can look forward to during your career with us? Visit our careers site and our openings:  zafin.com/careers

 - 5+ years’ experience working in one of the following roles: Procurement/Sourcing Manager, ERP/P2P Systems Consultant, or managing key customer and stakeholder relationships in a B2B SaaS company

 - Prior experience with the implementation or administration of a procurement tool / ERP (Microsoft Dynamics, SAP Ariba, Sage, Oracle Fusion, Netsuite, etc.)

Principal Product Manager, Content Transformation (Direct Tax AI)   

 Job Description: 
 Thomson Reuters has long been the industry leader in delivering expert tax content and insights that power our software, products, and customer workflows. As advances in AI and automation reshape how knowledge work is performed, we have an opportunity to fundamentally rethink how content is acquired, interpreted, transformed, and integrated into our products.  

 The Principal Product Manager, Content Transformation will lead this evolution. This role will define and execute a roadmap to modernize our approach to Content across our Direct Tax business, leveraging AI, automation, and human-in-the-loop workflows to increase speed, quality, scalability, and impact.  

 This is a highly strategic and hands-on product role focused on transforming the way subject matter expertise is applied throughout our Direct Tax organization. You will work across Product, Content, Technology, and Operations teams to design new capabilities, workflows, and tools that combine AI with deep domain expertise, enabling our experts to focus on high-value analysis, thought leadership, judgment, and validation while accelerating the delivery of accurate, impactful content to customers. You will play a critical role in helping Thomson Reuters build the future operating model for AI-powered content creation and delivery.  

 Role Overview : 
 The Principal Product Manager, Content Transformation is responsible for identifying, prioritizing, and delivering the highest-impact opportunities to modernize our content ecosystem through AI and automation.  
 This leader will develop a deep understanding of our content workflows, tax domain expertise, and product development processes. They will assess where AI can drive meaningful improvements in efficiency, quality, speed, and scale while ensuring appropriate human oversight and governance.  
 Success in this role requires a rare combination of product leadership, operational transformation experience, AI fluency, and execution excellence. The ideal candidate can move seamlessly between strategy and implementation, defining long-term operating models while also building prototypes, testing AI solutions, and partnering directly with teams to implement new ways of working.  
 As Thomson Reuters' most senior individual contributor product role, the Principal Product Manager is expected to exercise significant autonomy, influence senior leaders, navigate ambiguity, and drive cross-functional alignment across multiple teams and disciplines.  

 Key Responsibilities: 
 As a Principal Product Manager, you will:  
 Define and Lead the Content Transformation Strategy   

- Create and execute a multi-year roadmap to transform the Tax & Accounting content organization through AI and automation.  

- Identify and prioritize transformation opportunities across content acquisition, interpretation, authoring, validation, maintenance, and product integration workflows.  

- Establish clear success metrics and business cases that demonstrate measurable operational and customer impact.  
 Reimagine How Subject Matter Expertise Is Applied   

- Partner closely with Product Content leaders, tax analysts and other domain experts to understand tax content, software, and customer workflows and pain points, identifying opportunities to deliver higher-quality content faster, more accurately, and at greater scale through AI-enabled processes.  

- Design future-state workflows that effectively combine AI capabilities with human expertise.  

- Help evolve roles from manual content processing and translation activities toward higher-value work such as prompt development, exception management, quality evaluation, and expert decision-making.  
 Build AI-Powered Workflow Solutions   

- Work hands-on with Engineering, Data Science, TR Labs, and business stakeholders to prototype and deliver AI-enabled capabilities.  

- Work with product content and tech partners to evolve capabilities and expertise by understanding internal development needs, exploring new technologies, evaluating development options, and advocating for investment.  

- Design and implement human-in-the-loop processes that balance automation, quality, compliance, and trust.  

- Apply technologies including Generative AI, agentic workflows, machine learning, workflow automation, and orchestration platforms to solve complex content challenges.  
 Drive Organizational Change   

- Lead cross-functional transformation initiatives that span Product, Content, Operations, Technology, and Compliance teams.  

- Build alignment among leaders and stakeholders around future-state processes, tools, and operating models.  

- Champion adoption of new workflows and ways of working across the organization.  
 Measure and Optimize Outcomes   

- Establish metrics to evaluate efficiency gains, quality improvements, cost savings, and business impact.  

- Continuously identify opportunities for optimization and expansion of AI-enabled workflows.  

- Use data and experimentation to guide investment decisions and roadmap priorities.  
 Serve as a Thought Leader   

- Stay at the forefront of AI, automation, knowledge management, and digital transformation trends.  

- Help shape Thomson Reuters' strategy for applying AI to content-intensive domains.  

- Influence leaders and teams through vision, expertise, and execution.  

 Required Qualifications: 
 To be successful in this role, you will be:  
 A Strategic Transformer   
 You have a demonstrated track record of leading large-scale business, operational, or workflow transformation initiatives and can connect long-term vision with practical execution.  
 AI Fluent and Experimentation Driven   
 You understand how modern AI technologies can be applied to knowledge-intensive work and have practical experience designing AI-powered workflows, automation solutions, or human-in-the-loop systems.  
 Customer and User Obsessed   
 You are passionate about understanding the needs of both external customers and internal users and use those insights to drive transformation priorities.  
 Hands-On and Outcome-Oriented   
 You are comfortable rolling up your sleeves, testing solutions, analyzing workflows, working directly with users, and rapidly iterating toward better outcomes.  
 Influential and Collaborative   
 You excel at driving alignment across diverse stakeholder groups and can effectively communicate with executives, technical teams, domain experts, and operational leaders.  

 Preferred Qualifications   

- 8+ years of Product Management, Business Transformation, Process Transformation, or related leadership experience.  

- Experience leading complex AI, automation, or digital transformation initiatives.  

- Demonstrated success redesigning business processes and operating models through technology innovation.  

- Strong understanding of Generative AI, agentic AI, workflow automation, and human-in-the-loop design patterns.  

- Experience building or delivering AI-enabled products, platforms, or internal tooling solutions.  

- Ability to analyze complex operational workflows and identify opportunities for automation and optimization.  

- Experience working with highly regulated, content-intensive, or knowledge-driven domains.  

- Tax, accounting, regulatory, compliance, or other professional information experience is strongly preferred.  

- Proven ability to influence senior leaders and drive organizational change within matrixed environments.  

- Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience required; advanced degree preferred

Summary: 
 We are seeking a strategic and technical Senior Product Manager to drive product market fit for CoCounsel, Tax, Audit & Accounting across corporate customers of all sizes, from global, large enterprises to mid-market and smaller corporate teams. The Senior Product Manager will be instrumental in identifying our biggest market opportunities across our Corporate customer base and shaping how a diverse range of corporate in-house teams leverage CoCounsel's platform to transform their tax, accounting, and financial reporting operations.

 About the Role 

- Corporate Segment Focus: Define and execute the product strategy for CoCounsel Tax, Audit & Accounting across the corporate customer segment. Develop a nuanced understanding of where our biggest market opportunities exist and prioritize accordingly, ensuring deep product-market fit for the diverse range of in-house tax, accounting, and financial teams we serve. Own the vision for how CoCounsel should look and feel for corporate customers, mapping out how the experience must differ from today's accounting firm-centric model to meet the unique needs, workflows, and personas of in-house teams.

- Customer & Market Research: Engage directly with customers and partners to identify unmet needs, validate hypotheses, and continuously refine roadmap priorities. Conduct deep dives into usage data and behavior patterns to surface insights that inform strategy and translate complex in-house tax, accounting, and financial reporting workflows into clear, actionable product requirements.

- Enterprise Enablement: Oversee development of capabilities suited to large, complex organizations, including workflow integrations, security and compliance standards, and scalable deployment models appropriate for global enterprise environments. Create a corporate templates library and revamp onboarding for corporate users.

- MCP/API & Platform Strategy: Champion our corporate AI strategy, anchored in an MCP/API integration model. Develop a strong point of view on how CoCounsel's agentic capabilities connect across the broader corporate product portfolio to serve the distinct needs of corporate personas.

- Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner closely with engineering, data science, and subject matter experts to design, develop, and launch innovative AI-driven features. Serve as a key liaison for product marketing, sales, and sales operations, ensuring go-to-market strategies are grounded in deep product knowledge, field feedback informs roadmap decisions, and segment teams have clear positioning and the tools they need to succeed.

 About You 

- 5+ years of product management experience, with a track record of delivering enterprise SaaS or legal/tax technology products.

- Deep understanding of in-house corporate tax, accounting, and financial reporting workflows and the operational needs of in-house corporate teams, including familiarity with the broader corporate tax product portfolio and landscape.

- Strong grasp of AI-driven product development, including agentic platforms, and the practical application of MCP/API integration strategies to serve complex enterprise personas. Familiarity with AI coding a plus
